### P_NEKO.B: 2D sprite test

**File:** `P_NEKO.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 34,081 bytes, 524 lines. 59 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:P_NEKO.B",R`.

Shows the three kinds of object-type sprite: a rotating sprite, one with independent horizontal and vertical scale, and a 4-point distorted sprite, using a cat picture.

**Techniques:**

- Sprite object types 1, 2 and 3
- Z position as sprite priority
- Putting sprites behind the text screen with `PRIORITY`

```
1000 '2D sprite display sample
1010 ' Written by Kanayama (motos)
1020 '
1030 KLOAD ON
1040 SCREEN 0: PRIORITY 10,1 :'Put sprites behind the text screen
1050 '----------------------------------
1060 'Object Item Number
1070 TYPE = 0
1080 XP=4: YP=5: ZP=6
1090 XR=8: YR=9: ZR=10
1100 XS=12: YS=13: ZS=14
1110 ATR = 16
1120 X0 = 48: Y0 = 49
1130 '----------------------------------
1140 KPRINT (120,40),"<- Sprite type 1"
1150 KPRINT (128,70),"Sprite type 2 (down)"
1160 KPRINT (18,200),"(up) Sprite type 3"
1170 TEX_NUM = 0   :'TEXTURE number to assign
1180 TEX_HS  = 112 :'TEXTURE width size
1190 TEX_VS  = 113 :'TEXTURE height size
1200 ATR_NUM = 0   :'ATTRIBUTE number to assign
1210 '
1220 PALETTE 10,0,READHEX$(256*2)          :'Read sprite color from DATA statement.
1230 SETTEX TEX_NUM,TEX_HS,TEX_VS,256,READ :'Read texture pattern from DATA statement.
1240 SETATR ATR_NUM,1,(0, 1, 3, TEX_NUM, 0, 0)
1250 ' A sprite's Z position is used as the display priority between sprites.
1260 ' If it is beyond 100 it may not be displayed at all.
1270 '
1280 OBJ(1,TYPE) = 1: 'Z-rotation sprite
1290 OBJ(1,ATR)  = ATR_NUM
1300 OBJ(1,XP)   = -100,-50,300 :' X,Y position given
1310 '
1320 OBJ(2,TYPE) = 2: 'Sprite with independent H/V scale
1330 OBJ(2,ATR)  = ATR_NUM
1340 OBJ(2,XP)   = 100,30,200 :' X,Y position given
1350 '
1360 OBJ(3,TYPE) = 3: '4-point sprite
1370 OBJ(3,ATR)  = ATR_NUM
1380 OBJ(3,XP)   = -70,50,100 :' X,Y,Z position given (reference position for the 4 points)
1390 '
1400 *LOOP
1410  OBJ(1,ZR) = XSIN(N*3)/16    :'Tilt left and right
1420  OBJ(1,XS) = XSIN(N/4)/4+.8  :'Scale slowly
1430  OBJ(2,XS) = XSIN(N)/4+.8,XCOS(N)/4+.8 :'Give the left/right scale factors
1440  P0_X = -TEX_HS/4 + XSIN(N*1.2)*50 : P0_Y = -TEX_VS/4 + XSIN(N)*10
1450  P1_X = +TEX_HS/4 + XCOS(N*1.2)*50 : P1_Y = -TEX_VS/4 + XCOS(N)*10
1460  P2_X = +TEX_HS/4 + XSIN(N)*100: P2_Y = +TEX_VS/4 + XSIN(N*1.7)*10
1470  P3_X = -TEX_HS/4 + XCOS(N)*100: P3_Y = +TEX_VS/4 + XCOS(N*1.7)*10
1480  OBJ(3,X0) = P0_X,P0_Y, P1_X,P1_Y, P2_X,P2_Y, P3_X,P3_Y
1490  N=(N+&H0.001) AND! &HFFFF.FFFC
1500  GOTO *LOOP
1510 '
1520 END
1530 '
1540 '==== PALETTE 256*2 bytes
1550 DATA 00010001000200220023004100240043006100620045006500640083006600A2
1560 DATA 0067048500C30487008804C504E404A908A804AA08C7012310E604CA05060CC9
1570 DATA 08CB0D07014608EC10EB00CE19270D290947050B018510EC0149150B1149110C
      ' ... 464 DATA lines and 1 comment line not shown (lines 1580-6220) ...
6230 DATA 3F5A3F2A423F876943330D0300010101

### P_HERI.B: Helicopter model

**File:** `P_HERI.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 12,363 bytes, 451 lines. 41 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:P_HERI.B",R`.

### P_DOLL.B: Doll animation editor

**File:** `P_DOLL.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 49,217 bytes, 1,451 lines. 237 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:P_DOLL.B",R`.

An editor for animating a jointed polygon doll. You pick a joint, set its angles for each frame with the pad, and insert, copy, delete, save and load frames.

**Techniques:**

- A hierarchical model: each body part is an object linked to its parent with an offset
- Key-frame animation stored in arrays
- Saving and loading motion data with `FWRITE`/`FREAD`
- An on-screen parameter display updated with `LOCATE`/`PRINT USING`

**Files it uses:** `TAISO.D` (sample motion data: exercises)

```
  100 CLEAR,400
  101 DIM CST$(24),SCD$(3,4)
  110 DIM OFX(20),OFY(20),OFZ(20),PAR(20)
  115 DIM R(3,20,200),BP(3,200)
  116 DIM PLNUM(20)
  117 DIM FT(200)
  200 SCREEN 0
  300 PP1 = 1:PP2 = 1:FRPOS = 1:VDIF = 4
  310 FRMAX = 200
  400 FOR I=1 TO 19
  401 READ CST$(I)
  402 NEXT
  410 FOR I=20 TO 23
  411 READ CST$(I),SCD$(1,I-19),SCD$(2,I-19),SCD$(3,I-19)
  412 NEXT
 1002 '----------------------------------
 1003 'Object Item Number
 1004 TYPE = 0: FLAG = 1
 1005 XP = 4: XR = 8: XS = 12
 1006 ATR = 16: POLYGON = 17: ORDER = 18
 1007 PARENT = 20: CHILD = 21
 1008 XV = 24: XA = 28: XL = 32: XRV= 36
 1009 '----------------------------------

 4014 OBJ(I,TYPE) = 4 :' POLYGON
 4015 OBJ(I,XRV) = 0,0,0
 4016 OBJ(I,XP) = (OFX(I)-OFX(PAR(I)))*10,(OFY(I)-OFY(PAR(I)))*10,(OFZ(I)-OFZ(PAR(I)))*10
 4017 OBJ(I,XR) = 0,0,0
 4018 OBJ(I,PARENT) = PAR(I)
 4020 OBJ(I,ORDER) = 2
 4050 NEXT
 4060 FOR J=1 TO FRMAX:R(3,1,J)=500:NEXT

 4100 GOTO *POSLOOP

 5030 NEXT
 5031 OBJ(2,XP) = BP(1,FRPOS),BP(2,FRPOS)+535.4331,BP(3,FRPOS)+15.748
 5040 LOCATE 1,1:PRINT CST$(PP2);
 5050 IF PP1 = 1 THEN COLOR 6 ELSE COLOR 7
 5051 IF PP2>1 AND PP2< 20 THEN LOCATE 15,1:PRINT R(1,PP2-1,FRPOS);"   ";
 5052 IF PP2=1 THEN LOCATE 15,1:PRINT BP(1,FRPOS);"   ";
 5053 IF PP2 > 19 THEN LOCATE 15,1:PRINT SCD$(1,PP2-19);
 5060 IF PP1 = 2 THEN COLOR 6 ELSE COLOR 7
 5061 IF PP2>1 AND PP2< 20 THEN LOCATE 22,1:PRINT R(2,PP2-1,FRPOS);"   ";
 5062 IF PP2=1 THEN LOCATE 22,1:PRINT BP(2,FRPOS);"   ";
 5063 IF PP2 > 19 THEN LOCATE 22,1:PRINT SCD$(2,PP2-19);
 5070 IF PP1 = 3 THEN COLOR 6 ELSE COLOR 7
 5071 IF PP2>1 AND PP2< 20 THEN LOCATE 29,1:PRINT R(3,PP2-1,FRPOS);"   ";
 5072 IF PP2=1 THEN LOCATE 29,1:PRINT BP(3,FRPOS);"   ";
 5073 IF PP2 > 19 THEN LOCATE 29,1:PRINT SCD$(3,PP2-19);
 5080 COLOR 7
 5081 LOCATE 1,2:PRINT USING "FR:### STEP:### VDIF:###",FRPOS,FT(FRPOS),VDIF;
 5100 RETURN
 6000 *GETPADV

 6017 IF (P AND 64) AND VDIF > 0 THEN VDIF = VDIF - 1
 6020 IF ((P AND 16384) = 16384) AND PP1 > 1 AND POFF = 0 THEN PP1 = PP1 -1 :POFF = 1
 6030 IF ((P AND 32768) = 32768) AND PP1 < 3 AND POFF = 0 THEN PP1 = PP1 +1 :POFF = 1
 6040 IF ((P AND 4096 ) =  4096) AND PP2 > 1 AND POFF = 0 THEN PP2 = PP2 -1 :POFF = 1
 6050 IF ((P AND 8192 ) =  8192) AND PP2 <23 AND POFF = 0 THEN PP2 = PP2 +1 :POFF = 1

 6110 IF (P AND   8) AND PP2>1 AND PP2<20 THEN R(PP1,PP2-1,FRPOS) = R(PP1,PP2-1,FRPOS)-VDIF

 6125 IF (P AND   8) AND PP2 = 1 THEN BP(PP1,FRPOS) = BP(PP1,FRPOS) - VDIF

 6151 IF (P AND 512) AND PP2=20 AND PP1=2 THEN GOSUB *FTIME
 6152 IF (P AND 512) AND PP2=20 AND PP1=3 THEN GOSUB *FNEXT
 6153 IF (P AND 512) AND PP2=21 AND PP1=1 THEN GOSUB *FINS
 6154 IF (P AND 512) AND PP2=21 AND PP1=2 THEN GOSUB *FCOPY
 6155 IF (P AND 512) AND PP2=21 AND PP1=3 THEN GOSUB *FDEL
 6156 IF (P AND 512) AND PP2=22 AND PP1=1 THEN GOSUB *FSAVE

 6158 IF (P AND 512) AND PP2=23 AND PP1=1 THEN GOSUB *FPLAY

 6454 IF (PAD(0,1) AND   8) AND CPFR>1 THEN CPFR=CPFR-1
 6460 FOR I=1 TO 18
 6461 OBJ(I,XR) = R(1,I,CPFR)/1000,R(2,I,CPFR)/1000,R(3,I,CPFR)/1000
 6462 NEXT
 6463 OBJ(2,XP) = BP(1,CPFR),BP(2,CPFR)+535.4331,BP(3,CPFR)+15.748
 6470 IF (PAD(0,1) AND 1024) THEN GOTO 6500
 6471 VSYNC 7:GOTO 6452
 6500 FOR I=1 TO 18
 6501  FOR CJ=1 TO 3
 6502  R(CJ,I,FRPOS)=R(CJ,I,CPFR)
 6503  NEXT
 6504 NEXT
 6510 FOR CJ=1 TO 3
 6511  BP(CJ,FRPOS)=BP(CJ,CPFR)

 6520 FT(FRPOS)=FT(CPFR)

 6600 *FSAVE
 6601 ON ERROR GOTO *SVERR

### P_DLPLAY.B: Doll animation player

**File:** `P_DLPLAY.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 43,820 bytes, 1,304 lines. 92 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:P_DLPLAY.B",R`.

Plays back motion data made with `P_DOLL.B` on the same polygon doll.

**Techniques:**

- Reading motion data with `FREAD` and playing it frame by frame on the jointed model

## 5. Sound and music

The interactive sound tutorial, the music players and the sound tests. The players are mostly MML data, so their listings here show the player code and leave out the long `DATA` blocks.

| Program | What it is |

### S_TUTOR.B: Sound tutorial

**File:** `S_TUTOR.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 285,682 bytes, 5,217 lines. 4,522 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_TUTOR.B",R`.

An interactive tutorial on GAME BASIC's sound system, all on screen: a 20-page glossary, the specification, the tone sets, and a seven-part MML tutorial with examples you can hear (notes, lengths, velocity, gate time, pitch bend, chords, tuplets, key signatures, repeats, rearranging tones with `TARG`, shaping them with `TPROP`, the DSP effector, FM synthesis, macros, chords and inversions). The Tutorial Manual points to it as the place to start with sound (TM pp. 83-84).

**Techniques:**

- Paged text screens with `KPRINT` and a key loop for next, back and top
- Playing MML from a program with `EFFECT`, `BGM`, `SETSONG` and `PLAY`
- Every sound command in use: `PLAYINIT`, `TARG`, `TPROP`, `DSP`, `MMLSTAT`

> All of its screen text has been translated, so the listing reads as an English sound tutorial. The text is split into many short `KPRINT` pieces in the original, so some lines read a little choppily.

```
LOAD"COM:DUMMY"
 1000 ' GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN Sound Sample Program Ver 1.1
 1001 ' [ S_TUTOR.B ] Sound features sample program
 1002 ' Programmed by Naozumi Honma (nao)
 1003 '
 1004 '
 1005 SCREEN 0:SKCLOSE:CLEAR 10,1360
 1006 IF PEEK(0,3)<>78 THEN KLOAD ON:CLEAR 10,1360:POKE 0,0,0:POKE 0,1,1:POKE 0,2,1:POKE 0,3,78:POKE 0,4,1
 1007 NUM_OF_MSTR=2:WIDTH 1,1,38,26:PLAYINIT
 1008 DIM MSTR$(NUM_OF_MSTR):DIM NAME$(128)
 1009 COLOR ,RGB(31,31,31):COLOROFS ON,0:COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255):VSYNC:OFS=255
 1010 IF PEEK(0,0)=56 THEN *S_MENU_1  :'After hearing the sound samples, go back to menu 4
 1011 '----------------------------
 1012 '●Main menu
 1013 '----------------------------
 1014 *MAIN_MENU
 1015 KPRINT (10,20,0,1,0)
 1016 KPRINT "  Sound features sample program",RGB(31,31,0)
 1017 KPRINT "=====================================",RGB(0,11,22)
 1018 KPRINT "1: Glossary"
 1019 KPRINT "2: Sound system specification"
 1020 KPRINT "3: About tone data"
 1021 KPRINT "4: Using MML and the sound commands"
 1022 KPRINT "5: Listen to the sound samples!"
 1023 KPRINT "0: Quit";:KPRINT "     [ IMPORTANT ]",RGB(31,22,22)
 1024 KPRINT "- If the Saturn's audio output is set to mono,",RGB(31,22,22)
 1025 KPRINT "  the pan-related commands have no effect.",RGB(31,22,22)
 1026 KPRINT (10,190),"       Choose a number.",,,RGB(0,16,16)
 1027 GOSUB *FADEIN
 1028 *MMLP
 1029 A$=INPUT$(1):IF A$=" " OR A$=CHR$(13) THEN *MMLP
 1030 IF A$="1" THEN GOSUB *FADEOUT:GOTO *YOUGO_1
 1031 IF A$="2" THEN GOSUB *FADEOUT:GOTO *SPEC_1
 1032 IF A$="3" THEN GOSUB *FADEOUT:OFS=255:GOTO *TONE_1
 1033 IF A$="4" THEN GOSUB *FADEOUT:GOTO *HOW_TO
 1034 IF A$="5" THEN GOSUB *FADEOUT:GOTO *S_MENU_1
 1035 IF A$="0" THEN SCREEN 0:PRINT "Loading LAUNCH.B":GOSUB *FADEOUT:LOAD"CD:LAUNCH",R
 1036 GOTO *MMLP
 1037 '
 1038 '----------------------------
 1039 '●Return the tones to the standard set
 1040 '----------------------------
 1041 *TONE_RESET
 1042 CLS:PRINT "Loading STANDARD Set...":PLAYINIT "STANDARD":CLS:TR_FLAG=1
 1043 RETURN
 1044 '
 1045 '------------------------------
 1046 *KEYIN
 1047 GOSUB *FADEIN
 1048 A$=INPUT$(1)
 1049 IF A$="0" OR A$=CHR$(13) OR A$=" " THEN GOSUB *FADEOUT
 1050 RETURN
 1051 '------------------------------
 1052 *FADEIN
 1053 IF OFS=0 THEN RETURN
 1054 FOR OFS=255 TO 0 STEP -32
 1055   COLOROFS(-OFS,-OFS,-OFS)
 1056   VSYNC
 1057 NEXT OFS
 1058 OFS=0
 1059 COLOROFS(0,0,0)
 1060 VSYNC
 1061 RETURN
 1062 '------------------------------
 1063 *FADEOUT
 1064 IF OFS=255 THEN RETURN
 1065 FOR OFS=0 TO 255 STEP 32
 1066   COLOROFS(-OFS,-OFS,-OFS)
 1067   VSYNC
 1068 NEXT OFS
 1069 OFS=255
 1070 COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255)
 1071 CLS 0
 1072 VSYNC
 1073 RETURN
 1074 '

 1675 KPRINT ""Up/Down" or "8 2"   "Left/Right" or "4 6"",RGB(10,27,27)
 1676 KPRINT (10,190),"             Back->Enter             ",,,RGB(0,16,16)
 1677 LINE(35,52)-(35+32*8,52+16*5),RGB(31,31,31),BF:LINE(0,136)-(319,152),RGB(11,11,11),BF
 1678 XX=0:FOR I=1 TO 7:LINE(35+32+XX,52)-(35+32+XX,52+16*5),RGB(0,0,0):XX=XX+32:NEXT
 1679 LINE(35+32*0+20,52)-(35+32*0+44,52+16*3),RGB(0,0,0),BF
 1680 LINE(35+32*1+20,52)-(35+32*1+44,52+16*3),RGB(0,0,0),BF
 1681 LINE(35+32*3+20,52)-(35+32*3+44,52+16*3),RGB(0,0,0),BF
 1682 LINE(35+32*4+20,52)-(35+32*4+44,52+16*3),RGB(0,0,0),BF
 1683 LINE(35+32*5+20,52)-(35+32*5+44,52+16*3),RGB(0,0,0),BF
 1684 LINE(35+32*7+20,52)-(35+32*7+44,52+16*3),RGB(0,0,0),BF
 1685 LOCATE 7,9 :COLOR 7:PRINT "S   D       G   H   J"
 1686 LOCATE 5,14:COLOR 1:PRINT "Z   X   C   V   B   N   M   ,":COLOR 7
 1687 LOCATE 25,2:COLOR 7:PRINT P$
 1688 GOSUB *FADEIN
 1689 *KIKU_LOOP_1
 1690 COLOR 5:LOCATE 2,16
 1691 PRINT USING "N=### ### ### ### ### ### ### ###";NOTE;NOTE+2;NOTE+4;NOTE+5;NOTE+7;NOTE+9;NOTE+11;NOTE+12
 1692 COLOR 6:LOCATE 6,19:PRINT USING "###";TONE:LOCATE 15,19:PRINT USING "###";TPROP(0,0,@TONE):LOCATE 34,19:PRINT OCTAVE
 1693 COLOR 7:LOCATE 2,17:PRINT NAME$(TONE)
 1694 *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1695 A$=INPUT$(1)
 1696 IF A$="Z" OR A$="z" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"C" :GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1697 IF A$="X" OR A$="x" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"D" :GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1698 IF A$="C" OR A$="c" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"E" :GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1699 IF A$="V" OR A$="v" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"F" :GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1700 IF A$="B" OR A$="b" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"G" :GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1701 IF A$="N" OR A$="n" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"A" :GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1702 IF A$="M" OR A$="m" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"B" :GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1703 IF A$=","           THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+">C":GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1704 IF A$="S" OR A$="s" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"C+":GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1705 IF A$="D" OR A$="d" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"D+":GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1706 IF A$="G" OR A$="g" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"F+":GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1707 IF A$="H" OR A$="h" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"G+":GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1708 IF A$="J" OR A$="j" THEN EFFECT "@"+STR$(TONE)+"O"+STR$(OCTAVE)+"A+":GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_2
 1709 IF A$="8" OR A$=CHR$(30) THEN TONE=TONE-1:IF TONE=-1 THEN TONE=TPROP(0,0,@TONE)
 1710 IF A$="2" OR A$=CHR$(31) THEN TONE=TONE+1:IF TONE=TPROP(0,0,@TONE)+1 THEN TONE=0
 1711 IF A$="4" OR A$=CHR$(29) THEN OCTAVE=OCTAVE-1:NOTE=NOTE-12:IF OCTAVE=-1 THEN OCTAVE=8:NOTE=108
 1712 IF A$="6" OR A$=CHR$(28) THEN OCTAVE=OCTAVE+1:NOTE=NOTE+12:IF OCTAVE=9  THEN OCTAVE=0:NOTE=12
 1713 IF A$=CHR$(13) THEN GOSUB *FADEOUT:CLS:GOSUB *FADEIN:COLOROFS OFF:COLOROFS ON,0:COLOR 7:OFS=255:COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255):CLS 0:VSYNC:RETURN
 1714 GOTO *KIKU_LOOP_1

 1719 *HOW_TO

 1722 KPRINT "-------------------------------------",RGB(0,11,22)
 1723 KPRINT "1: Compatibility with MSX MML         "
 1724 KPRINT "2: MML tutorial                  "
 1725 KPRINT "                                     "
 1726 KPRINT "                                     "
 1727 KPRINT "                                     "
 1728 KPRINT "           [ IMPORTANT ]               ",RGB(31,22,22)
 1729 KPRINT "- The tutorial really plays sounds",RGB(31,22,22)
 1730 KPRINT " so mind the volume.        ",RGB(31,22,22)
 1731 KPRINT (10,190),"Choose a number.   Back->Enter ",,,RGB(0,16,16)
 1732 GOSUB *FADEIN
 1733 *HTLP
 1734 A$=INPUT$(1)

 1737 IF A$="2" THEN GOSUB *FADEOUT:GOTO *M_TUTORIAL

 1741 *GOKAN_1
 1742 KPRINT (10,20,0,1,0)

 1744 KPRINT "- These commands are compatible with":KPRINT " MSX MML:"
 1745 COLOR ,RGB(26,26,26)
 1746 KPRINT " note names "";:KPRINT FIX "CDEFGAB";,RGB(31,31,20):KPRINT "", sharp/flat "";:KPRINT FIX "#+-";,RGB(31,31,20)
 1747 KPRINT "", ":KPRINT " volume "";:KPRINT FIX "V";,RGB(31,31,20):KPRINT "", octave "";:KPRINT FIX "<>O";,RGB(31,31,20)
 1748 KPRINT "", length "";:KPRINT FIX "L";,RGB(31,31,20):KPRINT "", "
 1749 KPRINT " tone change "";:KPRINT FIX "@";,RGB(31,31,20):KPRINT "", rest "";:KPRINT FIX "R";,RGB(31,31,20)
 1750 KPRINT "", tuplet "";:KPRINT FIX "{}";,RGB(31,31,20):KPRINT "", "
 1751 KPRINT " tie "";:KPRINT FIX "&";,RGB(31,31,20):KPRINT "", tempo "";:KPRINT FIX "T";,RGB(31,31,20):KPRINT """
 1752 COLOR ,RGB(31,31,31)
 1753 KPRINT "- The sharp/flat "";:KPRINT FIX "#+-";,RGB(31,31,20):KPRINT "" commands change meaning"
 1754 KPRINT " "";:KPRINT FIX "S";,RGB(31,31,20):KPRINT "" when the key signature is set."
 1755 KPRINT " (natural "";:KPRINT FIX "n";,RGB(31,31,20):KPRINT "" then has a meaning)"
 1756 KPRINT (10,190),"Next->Space   Back->Enter    TOP->0",,,RGB(0,16,16)
 1757 GOSUB *KEYIN
 1758 IF A$="0"      THEN *MAIN_MENU
 1759 IF A$=CHR$(13) THEN *HOW_TO
 1760 IF A$<>" "     THEN *GOKAN_1

 1766 COLOR ,RGB(26,26,26)

 1780 KPRINT "", "

 5701 '
 5702 '----------------------------
 5703 '●Listen to the sound samples!
 5704 '----------------------------
 5705 *S_MENU_1
 5706 '
 5707 '---------------- MENU DATA
 5708 *MENU_STR
 5709   DATA "  Listen to the sound samples!"
 5710   DATA "1: Classic Game Arts works - BGM collection"
 5711   DATA "2: Famous classical pieces"
 5712 '
 5713   GOSUB *INIT_SYS
 5714 '
 5715 '================ Main Loop
 5716 *PAD_WATCH
 5717   TRIGGA=0
 5718   *PAD_W2:IF TRIGGA THEN KEY$="":KEY=0:GOTO *PAD_TRIGGA
 5719     KEY$=INKEY$:IF KEY$="" THEN *PAD_W2 ELSE KEY=ASC(KEY$)
 5720   *PAD_TRIGGA
 5721     WTIME=0
 5722     IF KEY=KEY_DOWN  OR KEY=KEY_D2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_DOWN) THEN GOSUB *MOVE_DOWN:GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 5723     IF KEY=KEY_UP    OR KEY=KEY_U2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_UP)   THEN GOSUB *MOVE_UP:  GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 5724     IF KEY=KEY_ENTER OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_START OR @PAD_C))  THEN *PLAY_GO
 5725     IF KEY=KEY_ESC   OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_Y     OR @PAD_B))  THEN POKE 0,0,0:GOSUB *FADEOUT:GOTO *MAIN_MENU
 5726     GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 5727 '
 5728 '================
 5729 *MOVE_DOWN
 5730   IF CNUM < NUM_OF_MSTR THEN CNUM=CNUM+1
 5731   IF (CNUM > 4) AND (CNUM <= (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP+1
 5732   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 5733   RETURN
 5734 '
 5735 '----------------
 5736 *MOVE_UP
 5737   IF CNUM > 1 THEN CNUM=CNUM-1
 5738   IF (CNUM > 3) AND (CNUM < (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP-1
 5739   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 5740   RETURN
 5741 '
 5742 '----------------
 5743 *DISPLAY_MENU
 5744   KPRINT (10,20,0,1,0),MSTR$(0),,,RGB(20,0,20)    :'Title display
 5745   LINE(10,164)-(307,164),RGB(31,31,0):KPRINT (10,124),"  From here on, use the":KPRINT "  control pad."
 5746   KPRINT (10,166),"Up/Down";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX "(direction buttons)---";,RGB(21,21,10)
 5747   KPRINT FIX "Move Cursor",RGB(0,31,20)
 5748   KPRINT (10,182-8),FIX "  START / C button";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX " --- ";,RGB(21,21,10)
 5749   KPRINT FIX "LOAD & EXEC.",RGB(0,31,20)
 5750   KPRINT (10,198-16),FIX "          B button";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX " --- ";,RGB(21,21,10)
 5751   KPRINT FIX "RETURN Main Menu",RGB(0,31,20)
 5752   MDY=38
 5753   FOR I=MTOP TO MTOP+1
 5754     IF I=CNUM THEN
 5755       KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31),,RGB(0,20,20)
 5756     ELSE
 5757       KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31)
 5758     ENDIF
 5759     MDY=MDY+18
 5760   NEXT
 5761   RETURN
 5762 '
 5763 '================ Subroutines
 5764 *INIT_SYS
 5765   MTOP=1:CNUM=PEEK(0,1):EMNUM=-1
 5766   RESTORE *MENU_STR:FOR I=0 TO NUM_OF_MSTR:READ MSTR$(I):NEXT
 5767 '
 5768   PAD_ABCXYZSTART = @PAD_A+@PAD_B+@PAD_C+@PAD_START+@PAD_X+@PAD_Y+@PAD_Z
 5769   PAD_UDLR  = @PAD_RIGHT+@PAD_LEFT+@PAD_DOWN+@PAD_UP+@PAD_L+@PAD_R
 5770   KEY_DOWN  = 31:  KEY_D2=ASC("X")-64
 5771   KEY_UP    = 30:  KEY_U2=ASC("E")-64
 5772   KEY_ENTER = 13: KEY_ESC = 27
 5773 '
 5774   SCREEN 0:WIDTH 1,1,38,26:COLOR ,RGB(31,31,31):COLOROFS ON,0:COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255):VSYNC:OFS=255
 5775   INITIAL_TOUCH=20:AFTER_TOUCH=3
 5776   ON INTERVAL (0) GOSUB *INT_COUNT: INTERVAL (0) ON,1
 5777 *CLEAR_INKEY: IF INKEY$<>"" THEN *CLEAR_INKEY
 5778   TRIGGA=PAD(0,2) :' Clear trigga
 5779   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU:GOSUB *FADEIN
 5780   RETURN
 5781 '
 5782 '----------------
 5783 *INT_COUNT:' Make repeat trigga of PAD ULDR
 5784   IF PAD(0)=52 THEN *INT_COUNT_RET: 'Ignore keyboard pad
 5785   TRIGGA=TRIGGA OR (PAD(0,2) AND PAD_ABCXYZSTART): 'Update A,B,C,START buttons
 5786   TESTBTN=PAD(0,1):IF (TESTBTN AND PAD_UDLR) = 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=0: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET
 5787   IF TESTBTNL<>TESTBTN THEN TESTBTNL=TESTBTN: REPEAT_COUNT=0
 5788   IF REPEAT_COUNT=0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=INITIAL_TOUCH: TRIGGA=TESTBTN: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET
 5789   REPEAT_COUNT=REPEAT_COUNT-1: IF REPEAT_COUNT <= 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=AFTER_TOUCH: TRIGGA=TESTBTN
 5790 *INT_COUNT_RET
 5791   SKCLOSE
 5792   RETURN
 5793 '
 5794 '================ Start Sound Sample Program
 5795 *PLAY_GO:SCREEN 0:WIDTH 1,1,38,26
 5796   POKE 0,0,56:POKE 0,1,CNUM:POKE 0,2,1:POKE 0,4,1

### PLAYMIDI.B: MIDI to MML converter

**File:** `PLAYMIDI.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 30,021 bytes, 720 lines. 596 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:PLAYMIDI.B",R`.

Reads a standard MIDI file, converts its events to MML for up to 16 tracks, sets the tones, plays the result and can save it.

**Techniques:**

- Reading a binary file byte by byte with `FREAD`
- Parsing the MThd and MTrk chunks and variable-length delta times
- Building MML strings in `USERDATA` and playing them with `SETSONG`/`BGM`

```

 1060 'length : length
 1070 '         Note(0)     Exp(1)      Pan(2)  Pit(3)     Vol(4)  Prg(5)         Hold(6)
 1080 'param1 : note number   expression  pan     pitch bend  volume  program
 1090 'param2 : volume

 4100    N_CNT=N_CNT+1
 4110   ENDIF
 4120  ENDIF

 5560 'Read MThd
 5580 *READ_MTHD
 5590 ON ERROR GOTO *READ_MTHD_ERR:FREAD #2,A$,4:ON ERROR GOTO 0
 5600 IF A$<>"MThd" THEN RET=-1:RET$="Not a MIDI file":RETURN
 5610 GOSUB *M2M_READ4:IF RET#<>6 THEN RET=-1:RET$="Not a MIDI file":RETURN
 5620 GOSUB *M2M_READ2:MIDI_FORMAT=RET
 5630 GOSUB *M2M_READ2:MIDI_MAXTRACK=RET
 5640 GOSUB *M2M_READ2:MIDI_Q_NOTE=RET
 5650 RET=0
 5660 IF MIDI_FORMAT<>0 OR MIDI_MAXTRACK<>1 THEN RET=-1:RET$="This file can't be converted"
 5680 *READ_MTHD_EXIT:ON ERROR GOTO 0:RETURN
 5700 *READ_MTHD_ERR:RET=-1:RET$="An error occurred while reading":RESUME *READ_MTHD_EXIT
 5710 'Read MTrk
 5730 *READ_MTRK
 5740 ON ERROR GOTO *READ_MTRK_ERR:FREAD #2,A$,4:ON ERROR GOTO 0
 5750 IF A$<>"MTrk" THEN RET=-1:RET$="Not a MIDI file":RETURN
 5760 GOSUB *M2M_READ4:IF RET#<0 THEN RET=-1:RET$="The MIDI file is strange":RETURN
 5770 T#=500000#
 5780 NOW#=0
 5790 END_FLAG=0
 5810 *MTRK_LOOP00:IF END_FLAG<>0 THEN RET=0:RETURN
 5820 GOSUB *M2M_READDELTA:IF RET#<0 THEN RET=-1:RET$="The MIDI file is strange":RETURN
 5830 NOW#=NOW#+INT(RET#*T#/500000#)
 5840 GOSUB *GETC:IF RET<0 THEN RET$="The MIDI file is strange":RETURN
 5850 IF RET<&H80 THEN GOSUB *UNGETC:RET=RUNNING ELSE RUNNING=RET
 5860 IF RET=&HFF THEN GOSUB *METAEVENT:IF END_FLAG=0 THEN *MTRK_LOOP00 ELSE RET=0:RETURN
 5870 TEMP=RET AND &HF0
 5880 IF TEMP=&HF0 THEN GOSUB *F0:GOTO *MTRK_LOOP00
 5890 IF TEMP<>&HF0 THEN MIDI_CH=RET AND 15
 5900 IF TEMP=&H80 THEN GOSUB *VM_NOTE_OFF:GOTO *MTRK_LOOP00
 5910 IF TEMP=&H90 THEN GOSUB *VM_NOTE_ON:GOTO *MTRK_LOOP00
 5920 IF TEMP=&HA0 THEN GOSUB *VM_POLY_KEY_PRESS:GOTO *MTRK_LOOP00
 5930 IF TEMP=&HB0 THEN GOSUB *VM_CONTROL_CHANGE:GOTO *MTRK_LOOP00
 5940 IF TEMP=&HC0 THEN GOSUB *VM_PROGRAM_CHANGE:GOTO *MTRK_LOOP00
 5950 IF TEMP=&HD0 THEN GOSUB *VM_CHANNEL_PRESS :GOTO *MTRK_LOOP00
 5960 IF TEMP=&HE0 THEN GOSUB *VM_PITCH_WHEEL:GOTO *MTRK_LOOP00
 5980 *READ_MTRK_EXIT:ON ERROR GOTO 0:RETURN
 6000 *READ_MTRK_ERR:RET=-1:RET$="The MIDI file is strange":RESUME *READ_MTRK_EXIT
 6010 '
 6030 *VM_NOTE_OFF
 6040 GOSUB *GETC:MIDI_NOTE=RET
 6050 GOSUB *GETC
 6070 *VM_NOTO_OFF_
 6080 IF CNV_TRACK=MIDI_CH THEN
 6090  FOR K=ENV_CNT-1 TO 0 STEP -1
 6100   IF EVENT(K)=15 THEN
 6110    IF (PARAM1(K) AND 127)=MIDI_NOTE THEN
 6120     EVENT(K)=0
 6130     LENGTH#(K)=NOW#-DELTA#(K)
 6140     K=-1
 6150    ENDIF
 6160   ENDIF
 6170  NEXT
 6180 ENDIF
 6190 RETURN
 6200 '
 6220 *VM_NOTE_ON
 6230 GOSUB *GETC:P1=RET
 6240 GOSUB *GETC:P2=RET
 6250 IF P2=0 THEN MIDI_NOTE=P1:GOTO *VM_NOTO_OFF_
 6260 IF MIDI_CH=9 THEN DRUM_USE(P1)=1
 6270 EV=15:LE#=NOW#:GOSUB *PUT_EVENT
 6280 RETURN
 6300 *VM_POLY_KEY_PRESS
 6310 GOSUB *GETC
 6320 GOSUB *GETC
 6330 RETURN
 6350 *VM_CONTROL_CHANGE
 6360 GOSUB *GETC:M2M_FUNC=RET
 6370 GOSUB *GETC
 6380 IF DEBUG THEN COLOR 5:PRINT "Control Change (";M2M_FUNC;")=";RET:COLOR 7
 6390 IF M2M_FUNC=10 THEN
 6400  EV=2:P1=RET:GOSUB *PUT_EVENT
 6410  RETURN
 6420 ENDIF
 6430 IF M2M_FUNC=11 THEN
 6440  EV=1:P1=RET:GOSUB *PUT_EVENT
 6450  RETURN
 6460 ENDIF
 6470 IF M2M_FUNC=7 THEN
 6480  EV=4:P1=RET:GOSUB *PUT_EVENT
 6490  RETURN
 6500 ENDIF
 6510 IF M2M_FUNC=64 THEN
 6520  IF RET<>0 THEN RET=1
 6530  EV=6:P1=RET:GOSUB *PUT_EVENT
 6540  RETURN
 6550 ENDIF
 6560 RETURN
 6580 *VM_PROGRAM_CHANGE
 6590 GOSUB *GETC
 6600 IF DEBUG THEN COLOR 5:PRINT "Program Change :";RET+1:COLOR 7
 6610 IF NEIRO>0 THEN
 6620  FOR K=1 TO NEIRO
 6630   IF NEIROLIST(K)=NEIROSET(RET) AND NEIROLIST$(K)=NEIROSET$(RET) THEN P1=K:K=1000
 6640  NEXT
 6650  IF K>=1000 THEN EV=5:GOSUB *PUT_EVENT:RETURN
 6660 ENDIF
 6670 NEIRO=NEIRO+1
 6680 NEIROLIST(NEIRO)=NEIROSET(RET)
 6690 NEIROLIST$(NEIRO)=NEIROSET$(RET)
 6700 P1=NEIRO:EV=5:GOSUB *PUT_EVENT:RETURN
 6710 RETURN
 6730 *VM_CHANNEL_PRESS
 6740 GOSUB *GETC
 6750 IF DEBUG THEN COLOR 5:PRINT "Channel Pressure:";RET:COLOR 7
 6760 RETURN
 6780 *VM_PITCH_WHEEL
 6790 GOSUB *GETC:PW#=RET AND &H7F
 6800 GOSUB *GETC:PW#=PW#+(RET AND &H7F)*&H80
 6810 IF DEBUG THEN COLOR 5:PRINT "Pitch Wheel:";P1:COLOR 7
 6820 P1=INT(PW#/&H4000*128)
 6830 EV=3:GOSUB *PUT_EVENT
 6840 RETURN
 6860 *F0
 6870 IF RET=&HF0 OR RET=&HF7 THEN
 6880   GOSUB *GETC:IF RET>0 THEN FOR I=1 TO RET:GOSUB *GETC:NEXT
 6890 ENDIF
 6900 RETURN
 6910 'Meta event
 6930 *METAEVENT:GOSUB *GETC
 6940 IF RET=&H2F THEN END_FLAG=1
 6950 IF RET=&H51 THEN
 6960  GOSUB *GETC
 6970  GOSUB *GETC:T#=RET*65535
 6980  GOSUB *GETC:T#=T#+RET*256
 6990  GOSUB *GETC:T#=T#+RET
 7000  RETURN
 7010 ENDIF
 7020 GOSUB *GETC:IF RET>0 THEN FOR I=1 TO RET:GOSUB *GETC:NEXT
 7030 RETURN
 7040 'Initialisation
 7060 *INIT
 7070 DIM EVENT(MAX_EVENT),DELTA#(MAX_EVENT),LENGTH#(MAX_EVENT),PARAM1(MAX_EVENT)
 7080 DIM MML$(15),ENV_COUNT(15)
 7090 DIM NEIROSET(127),NEIROSET$(127)
 7100 DIM NEIROLIST(127),NEIROLIST$(127)
 7110 DIM DRUM_USE(127)
 7120 FOR I=0 TO 127:READ NEIROSET$(I),NEIROSET(I):NEXT
 7140 *PUT_EVENT
 7150 IF CNV_TRACK=0 THEN ENV_COUNT(MIDI_CH)=ENV_COUNT(MIDI_CH)+1
 7160 IF MIDI_CH=CNV_TRACK THEN
 7170  IF ENV_CNT>=MAX_EVENT THEN COLOR 2:PRINT "Data overflow!!":COLOR 7:END_FLAG=1:RETURN
 7180  EVENT(ENV_CNT)=EV
 7190  LENGTH#(ENV_CNT)=LE#
 7200  DELTA#(ENV_CNT)=NOW#
 7210  PARAM1(ENV_CNT)=P1+P2*128
 7220  ENV_CNT=ENV_CNT+1
 7230 ENDIF
 7240 RETURN
 7250 'File OPEN
 7270 *FILEOPEN:RET=0:ON ERROR GOTO *FILEOPEN_ERR:OPEN FILENAME$ FOR INPUT AS #2
 7290 *FILEOPEN_EXIT:ON ERROR GOTO 0:RETURN
 7310 *FILEOPEN_ERR:RET=ERR:RET$="File OPEN failed":RESUME *FILEOPEN_EXIT
 7320 'File CLOSE
 7340 *FILECLOSE:RET=0:ON ERROR GOTO *FILECLOSE_ERR:CLOSE
 7360 *FILECLOSE_EXIT:ON ERROR GOTO 0:RETURN
 7380 *FILECLOSE_ERR:RET=ERR:RET$="File CLOSE failed":RESUME *FILECLOSE_EXIT
 7390 'Get 1 character
 7410 *GETC:IF F_UNGET THEN F_UNGET=(0<>0):RET=F_UNGET_VAL:RETURN
 7420 ON ERROR GOTO *GETC_ERR:FREAD #2,F$,1:ON ERROR GOTO 0:RET=ASC(F$)
 7440 *GETC_EXIT:RETURN
 7460 *GETC_ERR:RET=-1:RESUME *GETC_EXIT
 7470 'Put back 1 character
 7490 *UNGETC:F_UNGET=(0=0):F_UNGET_VAL=RET:RETURN
 7500 '4bytes Read
 7510 'The top byte is ignored
 7530 *M2M_READ4:ON ERROR GOTO *M2M_READ4_ERR:FREAD #2,F$,4:ON ERROR GOTO 0
 7540 RET#=ASC(MID$(F$,2,1))*&H10000+ASC(MID$(F$,3,1))*&H100+ASC(MID$(F$,4,1))
 7560 *M2M_READ4_EXIT:RETURN
 7580 *M2M_READ4_ERR:RET#=-1:RESUME *M2M_READ4_EXIT
 7590 '2bytes Read
 7610 *M2M_READ2:ON ERROR GOTO *M2M_READ2_ERR:FREAD #2,F$,2:ON ERROR GOTO 0
 7620 RET=ASC(MID$(F$,1,1))*&H100+ASC(MID$(F$,2,1))
 7640 *M2M_READ2_EXIT:RETURN
 7660 *M2M_READ2_ERR:RET=-1:RESUME *M2M_READ2_EXIT
 7670 ' Read the DELTA time
 7690 *M2M_READDELTA
 7700 GOSUB *GETC:RET#=RET:IF RET<0 THEN RETURN
 7710 IF RET AND &H80 THEN
 7720  RET#=RET# AND &H7F
 7740 *SYS_RVLOP00:GOSUB *GETC:IF RET<0 THEN RET#=-1:RETURN
 7750  RET#=RET#*&H80+(RET AND &H7F):IF RET AND &H80 GOTO *SYS_RVLOP00
 7760 ENDIF
 7770 RETURN
 7780 DATA "STANDARD",36:'1
 7790 DATA "ORCHEST" ,32:'2
 7800 DATA "ORCHEST" ,32:'3
      ' ... 124 DATA lines not shown (lines 7810-9040) ...
 9050 DATA "EXTRA1"  ,12:'128

### S_AIFF.B: PCM test with AIFF files

**File:** `S_AIFF.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 543 bytes, 17 lines. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_AIFF.B",R`.

Loads three AIFF samples from the CD as instruments with `TARG READ` and plays each one when you press a key.

**Techniques:**

- Using your own sampled sounds: `DATA` lines that name the AIFF files
- `EFFECT "@1 %1 C"`: the damper switch keeps a looping sample sounding

**Files it uses:** `BEAT_A.D`, `SAMPLE_A.D`, `WAVE1_A.D`

```
LOAD"COM:D"
 1000 ' [ S_AIFF.B ]
 1001 CLEAR 200,1360:CLS:PRINT "TARG ...AIFF file"
 1002 PLAYINIT:TARG READ:CLS
 1003 PRINT "BEAT_A.D (Press any key)":A$=INPUT$(1)
 1004 EFFECT "@1 %1 C"
 1005 PRINT "SAMPLE_A.D (Press any key)":A$=INPUT$(1)
 1006 EFFECT "@2 %1 C"
 1007 PRINT "WAVE1_A.D  (Press any key)":A$=INPUT$(1)
 1008 EFFECT "@3 %1 C"
 1009 END
 1010 '
 1011 DATA FILE, "CD:BEAT_A", 0, 0, 0, 127, 78
 1012 DATA FILE, "CD:SAMPLE_A", 0, 0, 0, 127, 78
 1013 DATA FILE, "CD:WAVE1_A", 0, 0, 0, 127, 78
 1014 DATA ENDARRANGE

```

### S_FM_TA.B: FM synthesis test

**File:** `S_FM_TA.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 958 bytes, 26 lines. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_FM_TA.B",R`.

Plays a short phrase with each of the 47 FM modulation waveforms and several `ml2` (multiple) values, rebuilding the FM tone with `TARG READ` each time.

**Techniques:**

- Building an FM tone definition (`BUILDLAYER` ... `ENDLAYER`) as strings in `USERDATA`, then loading it with `TARG READ`
- Changing one FM parameter at a time in a loop to hear its effect

```
LOAD"COM:DUMMY"
 1000 SCREEN 0: SKCLOSE :'Initialize screen, Close software keyboard
 1002 '
 1003 'Programed by BITS NAO.Honma
 1004 '
 1005 CLEAR 100,1360:CLS
 1006 PLAYINIT
 1007 FOR I=1 TO 47
 1008   FOR J=0 TO 4
 1009     LOCATE 10,10:PRINT "Wave Form = ";I
 1010     LOCATE 10,11:PRINT "      ml2 = ";J
 1011     USERDATA 0,0,"BUILDLAYER"
 1012     USERDATA     "FM"
 1013     USERDATA     "1",0                                        :'OP#
 1014     USERDATA     STR$(I),0                                    :'W
 1015     USERDATA     "1,1, 0, 7, 31,  0,  0, 31,  0,  0, 24",0    :'X,Y, M, S, AR, DR, SR, RR, SL, TL, ml1
 1016     USERDATA     STR$(J),0                                    :'ml2
 1017     USERDATA     "0,0",0                                      :'dt,KS
 1018     USERDATA     "ENDLAYER"
 1019     USERDATA     "ENDARRANGE"
 1020     TARG READ
 1021     PLAY "@1 O4 L8 CDE"
 1022   NEXT
 1023 NEXT
 1024 END

```

### S_GM_FM1.B: FM General MIDI set 1

**File:** `S_GM_FM1.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 50,719 bytes, 1,038 lines. 19 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_GM_FM1.B",R`.

Builds a full 128-instrument FM set laid out in General MIDI order with `TARG READ`, then plays every instrument in turn. The `DATA` holds the FM parameters for each instrument, one `BUILDLAYER` block per instrument.

**Techniques:**

- A complete FM instrument library in `DATA`: copy the blocks you like into your own programs

```
LOAD "COM:DD"
 1000 '
 1001 'Programed by Kenichi Kunishima
 1002 '
 1003 CLEAR,1360
 1004 PLAYINIT
 1005 TARG READ 52,0
 1006 FOR I=0 TO 127
 1007   LOCATE 10,10:PRINT "NUM =";I
 1008   PLAY "@"+STR$(I)+" L32 V15 O1 CEDG>CEDG>CEDG>CEDG>CEDG>CEDG(<<<<C2>>D2E2G2>>>C2) R4"
 1009 NEXT I
 1010 END
 1011 '   0:Acoustic Grand Piano
 1012 DATA "BUILDLAYER"
 1013 '     FM, OP,W,X,Y, M,S,AR,DR,SR,RR,SL, TL,ml1,ml2,dt,KS
 1014 DATA "FM", 1,1,1,1, 8,0,20, 2, 1, 6, 4, 55, 12,2,  -9, 1
 1015 DATA "FM", 2,1,1,1,10,5,18, 9, 4,14, 4,  0, 12,2,  -9, 1
      ' ... 765 DATA lines and 254 comment lines not shown (lines 1016-2034) ...
 2035 DATA "ENDARRANGE"

```

### S_CLASSI.B: Classical music menu

**File:** `S_CLASSI.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 6,595 bytes, 153 lines. 150 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_CLASSI.B",R`.

A menu of six classical pieces. Choosing one loads and runs its player program, which returns here when you press a key.

**Techniques:**

- A menu with fade in and out (`COLOROFS` under `ON INTERVAL`)
- Remembering the menu position across programs with `POKE`/`PEEK` in user memory
- Chaining with `LOAD "CD:...",R`

```
LOAD"COM:DUMMY"
 1000 ' GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN Sound Sample Program Ver 1.1
 1001 ' [ S_CLASSI.B ]
 1002 ' Programmed by Naozumi Honma (nao)
 1003 '               Kanayama Motoyuki (motos)
 1004 '
 1005 '
 1006   SCREEN 0: SKCLOSE         :'Initialize screen, Close software keyboard
 1007   CLEAR 10,1360:IF PEEK(0,3)<>78 THEN KLOAD ON:CLEAR 10,1360:POKE 0,0,56:POKE 0,1,2:POKE 0,2,1:POKE 0,3,78:POKE 0,4,1
 1008   WIDTH 1,1,38,26:COLOR ,RGB(31,31,31):COLOROFS ON,0:COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255):VSYNC:OFS=255
 1009 '
 1010   NUM_OF_MSTR=6                 :'<<< number of MENU items >>>
 1011   PROG$="***** Sound System Programed by Naozumi Honma (nao) / Bits Laboratory ***** BASIC Main System Programed by Motoyuki Kanayama (motos) / Bits Laboratory *****"
 1012   Q$=SPACE$(40)+PROG$+SPACE$(300):QCUT=1
 1013   GOTO *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1014 '
 1015 '---------------- MENU DATA
 1016 *MENU_STR
 1017   DATA "Famous classical pieces"
 1018   DATA "1:Air on the G String/J.S.Bach : Pipe Organ"
 1019   DATA "2:Air on the G String          : Strings"
      ' ... 3 DATA lines not shown (lines 1020-1022) ...
 1023   DATA "6:Pachelbel's Canon /J.Pachelbel"
 1025 '
 1026 '---------------- Exit Program
 1027 *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1028   OBJ CLEAR:GOSUB *FADEOUT:INTERVAL (0) OFF:INTERVAL (1) OFF:SCREEN 0:LOCATE 5,0:COLOR 7:PRINT "Loading S_TUTOR.B" :LOAD"CD:S_TUTOR",R
 1029   END
 1030 '
 1031 '---------------- Start Program
 1032 *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1033   GOSUB *INIT_SYS
 1034 '
 1035 '================ Main Loop
 1036 *PAD_WATCH
 1037   TRIGGA=0
 1038   *PAD_W2:IF TRIGGA THEN KEY$="":KEY=0:GOTO *PAD_TRIGGA
 1039     KEY$=INKEY$:IF KEY$="" THEN *PAD_W2 ELSE KEY=ASC(KEY$)
 1040   *PAD_TRIGGA
 1041     WTIME=0
 1042     IF KEY=KEY_DOWN  OR KEY=KEY_D2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_DOWN) THEN GOSUB *MOVE_DOWN:GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1043     IF KEY=KEY_UP    OR KEY=KEY_U2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_UP)   THEN GOSUB *MOVE_UP:  GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1044     IF KEY=KEY_ENTER OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_START OR @PAD_C))  THEN *PLAY_GO
 1045     IF KEY=KEY_ESC   OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_Y     OR @PAD_B))  THEN *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1046     GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1047 '
 1048 '================
 1049 *MOVE_DOWN
 1050   IF CNUM < NUM_OF_MSTR THEN CNUM=CNUM+1
 1051   IF (CNUM > 4) AND (CNUM <= (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP+1
 1052   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1053   RETURN
 1054 '
 1055 '----------------
 1056 *MOVE_UP
 1057   IF CNUM > 1 THEN CNUM=CNUM-1
 1058   IF (CNUM > 3) AND (CNUM < (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP-1
 1059   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1060   RETURN
 1061 '
 1062 '----------------
 1063 *DISPLAY_MENU
 1064   KPRINT (10,20),MSTR$(0),,,RGB(20,0,20)    :'Title display
 1065   LINE(10,164)-(307,164),RGB(31,31,0)
 1066   KPRINT (10,166),"Up/Down";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX "(direction buttons)---";,RGB(21,21,10):KPRINT FIX "Move Cursor",RGB(0,31,20)
 1067   KPRINT (10,182-8),FIX "  START / C button";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX " --- ";,RGB(21,21,10):KPRINT FIX "LOAD & EXEC.",RGB(0,31,20)
 1068   KPRINT (10,198-16),FIX "          B button";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX " --- ";,RGB(21,21,10):KPRINT FIX "RETURN Main Menu",RGB(0,31,20)
 1069   MDY=38
 1070   FOR I=MTOP TO MTOP+6 -1
 1071     IF I=CNUM THEN
 1072       KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31),,RGB(0,20,20)
 1073     ELSE
 1074       KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31)
 1075     ENDIF
 1076     MDY=MDY+18
 1077   NEXT
 1078   RETURN
 1079 '
 1080 '================ Subroutines
 1081 *INIT_SYS
 1082   MTOP=PEEK(0,4):CNUM=PEEK(0,2):EMNUM=-1
 1083   DIM MSTR$(NUM_OF_MSTR)
 1084   RESTORE *MENU_STR:FOR I=0 TO NUM_OF_MSTR:READ MSTR$(I):NEXT
 1085 '
 1086   PAD_ABCXYZSTART = @PAD_A+@PAD_B+@PAD_C+@PAD_START+@PAD_X+@PAD_Y+@PAD_Z
 1087   PAD_UDLR  = @PAD_RIGHT+@PAD_LEFT+@PAD_DOWN+@PAD_UP+@PAD_L+@PAD_R
 1088   KEY_DOWN  = 31:  KEY_D2=ASC("X")-64
 1089   KEY_UP    = 30:  KEY_U2=ASC("E")-64
 1090   KEY_ENTER = 13: KEY_ESC = 27
 1091 '
 1092   SCREEN 0:WIDTH 1,1,38,26
 1093   INITIAL_TOUCH=20:AFTER_TOUCH=3
 1094   ON INTERVAL (0) GOSUB *INT_COUNT: INTERVAL (0) ON,1
 1095   ON INTERVAL (1) GOSUB *DISP_COPYRIGHT: INTERVAL (1) ON,1
 1096 *CLEAR_INKEY: IF INKEY$<>"" THEN *CLEAR_INKEY
 1097   TRIGGA=PAD(0,2) :' Clear trigga
 1098   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU:GOSUB *FADEIN
 1099   RETURN
 1100 '
 1101 '----------------
 1102 *INT_COUNT:' Make repeat trigga of PAD ULDR
 1103   IF PAD(0)=52 THEN *INT_COUNT_RET: 'Ignore keyboard pad
 1104   TRIGGA=TRIGGA OR (PAD(0,2) AND PAD_ABCXYZSTART): 'Update A,B,C,START buttons
 1105   TESTBTN=PAD(0,1):IF (TESTBTN AND PAD_UDLR) = 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=0: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET
 1106   IF TESTBTNL<>TESTBTN THEN TESTBTNL=TESTBTN: REPEAT_COUNT=0
 1107   IF REPEAT_COUNT=0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=INITIAL_TOUCH: TRIGGA=TESTBTN: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET
 1108   REPEAT_COUNT=REPEAT_COUNT-1: IF REPEAT_COUNT <= 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=AFTER_TOUCH: TRIGGA=TESTBTN
 1109 *INT_COUNT_RET
 1110   SKCLOSE
 1111   RETURN
 1112 '
 1113 '---------------- SCREEN Fade Out
 1114 *FADEOUT
 1115   COLOROFS ON,0:IF OFS=255 THEN RETURN
 1116   FOR OFS=0 TO 255 STEP 32
 1117     COLOROFS(-OFS,-OFS,-OFS)
 1118     VSYNC
 1119   NEXT OFS
 1120   OFS=255
 1121   COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255)
 1122   CLS 0
 1123   VSYNC
 1124   RETURN
 1125 '
 1126 '================ Start Sound Sample Program
 1127 *PLAY_GO:INTERVAL (0) OFF:INTERVAL (1) OFF:SCREEN 0:WIDTH 1,1,38,26:POKE 0,2,CNUM:POKE 0,4,MTOP
 1128 IF CNUM=1 THEN PRINT "Loading S_ARIA_P.B":GOSUB *FADEOUT:LOAD"CD:S_ARIA_P",R
 1129 IF CNUM=2 THEN PRINT "Loading S_ARIA.B"  :GOSUB *FADEOUT:LOAD"CD:S_ARIA",R
 1130 IF CNUM=3 THEN PRINT "Loading S_POLONA.B":GOSUB *FADEOUT:LOAD"CD:S_POLONA",R
 1131 IF CNUM=4 THEN PRINT "Loading S_MARIA.B" :GOSUB *FADEOUT:LOAD"CD:S_MARIA",R
 1132 IF CNUM=5 THEN PRINT "Loading S_FUGA.B"  :GOSUB *FADEOUT:LOAD"CD:S_FUGA",R
 1133 IF CNUM=6 THEN PRINT "Loading S_KANON.B" :GOSUB *FADEOUT:LOAD"CD:S_KANON",R
 1134 GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU:GOSUB *FADEIN:GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1135 '------------------------------
 1136 *FADEIN
 1137 FOR OFS=255 TO 0 STEP -32
 1138   COLOROFS(-OFS,-OFS,-OFS)
 1139   VSYNC
 1140 NEXT OFS
 1141 COLOROFS(0,0,0)
 1142 VSYNC
 1143 RETURN
 1144 '---------------- Copyright display
 1145 *DISP_COPYRIGHT
 1146   DC_TIME=DC_TIME+1
 1147   IF (DC_TIME AND &HF) <> 0 THEN RETURN
 1148   LOCATE 0,25:COLOR 4:PRINT MID$(Q$,QCUT,37);
 1149   QCUT=QCUT+1:DC_TIME=0
 1150   IF (QCUT=(LEN(PROG$)+100)) THEN QCUT=1
 1151   RETURN


### S_ARIA.B: Air on the G String (strings)

**File:** `S_ARIA.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 2,804 bytes, 56 lines. 15 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_ARIA.B",R`.

Bach's *Air on the G String* played with the orchestral strings set.

**Techniques:**

- The shortest complete music player: `PLAYINIT "DSP","ORCHEST"`, `SETSONG`, `BGM`
- Returning to the menu program

```
LOAD"COM:D"
 1000 SCREEN 0: SKCLOSE :'Initialize screen, Close software keyboard

 1005 PLAYINIT "DSP","ORCHEST"
 1006 SETSONG
 1007 BGM :VSYNC 2:PLAYTEMPO 0,-900
 1008 PRINT:PRINT " --- S_AREA.B ---":PRINT:PRINT " PRESS ANY KEY -> MAIN MENU"

      ' ... 41 DATA lines not shown (lines 1013-1053) ...



### S_G_ARTS.B: Game Arts music menu

- A two-level menu and information pages with `KPRINT`

### S_SILPH.B: Silpheed music

**File:** `S_SILPH.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 165,249 bytes, 4,815 lines. 336 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_SILPH.B",R`.

Tunes from *Silpheed* (Game Arts), in versions close to the original and new arrangements. Shares its player code with the other Game Arts players.

**Techniques:**

- A menu of tracks driven by the pad
- Rearranging tones with `TARG` and adjusting them with `TPROP`
- `PLAYFADE` to fade out

```
LOAD"COM:D"
 1000 ' GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN Sound Sample Program Ver 1.1
 1001 ' [ S_SILPH.B ]
 1002 ' Programmed by Naozumi Honma (nao)
 1003 '               Kanayama Motoyuki (motos)
 1004 '               Yukihiro Ninagawa
 1005 '
 1006   SCREEN 0: SKCLOSE         :'Initialize screen, Close software keyboard
 1007   CLEAR 10,1360:IF PEEK(0,3)<>78 THEN KLOAD ON:CLEAR 10,1360:POKE 0,0,56:POKE 0,1,1:POKE 0,2,10:POKE 0,3,78:POKE 0,4,7:POKE 0,5,1
 1008   WIDTH 1,1,38,26:PLAYINIT:COLOR ,RGB(31,31,31):COLOROFS ON,0:COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255):VSYNC:OFS=255
 1009 '

 1012   PROG$="***** MUSIC COMPOSER : Masakuni Mitsuhashi / Hibiki Godai / MECANO ASSOCIATES ***** Score Arrange & MML Programed by Yukihiro Ninagawa ***** Sound System Programed by Naozumi Honma (nao) / Bits Laboratory *****"
 1013   PROG$=PROG$+" BASIC Main System Programed by Motoyuki Kanayama (motos) / Bits Laboratory ***** Special Thanks - Kenichi Kunishima, Tomoyuki Shimada, Yukihiro Yoshida *****"
 1014   Q$=SPACE$(40)+PROG$+SPACE$(300):QCUT=1
 1015   GOTO *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1016 '
 1017 '---------------- MENU DATA

 1019   DATA " Silpheed               (C)GAME ARTS"

 1021   DATA " 2: Silph of wind       /Hibiki Godai"
      ' ... 19 DATA lines not shown (lines 1022-1040) ...
 1041   DATA "22: Little moments peace   (Original)"
 1042 '
 1043 '---------------- Exit Program
 1044 *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1045   GOSUB *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:OBJ CLEAR:GOSUB *FADEOUT:INTERVAL (0) OFF:INTERVAL (1) OFF:SCREEN 0:LOCATE 5,0:COLOR 7:PRINT "Loading S_G_ARTS.B":LOAD"CD:S_G_ARTS",R
 1046   END
 1047 '
 1048 '---------------- Start Program
 1049 *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1050   GOSUB *INIT_SYS
 1051   GOSUB *SET_OBJECTS
 1052 '
 1053 '================ Main Loop
 1054 *PAD_WATCH
 1055   TRIGGA=0
 1056   *PAD_W2:IF TRIGGA THEN KEY$="":KEY=0:GOTO *PAD_TRIGGA
 1057     IF PLAYSTAT(0)=0 THEN EMNUM=-1:GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1058     KEY$=INKEY$:IF KEY$="" THEN *PAD_W2 ELSE KEY=ASC(KEY$)
 1059   *PAD_TRIGGA
 1060     WTIME=0
 1061     IF KEY=KEY_DOWN  OR KEY=KEY_D2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_DOWN) THEN GOSUB *MOVE_DOWN:GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1062     IF KEY=KEY_UP    OR KEY=KEY_U2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_UP)   THEN GOSUB *MOVE_UP:  GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1063     IF KEY=KEY_ENTER OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_START OR @PAD_C))  THEN IF EMNUM=CNUM THEN BGM:GOTO *PAD_WATCH ELSE EMNUM=CNUM:GOSUB *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:GOTO *PLAY_GO
 1064     IF KEY=KEY_ESC   OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_Y     OR @PAD_B))  THEN *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1065     GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1066 '
 1067 '================
 1068 *MOVE_DOWN
 1069   IF CNUM < NUM_OF_MSTR THEN CNUM=CNUM+1
 1070   IF (CNUM > 4) AND (CNUM <= (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP+1
 1071   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1072   RETURN
 1073 '
 1074 '----------------
 1075 *MOVE_UP
 1076   IF CNUM > 1 THEN CNUM=CNUM-1
 1077   IF (CNUM > 3) AND (CNUM < (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP-1
 1078   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1079   RETURN
 1080 '
 1081 '----------------
 1082 *DISPLAY_MENU
 1083   MDY=38
 1084   FOR I=MTOP TO MTOP+6
 1085     IF I=CNUM THEN
 1086       IF I=EMNUM THEN
 1087         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31),,RGB(20,20,0)
 1088       ELSE
 1089         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31),,RGB(0,20,20)
 1090       ENDIF
 1091     ELSE
 1092       IF I=EMNUM THEN
 1093         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,0),,RGB(16,16,16)
 1094       ELSE
 1095         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31)
 1096       ENDIF
 1097     ENDIF
 1098     MDY=MDY+18
 1099   NEXT
 1100   RETURN
 1101 '
 1102 '================ Subroutines
 1103 *INIT_SYS
 1104   MTOP=1:EMNUM=-1
 1105   DIM MSTR$(NUM_OF_MSTR)
 1106   RESTORE *MENU_STR:FOR I=0 TO NUM_OF_MSTR:READ MSTR$(I):NEXT
 1107 '
 1108   PAD_ABCXYZSTART = @PAD_A+@PAD_B+@PAD_C+@PAD_START+@PAD_X+@PAD_Y+@PAD_Z
 1109   PAD_UDLR  = @PAD_RIGHT+@PAD_LEFT+@PAD_DOWN+@PAD_UP+@PAD_L+@PAD_R

 1111   KEY_UP    = 30:  KEY_U2=ASC("E")-64

 1114   SCREEN 0:WIDTH 1,1,38,26

 1118 *CLEAR_INKEY: IF INKEY$<>"" THEN *CLEAR_INKEY
 1119   TRIGGA=PAD(0,2) :' Clear trigga

 1121   LINE(10,164)-(307,164),RGB(31,31,0)

 1123   KPRINT (10,182-8),FIX "  START / C button";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX " --- ";,RGB(21,21,10):KPRINT FIX "Start BGM  ",RGB(0,31,20)
 1124   KPRINT (10,198-16),FIX "          B button";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX " --- ";,RGB(21,21,10):KPRINT FIX "RETURN Main Menu",RGB(0,31,20)
 1125   CNUM=-1:GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU:CNUM=1

 1129 '----------------
 1130 *INT_COUNT:' Make repeat trigga of PAD ULDR
 1131   IF PAD(0)=52 THEN *INT_COUNT_RET: 'Ignore keyboard pad

 1133   TESTBTN=PAD(0,1):IF (TESTBTN AND PAD_UDLR) = 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=0: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET
 1134   IF TESTBTNL<>TESTBTN THEN TESTBTNL=TESTBTN: REPEAT_COUNT=0
 1135   IF REPEAT_COUNT=0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=INITIAL_TOUCH: TRIGGA=TESTBTN: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET
 1136   REPEAT_COUNT=REPEAT_COUNT-1: IF REPEAT_COUNT <= 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=AFTER_TOUCH: TRIGGA=TESTBTN
 1137 *INT_COUNT_RET
 1138   SKCLOSE
 1139   RETURN

 1143 'Object Item Number

 1152   OBJ(0,XP+2)=110

 1157   SLEN=LEN(PFONT$): PT=-SLEN/2*45 : ND=RND(255)/255:OBJ(1,XP+2)=90+SLEN*10
 1158   FOR SP=1 TO SLEN

### S_ZELIAR.B: Zeliard music

**File:** `S_ZELIAR.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 162,484 bytes, 3,568 lines. 281 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_ZELIAR.B",R`.

Tunes from *Zeliard*. The PC-88 MML was ported as it was, using only the standard tone sets rearranged, no FM.

**Techniques:**

- As `S_SILPH.B`

```
LOAD"COM:D"
 1000 ' GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN Sound Sample Program Ver 1.1
 1001 ' [ S_ZELIAR.B ]
 1002 ' Programmed by Naozumi Honma (nao)
 1003 '               Kanayama Motoyuki (motos)
 1004 '               Yukihiro Ninagawa
 1005 '
 1006   SCREEN 0: SKCLOSE         :'Initialize screen, Close software keyboard
 1007   CLEAR 10,1360:IF PEEK(0,3)<>78 THEN KLOAD ON:CLEAR 10,1360:POKE 0,0,56:POKE 0,1,1:POKE 0,2,11:POKE 0,3,78:POKE 0,4,8:POKE 0,5,1
 1008   WIDTH 1,1,38,26:PLAYINIT:COLOR ,RGB(31,31,31):COLOROFS ON,0:COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255):VSYNC:OFS=255
 1009 '
 1010   TITLE$="ZELIARD"   :'<<< Polygon Title   >>>
 1011   NUM_OF_MSTR=17     :'<<< number of MENU items >>>
 1012   PROG$="***** MUSIC COMPOSER : MECANO ASSOCIATES ***** MML Programed by Yukihiro Ninagawa ***** Sound System Programed by Naozumi Honma (nao) / Bits Laboratory ***** BASIC Main System Programed by Motoyuki Kanayama (motos)"
 1013   PROG$=PROG$+" / Bits Laboratory ***** Special Thanks - Kenichi Kunishima, Masakuni Mitsuhashi, Tomoyuki Shimada, Yukihiro Yoshida *****"
 1014   Q$=SPACE$(40)+PROG$+SPACE$(300):QCUT=1
 1015   GOTO *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1016 '
 1017 '---------------- MENU DATA
 1018 *MENU_STR
 1019   DATA " Zeliard                (C)GAME ARTS"
 1020   DATA " 1: Opening"
 1021   DATA " 2: Town above ground, part 1"
      ' ... 14 DATA lines not shown (lines 1022-1035) ...
 1036   DATA "17: Ending"
 1037 '
 1038 '---------------- Exit Program
 1039 *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1040   GOSUB *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:OBJ CLEAR:GOSUB *FADEOUT:INTERVAL OFF:SCREEN 0:LOCATE 5,0:COLOR 7:PRINT "Loading S_G_ARTS.B":LOAD"CD:S_G_ARTS",R
 1041   END
 1042 '
 1043 '---------------- Start Program
 1044 *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1045   GOSUB *INIT_SYS
 1046   GOSUB *SET_OBJECTS
 1047 '
 1048 '================ Main Loop
 1049 *PAD_WATCH
 1050   TRIGGA=0
 1051   *PAD_W2:IF TRIGGA THEN KEY$="":KEY=0:GOTO *PAD_TRIGGA
 1052     IF PLAYSTAT(0)=0 THEN EMNUM=-1:GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1053     KEY$=INKEY$:IF KEY$="" THEN *PAD_W2 ELSE KEY=ASC(KEY$)
 1054   *PAD_TRIGGA
 1055     WTIME=0
 1056     IF KEY=KEY_DOWN  OR KEY=KEY_D2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_DOWN) THEN GOSUB *MOVE_DOWN:GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1057     IF KEY=KEY_UP    OR KEY=KEY_U2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_UP)   THEN GOSUB *MOVE_UP:  GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1058     IF KEY=KEY_ENTER OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_START OR @PAD_C))  THEN IF EMNUM=CNUM THEN BGM:GOTO *PAD_WATCH ELSE EMNUM=CNUM:GOSUB *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:GOTO *PLAY_GO
 1059     IF KEY=KEY_ESC   OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_Y     OR @PAD_B))  THEN *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1060     GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1061 '
 1062 '================
 1063 *MOVE_DOWN
 1064   IF CNUM < NUM_OF_MSTR THEN CNUM=CNUM+1
 1065   IF (CNUM > 4) AND (CNUM <= (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP+1
 1066   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1067   RETURN
 1068 '
 1069 '----------------
 1070 *MOVE_UP
 1071   IF CNUM > 1 THEN CNUM=CNUM-1
 1072   IF (CNUM > 3) AND (CNUM < (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP-1
 1073   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1074   RETURN
 1075 '
 1076 '----------------
 1077 *DISPLAY_MENU
 1078   MDY=38
 1079   FOR I=MTOP TO MTOP+6
 1080     IF I=CNUM THEN
 1081       IF I=EMNUM THEN
 1082         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31),,RGB(20,20,0)
 1083       ELSE
 1084         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31),,RGB(0,20,20)
 1085       ENDIF
 1086     ELSE
 1087       IF I=EMNUM THEN
 1088         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,0),,RGB(16,16,16)
 1089       ELSE
 1090         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31)
 1091       ENDIF
 1092     ENDIF
 1093     MDY=MDY+18
 1094   NEXT
 1095   RETURN
 1096 '
 1097 '================ Subroutines
 1098 *INIT_SYS
 1099   MTOP=1:EMNUM=-1
 1100   DIM MSTR$(NUM_OF_MSTR)
 1101   RESTORE *MENU_STR:FOR I=0 TO NUM_OF_MSTR:READ MSTR$(I):NEXT
 1102 '
 1103   PAD_ABCXYZSTART = @PAD_A+@PAD_B+@PAD_C+@PAD_START+@PAD_X+@PAD_Y+@PAD_Z
 1104   PAD_UDLR  = @PAD_RIGHT+@PAD_LEFT+@PAD_DOWN+@PAD_UP+@PAD_L+@PAD_R
 1105   KEY_DOWN  = 31:  KEY_D2=ASC("X")-64
 1106   KEY_UP    = 30:  KEY_U2=ASC("E")-64
 1107   KEY_ENTER = 13: KEY_ESC = 27
 1108 '
 1109   SCREEN 0:WIDTH 1,1,38,26
 1110   INITIAL_TOUCH=20:AFTER_TOUCH=3
 1111   ON INTERVAL (0) GOSUB *INT_COUNT: INTERVAL (0) ON,1
 1112   ON INTERVAL (1) GOSUB *DISPLAY_PFONT: INTERVAL (1) ON,1
 1113 *CLEAR_INKEY: IF INKEY$<>"" THEN *CLEAR_INKEY
 1114   TRIGGA=PAD(0,2) :' Clear trigga
 1115   KPRINT (10,20),MSTR$(0),,,RGB(20,0,20)    :'Title display
 1116   LINE(10,164)-(307,164),RGB(31,31,0)
 1117   KPRINT (10,166),"Up/Down";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX "(direction buttons)---";,RGB(21,21,10):KPRINT FIX "Move Cursor",RGB(0,31,20)
 1118   KPRINT (10,182-8),FIX "  START / C button";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX " --- ";,RGB(21,21,10):KPRINT FIX "Start BGM  ",RGB(0,31,20)
 1119   KPRINT (10,198-16),FIX "          B button";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX " --- ";,RGB(21,21,10):KPRINT FIX "RETURN Main Menu",RGB(0,31,20)
 1120   CNUM=-1:GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU:CNUM=1
 1121   GOSUB *SOUND_INIT:GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU    :'Sound sample's own initialisation routine
 1122   RETURN
 1123 '
 1124 '----------------
 1125 *INT_COUNT:' Make repeat trigga of PAD ULDR
 1126   IF PAD(0)=52 THEN *INT_COUNT_RET: 'Ignore keyboard pad
 1127   TRIGGA=TRIGGA OR (PAD(0,2) AND PAD_ABCXYZSTART): 'Update A,B,C,START buttons
 1128   TESTBTN=PAD(0,1):IF (TESTBTN AND PAD_UDLR) = 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=0: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET
 1129   IF TESTBTNL<>TESTBTN THEN TESTBTNL=TESTBTN: REPEAT_COUNT=0
 1130   IF REPEAT_COUNT=0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=INITIAL_TOUCH: TRIGGA=TESTBTN: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET
 1131   REPEAT_COUNT=REPEAT_COUNT-1: IF REPEAT_COUNT <= 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=AFTER_TOUCH: TRIGGA=TESTBTN
 1132 *INT_COUNT_RET
 1133   SKCLOSE
 1134   RETURN
 1135 '
 1136 '----------------
 1137 *SET_OBJECTS
 1138 'Object Item Number
 1139   TYPE = 0: XP = 4: XR = 8: XS = 12
 1140   PARENT = 20: XRV= 36
 1141 '
 1142   SETDISP 3: SETPERS 105
 1143   SETLIGHT .5,-1,.5:PRIORITY 10,1
 1144   PFONT$=TITLE$:GOSUB *MAKE_PFONT
 1145   WTIME = 0:SOFS=-255: COLOROFS ON,10:COLOROFS (SOFS,SOFS,SOFS)
 1146   OBJ(1,TYPE)=6:OBJ(1,XRV)=&H0.0018,&H0.0024,-&H0.002
 1147   OBJ(0,XP+2)=110
 1148   RETURN
 1149 '
 1150 '----------------
 1151 *MAKE_PFONT
 1152   SLEN=LEN(PFONT$): PT=-SLEN/2*45 : ND=RND(255)/255:OBJ(1,XP+2)=90+SLEN*10
 1153   FOR SP=1 TO SLEN
 1154     CH$=MID$(PFONT$,SP,1): CH2$=MID$(PFONT$,SP+1,1)
 1155     IF CH$=" " THEN
 1156       PT=PT+40
 1157     ELSE
 1158       OBJ(SP+2,XP)=PT,60:OBJ(SP+2,PARENT)=1:OBJ(SP+2,TYPE)=4: OBJ(SP+2,XRV)=&H0.001
 1159       SETPFONT SP+2,ASC(CH$),(1,1.2,3),RGB(30,24,30)
 1160       IF CH$="I" OR CH2$="I" THEN PT=PT+50 ELSE PT=PT+60
 1161     ENDIF
 1162   NEXT SP
 1163   RETURN
 1164 '
 1165 '----------------
 1166 *DISPLAY_PFONT:GOSUB *DISP_COPYRIGHT
 1167   IF WTIME = 0 THEN *DISP_HIDDEN
 1168   IF WTIME > 60*20 THEN *DISP_APEAR
 1169   WTIME = WTIME + 1: RETURN
 1170 *DISP_HIDDEN
 1171   IF SOFS > -330 THEN SOFS = SOFS - 5
 1172   IF SOFS <= -330 THEN SOFS = -330: WTIME = 1
 1173   GOTO *DISP_RET
 1174 *DISP_APEAR
 1175   IF SOFS < -110 THEN SOFS = SOFS + .5
 1176 *DISP_RET
 1177   OX=SOFS+XSIN(ND)*50: IF OX < -255 THEN OX = -255
 1178   OY=SOFS+XSIN(ND+1/3)*50: IF OY < -255 THEN OY = -255
 1179   OZ=SOFS+XSIN(ND+2/3)*50: IF OZ < -255 THEN OZ = -255
 1180   ND=ND+&H0.0004: COLOROFS (OX,OY,OZ)
 1181   RETURN
 1182 '
 1183 '---------------- SCREEN Fade Out
 1184 *FADEOUT
 1185   COLOROFS ON,0:IF OFS=255 THEN RETURN
 1186   FOR OFS=0 TO 255 STEP 32
 1187     COLOROFS(-OFS,-OFS,-OFS)
 1188     VSYNC
 1189   NEXT OFS
 1190   OFS=255
 1191   COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255)
 1192   CLS 0
 1193   VSYNC
 1194   RETURN
 1195 '
 1196 '================ Sound sample's own initialisation routine
 1197 *SOUND_INIT
 1198   LOCATE 5,0:COLOR 7
 1199   IF PEEK(0,5)=1 THEN PRINT " Tone Data Set...":PLAYINIT "ZELIARD",1 ELSE PRINT " Arrange Tone....":PLAYINIT 1:RESTORE *TONE_SET:TARG READ
 1201   GOSUB *TPROP_SUB:LOCATE 5,0:PRINT "                 "
 1202   RETURN
 1203 '
 1204 '================ MUSIC FADE OUT
 1205 *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:IF PLAYSTAT(0)=0 THEN RETURN
 1206   TMP_F=CNUM:CNUM=-1:GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU:LOCATE 5,0:COLOR 7:PRINT " Music Fade Out...":PLAYFADE 0,0,4:VSYNC 2
 1207   *MFO_LOOP
 1208     IF PLAYSTAT(0)=1 THEN *MFO_LOOP
 1209   CNUM=TMP_F:GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU:LOCATE 5,0:PRINT "                  ":RETURN
 1210 '
 1211 '================ Start Sound Sample Program
 1212 *PLAY_GO
 1213   PLAYSTOP:VSYNC 2
 1214   LOCATE 5,0:COLOR 7:PRINT " Set Song Data..."
 1215   TMP=CNUM
 1216   ON CNUM RESTORE *ZOPN,*MGT1,*MUS1,*MUS2,*MGT2,*MUS3,*MUS4,*UGM1,*MUS5,*MUS6,*UGM2,*MUS7,*MUS8,*MBOS,*MMAO,*MFAN,*ZEND

 1218   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU:BGM:VSYNC 2
 1219   GOTO *PAD_WATCH

### S_VEIGUS.B: Veigues music

**File:** `S_VEIGUS.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 22,055 bytes, 446 lines. 27 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_VEIGUS.B",R`.

The opening of *Tactical Gladiator Veigues*, almost entirely FM.

**Techniques:**

- FM tones defined in `DATA` and loaded with `TARG`

```
LOAD "COM:FMVEIGS.B"
 1000 '
 1001 'Programed by Mitsuhashi
 1002 '
 1003 '=== VEIGUES OPENING MUSIC ===
 1004 CLEAR 10,1360:PLAYINIT:SCREEN 1:CLS:IF PEEK(0,3)<>78 THEN KLOAD ON:CLEAR 10,1360:POKE 0,0,56:POKE 0,1,1:POKE 0,2,12:POKE 0,3,78:POKE 0,4,9:POKE 0,5,1
 1006 IF PEEK(0,5)=1 THEN PRINT "--- VEIGUES --- Tone Data Set..":PLAYINIT "VEIGUES",1 ELSE PRINT "--- VEIGUES --- Tone arrange...":PLAYINIT 1:RESTORE *VOPEN_TARG:TARG READ
 1007 RESTORE *VOPEN_SONG:SETSONG:CLS
 1008 COLOR 6:PRINT "== VEIGUES Opening Music(GAME ARTS)==":PRINT:PRINT:PRINT
 1009 KPRINT (100,25),"FM synthesis sample":PRINT
 1010 COLOR 4:PRINT " MUSIC COMPOSER      MML PROGRAMMING"
 1011 COLOR 5:PRINT "   MECANO ASSOCIATES     M.Mitsuhashi"
 1012 COLOR 7
 1013 VOLUME 116:BGM
 1014 PRINT:PRINT " PRESS ANY KEY -> MAIN MENU"
 1015 *LOOP:IF INKEY$="" AND PAD(0,2)=0 THEN *LOOP ELSE PLAYSTOP 0:CLS:CLS 0:PRINT "Loading S_G_ARTS.B":LOAD "CD:S_G_ARTS",R
 1016 '
 1017 *VOPEN_TARG
 1018  REM  ----------W.BANJYO
 1019 DATA BUILDLAYER
 1020 DATA FM, 1 , 1 ,  1 ,  1 ,  7 ,  0 , 31 ,  7 ,  4, 22 , 31 , 80,  52 , 0,-35,0
 1021 DATA FM, 2 , 1 ,  1 ,  1 , 12 ,  0 , 31 , 12 , 15, 22 , 22 , 40,  52 , 0,-35,0
      ' ... 49 DATA lines and 8 comment lines not shown (lines 1022-1078) ...
 1079 '########## SONG DATA ##########
 1080 *VOPEN_SONG
 1081 DATA \S=\N41'8~64;64;\  \B=\N30'8~64;64;\  \L=\N45'8~64;64;\  \M=\N45'8~80;80;\  \H=\N48'8~64;64;\
      ' ... 362 DATA lines not shown (lines 1082-1443) ...
 1444 DATA ENDSONG

### S_F_HAWK.B: Fire Hawk music

**File:** `S_F_HAWK.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 297,488 bytes, 6,162 lines. 385 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_F_HAWK.B",R`.

Tunes from *Fire Hawk (Thexder 2)*. The boss tune cuts in seamlessly at a musical break point.

**Techniques:**

- `ON MMLSTAT GOSUB` and the MML `!` command: the music tells the program when it reaches a good point to change BGM
- Several tone arrangements shared between tunes

```
LOAD "COM:S_F_HAWK.B"
 1000 ' GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN Sound Sample Program Ver 1.1
 1001 ' [ S_F_HAWK.B ]
 1002 ' Programmed by Naozumi Honma (nao)
 1003 '               Kanayama Motoyuki (motos)
 1004 '               M.Mitsuhashi
 1005 '
 1006   SCREEN 0: SKCLOSE         :'Initialize screen, Close software keyboard
 1007   CLEAR 10,1360:IF PEEK(0,3)<>78 THEN KLOAD ON:CLEAR 10,1360:POKE 0,0,56:POKE 0,1,1:POKE 0,2,13:POKE 0,3,78:POKE 0,4,10:POKE 0,5,1
 1008   WIDTH 1,1,38,26:PLAYINIT:COLOR ,RGB(31,31,31):COLOROFS ON,0:COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255):VSYNC:OFS=255
 1009 '
 1010   TITLE$="FIRE HAWK"        :'<<< Polygon Title   >>>
 1011   NUM_OF_MSTR=14            :'<<< number of MENU items >>>
 1012   PROG$="***** MML Programed by Masakuni Mitsuhashi ***** Sound System Programed by Naozumi Honma (nao) / Bits Laboratory ***** BASIC Main System Programed by Motoyuki Kanayama (motos) / Bits Laboratory *****"
 1013   PROG$=PROG$+" Special Thanks - Kenichi Kunishima, Tomoyuki Shimada *****"
 1014   Q$=SPACE$(40)+PROG$+SPACE$(300):QCUT=1

      ' ... 11 DATA lines not shown (lines 1022-1032) ...
 1033   DATA "14: Ending      :Mitsuhashi Masakuni :E"

 1036 *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1037   GOSUB *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:OBJ CLEAR:GOSUB *FADEOUT:INTERVAL (0) OFF:INTERVAL (1) OFF:SCREEN 0:LOCATE 5,0:COLOR 7:PRINT "Loading S_G_ARTS.B":LOAD"CD:S_G_ARTS",R
 1038   END

 1040 '---------------- Start Program
 1041 *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1042   GOSUB *INIT_SYS
 1043   GOSUB *SET_OBJECTS
 1044 '
 1045 '================ Main Loop
 1046 *PAD_WATCH
 1047   TRIGGA=0
 1048   *PAD_W2:IF TRIGGA THEN KEY$="":KEY=0:GOTO *PAD_TRIGGA
 1049     IF PLAYSTAT(0)=0 THEN EMNUM=-1:GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1050     KEY$=INKEY$:IF KEY$="" THEN *PAD_W2 ELSE KEY=ASC(KEY$)
 1051   *PAD_TRIGGA
 1052     WTIME=0
 1053     IF KEY=KEY_DOWN  OR KEY=KEY_D2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_DOWN) THEN GOSUB *MOVE_DOWN:GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1054     IF KEY=KEY_UP    OR KEY=KEY_U2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_UP)   THEN GOSUB *MOVE_UP:  GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1055     IF KEY=KEY_ENTER OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_START OR @PAD_C))  THEN EMNUM=CNUM:GOSUB *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:GOTO *PLAY_GO
 1056     IF KEY=KEY_ESC   OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_Y     OR @PAD_B))  THEN *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1057     GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1058 '
 1059 '================
 1060 *MOVE_DOWN
 1061   IF CNUM < NUM_OF_MSTR THEN CNUM=CNUM+1
 1062   IF (CNUM > 4) AND (CNUM <= (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP+1
 1063   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1064   RETURN
 1065 '
 1066 '----------------
 1067 *MOVE_UP
 1068   IF CNUM > 1 THEN CNUM=CNUM-1
 1069   IF (CNUM > 3) AND (CNUM < (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP-1
 1070   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1071   RETURN
 1072 '
 1073 '----------------
 1074 *DISPLAY_MENU
 1075   MDY=38
 1076   FOR I=MTOP TO MTOP+6
 1077     IF I=CNUM THEN
 1078       IF I=EMNUM THEN
 1079         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31),,RGB(20,20,0)
 1080       ELSE
 1081         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31),,RGB(0,20,20)
 1082       ENDIF
 1083     ELSE
 1084       IF I=EMNUM THEN
 1085         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,0),,RGB(16,16,16)
 1086       ELSE
 1087         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31)
 1088       ENDIF
 1089     ENDIF
 1090     MDY=MDY+18
 1091   NEXT
 1092   RETURN

 1121 '----------------
 1122 *INT_COUNT:' Make repeat trigga of PAD ULDR
 1123   IF PAD(0)=52 THEN *INT_COUNT_RET: 'Ignore keyboard pad
 1124   TRIGGA=TRIGGA OR (PAD(0,2) AND PAD_ABCXYZSTART): 'Update A,B,C,START buttons
 1125   TESTBTN=PAD(0,1):IF (TESTBTN AND PAD_UDLR) = 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=0: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET
 1126   IF TESTBTNL<>TESTBTN THEN TESTBTNL=TESTBTN: REPEAT_COUNT=0
 1127   IF REPEAT_COUNT=0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=INITIAL_TOUCH: TRIGGA=TESTBTN: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET
 1128   REPEAT_COUNT=REPEAT_COUNT-1: IF REPEAT_COUNT <= 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=AFTER_TOUCH: TRIGGA=TESTBTN
 1129 *INT_COUNT_RET

 1131   RETURN

 1139   SETDISP 3: SETPERS 105

 1142   WTIME = 0:SOFS=-255: COLOROFS ON,10:COLOROFS (SOFS,SOFS,SOFS)
 1143   OBJ(1,TYPE)=6:OBJ(1,XRV)=&H0.0018,&H0.0024,-&H0.002
 1144   OBJ(0,XP+2)=110

 1147 '----------------
 1148 *MAKE_PFONT
 1149   SLEN=LEN(PFONT$): PT=-SLEN/2*45 : ND=RND(255)/255:OBJ(1,XP+2)=90+SLEN*10
 1150   FOR SP=1 TO SLEN
 1151     CH$=MID$(PFONT$,SP,1): CH2$=MID$(PFONT$,SP+1,1)
 1152     IF CH$=" " THEN
 1153       PT=PT+40
 1154     ELSE
 1155       OBJ(SP+2,XP)=PT,60:OBJ(SP+2,PARENT)=1:OBJ(SP+2,TYPE)=4: OBJ(SP+2,XRV)=&H0.001
 1156       SETPFONT SP+2,ASC(CH$),(1,1.2,3),RGB(30,24,30)
 1157       IF CH$="I" OR CH2$="I" THEN PT=PT+50 ELSE PT=PT+60
 1158     ENDIF
 1159   NEXT SP
 1160   RETURN

 1162 '----------------
 1163 *DISPLAY_PFONT:GOSUB *DISP_COPYRIGHT
 1164   IF WTIME = 0 THEN *DISP_HIDDEN
 1165   IF WTIME > 60*20 THEN *DISP_APEAR
 1166   WTIME = WTIME + 1: RETURN
 1167 *DISP_HIDDEN
 1168   IF SOFS > -330 THEN SOFS = SOFS - 5
 1169   IF SOFS <= -330 THEN SOFS = -330: WTIME = 1
 1170   GOTO *DISP_RET
 1171 *DISP_APEAR
 1172   IF SOFS < -110 THEN SOFS = SOFS + .5
 1173 *DISP_RET
 1174   OX=SOFS+XSIN(ND)*50: IF OX < -255 THEN OX = -255
 1175   OY=SOFS+XSIN(ND+1/3)*50: IF OY < -255 THEN OY = -255
 1176   OZ=SOFS+XSIN(ND+2/3)*50: IF OZ < -255 THEN OZ = -255
 1177   ND=ND+&H0.0004: COLOROFS (OX,OY,OZ)

 1180 '---------------- SCREEN Fade Out
 1181 *FADEOUT
 1182   COLOROFS ON,0:IF OFS=255 THEN RETURN
 1183   FOR OFS=0 TO 255 STEP 32
 1184     COLOROFS(-OFS,-OFS,-OFS)
 1185     VSYNC
 1186   NEXT OFS
 1187   OFS=255
 1188   COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255)
 1189   CLS 0
 1190   VSYNC
 1191   RETURN

### S_ALISIA.B: Alisia Dragoon music

**File:** `S_ALISIA.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 227,119 bytes, 4,268 lines. 294 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_ALISIA.B",R`.

Tunes from *Alisia Dragoon*, mixing FM and PCM, including some not in the released game.

**Techniques:**

- As `S_SILPH.B`

```
LOAD"COM:DUMMY"
 1000 ' GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN Sound Sample Program Ver 1.1
 1001 ' [ S_ALISIA.B ]
 1002 ' Programmed by Naozumi Honma (nao)
 1003 '               Kanayama Motoyuki (motos)
 1004 '               Yukihiro Ninagawa
 1005 '
 1006   SCREEN 0: SKCLOSE         :'Initialize screen, Close software keyboard
 1007   CLEAR 10,1360:IF PEEK(0,3)<>78 THEN KLOAD ON:CLEAR 10,1360:POKE 0,0,56:POKE 0,1,1:POKE 0,2,14:POKE 0,3,78:POKE 0,4,11:POKE 0,5,1
 1008   WIDTH 1,1,38,26:PLAYINIT:COLOR ,RGB(31,31,31):COLOROFS ON,0:COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255):VSYNC:OFS=255
 1009 '
 1010   TITLE$="ALISIA DRAGOON"   :'<<< Polygon Title   >>>
 1011   NUM_OF_MSTR=24            :'<<< number of MENU items >>>
 1012   PROG$="***** MUSIC COMPOSER : MECANO ASSOCIATES ***** MML Programed by Yukihiro Ninagawa ***** Sound System Programed by Naozumi Honma (nao) / Bits Laboratory ***** BASIC Main System Programed by Motoyuki Kanayama (motos)"
 1013   PROG$=PROG$+" / Bits Laboratory ***** Special Thanks - Kenichi Kunishima, Masakuni Mitsuhashi, Tomoyuki Shimada, Yukihiro Yoshida *****"
 1014   Q$=SPACE$(40)+PROG$+SPACE$(300):QCUT=1
 1015   GOTO *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1016 '
 1017 '---------------- MENU DATA
 1018 *MENU_STR
 1019   DATA " Alisia Dragoon         (C)GAME ARTS"
 1020   DATA " 1: Opening"
 1021   DATA " 2: STAGE 1-1 Forest"
      ' ... 21 DATA lines not shown (lines 1022-1042) ...
 1043   DATA "24: Game over"
 1044 '
 1045 '---------------- Exit Program
 1046 *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1047   GOSUB *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:OBJ CLEAR:GOSUB *FADEOUT:INTERVAL (0) OFF:INTERVAL (1) OFF:SCREEN 0:LOCATE 5,0:COLOR 7:PRINT "Loading S_G_ARTS.B":LOAD"CD:S_G_ARTS",R
 1048   END
 1049 '
 1050 '---------------- Start Program
 1051 *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1052   GOSUB *INIT_SYS
 1053   GOSUB *SET_OBJECTS
 1054 '
 1055 '================ Main Loop
 1056 *PAD_WATCH
 1057   TRIGGA=0
 1058   *PAD_W2:IF TRIGGA THEN KEY$="":KEY=0:GOTO *PAD_TRIGGA
 1059     IF PLAYSTAT(0)=0 THEN EMNUM=-1:GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1060     KEY$=INKEY$:IF KEY$="" THEN *PAD_W2 ELSE KEY=ASC(KEY$)
 1061   *PAD_TRIGGA
 1062     WTIME=0
 1063     IF KEY=KEY_DOWN  OR KEY=KEY_D2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_DOWN) THEN GOSUB *MOVE_DOWN:GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1064     IF KEY=KEY_UP    OR KEY=KEY_U2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_UP)   THEN GOSUB *MOVE_UP:  GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1065     IF KEY=KEY_ENTER OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_START OR @PAD_C))  THEN IF EMNUM=CNUM THEN BGM:GOTO *PAD_WATCH ELSE EMNUM=CNUM:GOSUB *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:GOTO *PLAY_GO
 1066     IF KEY=KEY_ESC   OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_Y     OR @PAD_B))  THEN *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1067     GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1068 '
 1069 '================

### S_LUNARA.B: Lunar music, version A

**File:** `S_LUNARA.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 175,681 bytes, 3,678 lines. 263 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_LUNARA.B",R`.

Tunes from *Lunar: The Silver Star*. Every tune uses the same tone layout, with the first 30 tones left free for sound effects, so they can be used as BGM in your own game.

**Techniques:**

- One shared tone layout for all tunes: a model for game BGM

```
LOAD"COM:DUMMY"
 1000 ' GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN Sound Sample Program Ver 1.1

 1003 '               Kanayama Motoyuki (motos)
 1004 '               Yukihiro Ninagawa

 1006   SCREEN 0: SKCLOSE         :'Initialize screen, Close software keyboard

 1008   WIDTH 1,1,38,26:PLAYINIT:COLOR ,RGB(31,31,31):COLOROFS ON,0:COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255):VSYNC:OFS=255

 1013   PROG$=PROG$+" / Bits Laboratory ***** Special Thanks - Kenichi Kunishima, Masakuni Mitsuhashi, Tomoyuki Shimada, Yukihiro Yoshida *****"

### S_LUNARB.B: Lunar music, version B

**File:** `S_LUNARB.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 279,847 bytes, 6,003 lines. 625 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_LUNARB.B",R`.

Version A with each tune's tones rearranged for listening, using the DSP effects. Each tune is initialised separately.

**Techniques:**

- Advanced MML: per-tune `PLAYINIT` DSP modes and heavy use of `TPROP` (over 170 calls)

```
LOAD"COM:DUMMY"
 1000 ' GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN Sound Sample Program Ver 1.1
 1001 ' [ S_LUNARB.B ]
 1002 ' Programmed by Naozumi Honma (nao)
 1003 '               Kanayama Motoyuki (motos)
 1004 '               Yukihiro Ninagawa
 1005 '
 1006   SCREEN 0: SKCLOSE         :'Initialize screen, Close software keyboard
 1007   CLEAR 10,1360:IF PEEK(0,3)<>78 THEN KLOAD ON:CLEAR 10,1360:POKE 0,0,56:POKE 0,1,1:POKE 0,2,16:POKE 0,3,78:POKE 0,4,11:POKE 0,5,1
 1008   WIDTH 1,1,38,26:PLAYINIT:COLOR ,RGB(31,31,31):COLOROFS ON,0:COLOROFS(-255,-255,-255):VSYNC:OFS=255
 1009 '
 1010   TITLE$="LUNAR B"    :'<<< Polygon Title   >>>
 1011   NUM_OF_MSTR=15      :'<<< number of MENU items >>>
 1012   PROG$="***** MUSIC COMPOSER : TWO FIVE / Noriyuki Iwadare ***** MML Programed by Yukihiro Ninagawa ***** Sound System Programed by Naozumi Honma (nao) / Bits Laboratory ***** BASIC Main System Programed by Motoyuki Kanayama (motos)"
 1013   PROG$=PROG$+" / Bits Laboratory ***** Special Thanks - Kenichi Kunishima, Masakuni Mitsuhashi, Tomoyuki Shimada, Yukihiro Yoshida *****"
 1014   Q$=SPACE$(40)+PROG$+SPACE$(300):QCUT=1
 1015   GOTO *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1016 '
 1017 '---------------- MENU DATA
 1018 *MENU_STR
 1019   DATA " LUNAR-SS Version B     (C)GAME ARTS "
 1020   DATA " 1: M01 Small-fry battle 1"
 1021   DATA " 2: M02 Tavern"
      ' ... 12 DATA lines not shown (lines 1022-1033) ...
 1034   DATA "15: M46 Resolved to fight"
 1035 '
 1036 '---------------- Exit Program
 1037 *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1038   GOSUB *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:OBJ CLEAR:GOSUB *FADEOUT:INTERVAL (0) OFF:INTERVAL (1) OFF:SCREEN 0:LOCATE 5,0:COLOR 7:PRINT "Loading S_G_ARTS.B":LOAD"CD:S_G_ARTS",R
 1039   END
 1040 '
 1041 '---------------- Start Program
 1042 *START_THIS_PROGRAM
 1043   GOSUB *INIT_SYS
 1044   GOSUB *SET_OBJECTS
 1045 '
 1046 '================ Main Loop
 1047 *PAD_WATCH
 1048   TRIGGA=0
 1049   *PAD_W2:IF TRIGGA THEN KEY$="":KEY=0:GOTO *PAD_TRIGGA
 1050     IF PLAYSTAT(0)=0 THEN EMNUM=-1:GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1051     KEY$=INKEY$:IF KEY$="" THEN *PAD_W2 ELSE KEY=ASC(KEY$)
 1052   *PAD_TRIGGA
 1053     WTIME=0
 1054     IF KEY=KEY_DOWN  OR KEY=KEY_D2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_DOWN) THEN GOSUB *MOVE_DOWN:GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1055     IF KEY=KEY_UP    OR KEY=KEY_U2 OR (TRIGGA AND @PAD_UP)   THEN GOSUB *MOVE_UP:  GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1056     IF KEY=KEY_ENTER OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_START OR @PAD_C))  THEN IF EMNUM=CNUM THEN BGM:GOTO *PAD_WATCH ELSE EMNUM=CNUM:GOSUB *MUSIC_FADE_OUT:GOTO *PLAY_GO
 1057     IF KEY=KEY_ESC   OR (TRIGGA AND (@PAD_Y     OR @PAD_B))  THEN *EXIT_THIS_PROGRAM
 1058     GOTO *PAD_WATCH
 1059 '
 1060 '================
 1061 *MOVE_DOWN
 1062   IF CNUM < NUM_OF_MSTR THEN CNUM=CNUM+1
 1063   IF (CNUM > 4) AND (CNUM <= (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP+1
 1064   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1065   RETURN
 1066 '
 1067 '----------------
 1068 *MOVE_UP
 1069   IF CNUM > 1 THEN CNUM=CNUM-1
 1070   IF (CNUM > 3) AND (CNUM < (NUM_OF_MSTR - 3)) THEN MTOP=MTOP-1
 1071   GOSUB *DISPLAY_MENU
 1072   RETURN
 1073 '
 1074 '----------------
 1075 *DISPLAY_MENU
 1076   MDY=38
 1077   FOR I=MTOP TO MTOP+6
 1078     IF I=CNUM THEN
 1079       IF I=EMNUM THEN
 1080         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31),,RGB(20,20,0)
 1081       ELSE
 1082         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31),,RGB(0,20,20)
 1083       ENDIF
 1084     ELSE
 1085       IF I=EMNUM THEN
 1086         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,0),,RGB(16,16,16)
 1087       ELSE
 1088         KPRINT (10,MDY),MSTR$(I),RGB(31,31,31)
 1089       ENDIF
 1090     ENDIF
 1091     MDY=MDY+18
 1092   NEXT
 1093   RETURN

 1096 *INIT_SYS
 1097   MTOP=1:EMNUM=-1
 1098   DIM MSTR$(NUM_OF_MSTR)

 1100 '

 1116   KPRINT (10,182-8),FIX "  START / C button";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX " --- ";,RGB(21,21,10):KPRINT FIX "Start BGM  ",RGB(0,31,20)
 1117   KPRINT (10,198-16),FIX "          B button";,RGB(31,22,22):KPRINT FIX " --- ";,RGB(21,21,10):KPRINT FIX "RETURN Main Menu",RGB(0,31,20)

 1126   TESTBTN=PAD(0,1):IF (TESTBTN AND PAD_UDLR) = 0 THEN REPEAT_COUNT=0: GOTO *INT_COUNT_RET

 1151   FOR SP=1 TO SLEN

### S_TUBASA.B: Lunar: Tsubasa (karaoke)

**File:** `S_TUBASA.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 62,339 bytes, 1,158 lines. 165 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:S_TUBASA.B",R`.

The *Lunar* opening theme as a karaoke sample: the lyrics appear in time with the music.

**Techniques:**

- `ON MMLSTAT GOSUB` to show each lyric line when the MML reaches it

```
LOAD"COM:DUMMY"
1000 ' GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN Sound Sample Program Ver 1.1
1001 ' [ S_TUBASA.B ]
1002 ' Programmed by Yukihiro Ninagawa
1003 '               Naozumi Honma (nao)
1004 '
1006 SCREEN 0: SKCLOSE         :'Initialize screen, Close software keyboard
1007 CLEAR 10,1360:IF PEEK(0,3)<>78 THEN KLOAD ON:CLEAR 10,1360:POKE 0,0,56:POKE 0,1,1:POKE 0,2,17:POKE 0,3,78:POKE 0,4,11:POKE 0,5,1
1008 WIDTH 1,1,38,26:CLS -1
1010 PRINT "[TSU BA SA]"
1020 PRINT " Just a moment..."
1021 PROG$="***** MUSIC COMPOSER : TWO FIVE / Noriyuki Iwadare ***** MML Programed by Yukihiro Ninagawa ***** Sound System Programed by Naozumi Honma (nao) / Bits Laboratory ***** BASIC Main System Programed by Motoyuki Kanayama (motos)"
1022 PROG$=PROG$+" / Bits Laboratory ***** Special Thanks - Yukihiro Yoshida *****"
1023 Q$=SPACE$(40)+PROG$+SPACE$(300):QCUT=1
1124 ON INTERVAL (1) GOSUB *DISP_COPYRIGHT
1125 ON MMLSTAT GOSUB *WORD

20020 DC_TIME=DC_TIME+1

20070 RETURN

## 6. Tools and utilities

The launcher, the paint program, the song and instrument editors, and small utilities. The tool main programs are the largest BASIC programs on the CD and show how to build windows, menus and mouse handling in GAME BASIC.
