20620 ON ERROR GOTO *SET_NEIROLIST_ERR1
20630 I=0
20650 *SETNEIROL0
20660 GOSUB *GET_TOKEN
20670 IF INSTR("@#",LEFT$(TOKEN$,1))<>0 THEN
20680  LIST_$(I,0)=TOKEN$
20690  GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:LIST_$(I,1)=TOKEN$
20700  GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:LIST_$(I,2)=TOKEN$
20710  I=I+1
20720  IF LOF(1)>LOC(1) GOTO *SETNEIROL0
20730 ELSE
20740  RET=1
20750 ENDIF
20770 *SET_NEIROLIST_EXIT1
20780 ON ERROR GOTO *SET_NEIROLIST_ERR1
20790 CLOSE #1
20810 *SET_NEIROLIST_EXIT
20820 ON ERROR GOTO 0
20830 IF RET<>0 THEN
20840  FOR I=0 TO 127:LIST_$(I,0)=" ** Unknown **":NEXT
20850 ENDIF
20860 RETURN
20880 *SET_NEIROLIST_ERR:RET=1:RESUME *SET_NEIROLIST_EXIT
20900 *SET_NEIROLIST_ERR1:RET=1:RESUME *SET_NEIROLIST_EXIT1
20910 'Get 1 token from the file
20930 *GET_TOKEN:ON ERROR GOTO *GET_TOKEN_ERR
20940 TOKEN$=""
20960 *GET_TOKENL:IF LOF(1)<LOC(1) THEN TOKEN$="No good":ON ERROR GOTO 0:RETURN
20970 FREAD #1,C$,1:IF C$=CHR$(13) GOTO *GET_TOKENL
20980 IF INSTR(","+CHR$(10)+CHR$(13),C$)<>0 THEN ON ERROR GOTO 0:RETURN
20990 TOKEN$=TOKEN$+C$:GOTO *GET_TOKENL
21010 *GET_TOKEN_ERR:TOKEN$="No good":RESUME *GET_TOKEN_EXIT
21030 *GET_TOKEN_EXIT
21040 ON ERROR GOTO 0:RETURN
21050 '-------------------------------------------------------------
21060 'Tone settings
21070 '-------------------------------------------------------------
21080 'Set the sounds in the list
21100 *SET_NEIROSET
21110 LI=1000
21120 NEI$=""
21130 IF RIGHT$(FILE$,2)<>".D" THEN
21140  ON ERROR GOTO *SET_NEIROSET_EXIT
21150  PLAYINIT FILE$
21160  ARG1$="PLAYINIT "+CHR$(34)+FILE$+CHR$(34):GOSUB *WRITELINE1
21170  RET=0
21180  ON ERROR GOTO 0
21190  RETURN
21200 ENDIF
21210 RET=0:F=0
21230 *SET_NEIROSETL0
21240 IF LIST_$(RET,0)<>"" THEN
21250  GOSUB *SET_NEIROSETSUB
21260  RET=RET+1
21270  GOTO *SET_NEIROSETL0
21280 ENDIF
21290 USERDATA "ENDARRANGE":ARG1$="ENDARRANGE":ARG2=1:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21300 ON ERROR GOTO *SET_NEIROSET_EXIT
21310 TARG READ 0,0
21320 ARG1$="TARG READ 0,0":GOSUB *WRITELINE1
21330 RET=0
21350 *SET_NEIROSET_EXIT_1
21360 USERDATA END
21370 ON ERROR GOTO 0
21380 RETURN
21400 *SET_NEIROSET_EXIT:RET=1:RESUME *SET_NEIROSET_EXIT_1
21410 '
21430 *SET_NEIROSETSUB
21440 IF LEFT$(LIST_$(RET,0),1)="@" THEN
21450  '
21460  IF F=0 THEN F=1:USERDATA 0,0,LIST_$(RET,1) ELSE USERDATA LIST_$(RET,1)
21470  USERDATA LIST_$(RET,2),0
21480  ARG1$=CHR$(34)+LIST_$(RET,1)+CHR$(34)+","+LIST_$(RET,2):ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21490 ELSE
21500  'Home-made sounds
21501  ON ERROR GOTO *ERR001
21510  OPEN LIST_$(RET,1) FOR INPUT AS #1
21511  ON ERROR GOTO *ERR002
21520  FOR I=1 TO VAL(LIST_$(RET,2))
21540 *SET_NEIRO_LISTL0
21550    GOSUB *GET_TOKEN
21560    IF LEFT$(TOKEN$,1)<>"@" GOTO *SET_NEIRO_LISTL0
21570  NEXT
21580  IF TOKEN$="@FM" THEN
21590    GOSUB *GET_TOKEN
21600    'BUILDLAYER
21610    IF F=0 THEN F=1:USERDATA 0,0,TOKEN$ ELSE USERDATA TOKEN$
21620    ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=1:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21630    FOR L=0 TO 3
21640     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$  :'FM
21650     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=1:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21660     A$=TOKEN$
21670     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'OP#
21680     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21690     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'W
21700     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21710     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'X
21720     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21730     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'Y
21740     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21750     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'M
21760     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21770     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'S
21780     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21790     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'AR
21800     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21810     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'DR
21820     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21830     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'SR
21840     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21850     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'RR
21860     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21870     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'SL
21880     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21890     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'TL
21900     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21910     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'ml1
21920     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21930     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'ml2
21940     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21950     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'dt
21960     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21970     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'KS
21980     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
21990     IF A$="FMEXT" THEN
22000       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'sn
22010       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22020       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'en
22030       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22040       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'vl
22050       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22060       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'RE
22070       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22080       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'LF
22090       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22100       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'AW
22110       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22120       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'AS
22130       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22140       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'PW
22150       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22160       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'PS
22170       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22180       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'MX
22190       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22200       GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'DP
22210       ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22220     ENDIF
22230    NEXT
22240    GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$:'ENDLAYER
22250    ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=1:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22260  ELSE
22270   'PCM
22280   GOSUB *GET_TOKEN
22290   IF TOKEN$="BUILDLAYER" THEN
22300     IF F=0 THEN F=1:USERDATA 0,0,TOKEN$ ELSE USERDATA TOKEN$
22310     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=1:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22320     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN
22340 *SET_NEIRO_LISTL1
22350     GOSUB *SET_PCM_SUB
22360     GOSUB *GET_TOKEN
22370     IF TOKEN$<>"ENDLAYER" GOTO *SET_NEIRO_LISTL1
22380     USERDATA TOKEN$
22390     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=1:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22400   ELSE
22410     IF F=0 THEN F=1:USERDATA 0,0,TOKEN$ ELSE USERDATA TOKEN$
22420     ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=1:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22430     GOSUB *SET_PCM_SUB1
22440   ENDIF
22450  ENDIF
22460  CLOSE #1
22470 ENDIF
22480 RETURN
22481 *ERR001:RESUME *ERR001EXIT
22482 *ERR001EXIT:ON ERROR GOTO 0:RETURN
22483 *ERR002:RESUME *ERR002EXIT
22484 *ERR002EXIT:ON ERROR GOTO 0:CLOSE #1:RETURN
22500 *SET_PCM_SUB
22510 USERDATA TOKEN$
22520 ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=1:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22540 *SET_PCM_SUB1
22550 GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$
22560 ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=1:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22570 GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA "20",0:'
22580 ARG1$="20":ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22590 GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'
22600 ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22610 GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'sn
22620 ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22630 GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'en
22640 ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22650 GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:USERDATA TOKEN$,0:'bn
22660 ARG1$=TOKEN$:ARG2=0:GOSUB *WRITELINE
22670 RETURN
22690 *WRITELINE
22700 IF ARG2=0 THEN ARG1$="DATA "+ARG1$ ELSE ARG1$="DATA "+CHR$(34)+ARG1$+CHR$(34)
22720 *WRITELINE1
22730 NEI$=NEI$+STR$(LI)+" "+ARG1$+CHR$(13)+CHR$(10)
22740 '? ARG1$
22750 LI=LI+10:RETURN
22760 '--------------------------------------
22770 'Music data operations
22780 '            Version 0.01
22790 '               Programed by Sofiya.
22800 '--------------------------------------
22810 'Initialise
22830 *INIT_TRACK
22840 MAX_F=255:DIM DA_NOTE$(12),DATA_TRACK$(16,MAX_F)
22860 *DA_RES_NOTE:RESTORE *DA_RES_NOTE:DATA "C","C#","D","D#","E","F","F#","G","G#","A","A#","B"
22870 FOR DA_TMP=0 TO 11:READ DA_NOTE$(DA_TMP):NEXT :GOTO *CLEAR_ALL_TRACK
22880 '-----[ CLEAR_ALL_TRACK ]-----
22890 ' Initialise all the data
22910 *CLEAR_ALL_TRACK
22920 FOR DA_TEMP1=0 TO 15
22930  G_MAX_FR(DA_TEMP1)=0
22940  DATA_TRACK$(DA_TEMP1,0)=STRW$(2,65535)+CHR$(0)+CHR$(0)+CHR$(0)
22950  FOR DA_TEMP0=1 TO MAX_F:DATA_TRACK$(DA_TEMP1,DA_TEMP0)="":NEXT
22960 NEXT
22970 FOR DA_TEMP1=0 TO MAX_F
22980  GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TEMP1,0)=0:'Repeat signs
22990  GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TEMP1,1)=S_TEMPO:'Tempo
23000  GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TEMP1,2)=0:'For expansion
23010  GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TEMP1,3)=0:'For expansion
23020 NEXT
23030 RETURN
23040 '-----[ DALINK_SEARCH ]-----
23050 ' Find bar DA_FR
23060 ' ENTRY:
23080 *DALINK_SEARCH
23090 DA_TEMP1=ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,0),2,1))+ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,0),1,1))*256
23100 IF DA_FR=0 OR DA_TEMP1>60000 THEN DA_FR=DA_TEMP1:RETURN
23110 FOR DA_CNT=1 TO DA_FR
23120  DA_TEMP1=ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_TEMP1),2,1))+ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_TEMP1),1,1))*256
23130  IF DA_TEMP1>60000 THEN DA_CNT=DA_FR+1
23140 NEXT
23150 DA_FR=DA_TEMP1
23160 RETURN
23170 '-----[ DALINK_NEXT ]-----
23180 ' The bar after DA_FR
23190 ' ENTRY:
23210 *DALINK_NEXT:DA_FR=ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR),2,1))+ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR),1,1))*256:RETURN
23220 '-----[ DALINK_PREV ]-----
23230 ' The bar before DA_FR
23240 ' ENTRY:
23260 *DALINK_PREV:DA_FR=ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR),4,1))+ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR),3,1))*256:RETURN
23270 '-----[ DALINK_DELETE ]-----
23280 ' Delete bar DA_FR
23300 *DALINK_DELETE
23310 GOSUB *DALINK_SEARCH
23320 DA_TEMP1=ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR),2,1))+ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR),1,1))*256
23330 DA_TEMP2=ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR),4,1))+ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR),3,1))*256
23340 IF DA_TEMP1<=60000 THEN MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_TEMP1),1,2)=DA_TEMP2
23350 MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_TEMP2),1,2)=DA_TEMP1:DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR)=""
23360 G_MAX_FR(DA_CH)=G_MAX_FR(DA_CH)-1:RETURN
23370 '-----[ DALINK_ADD ]-----
23380 ' Add bar DA_FR
23400 *DALINK_ADD
23410 RET=0
23420 'Reserve arrays
23430 DA_TEMP0=0
23450 *DALINK_ADD_LOOP00
23460   DA_TEMP0=DA_TEMP0+1
23470   IF DA_TEMP0>MAX_F THEN RET=1:RETURN :'Can't add any more
23480   IF DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_TEMP0)<>"" GOTO *DALINK_ADD_LOOP00
23490 'Get the last track
23500   DA_TEMP1=ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,0),3,1))*256+ASC(MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,0),4,1))
23510   IF DA_TEMP1>60000 THEN
23520     MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,0),1,4)=STRW$(1,DA_TEMP0)+STRW$(1,DA_TEMP0)
23530     DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_TEMP0)=STRW$(2,65535)+DA_DATA$
23540   ELSE
23550     DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_TEMP0)=STRW$(1,65535)+STRW$(1,DA_TEMP1)+DA_DATA$
23560     MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_TEMP1),1,2)=STRW$(1,DA_TEMP0)
23570     MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,0),3,2)=STRW$(1,DA_TEMP0)
23580   ENDIF
23590 G_MAX_FR(DA_CH)=G_MAX_FR(DA_CH)+1
23600 RETURN
23610 '-----[ DA_SAVE ]-----------
23620 ' Save in the internal OTO format
23630 ' ENTRY
23640 ' DA_FILE_START: first phrase
23650 ' DA_FILE_END  : last phrase
23660 ' 65535 for to the end
23670 ' DA_FILE_TRACK: tracks to save
23680 ' as bits: MSB is track 15
23690 ' LSB is track 0
23700 ' FILENAME$    : file name
23710 '
23730 *DA_SAVE
23740 IF DA_FILE_START>DA_FILE_END THEN RET=-1:RETURN
23750 RET=0:IF DA_FILE_TRACK=0 THEN RETURN
23760 ON ERROR GOTO *DA_SAVE_FILE_OPEN_ERR
23770 OPEN FILENAME$ FOR OUTPUT AS #1
23780 ON ERROR GOTO *DA_SAVE_FWRITE_ERR
23790 SYS_OBJ=255:SYS_MODE=&B1000
23800 SYS_MES_TITLE$="Writing music data":SYS_MES_MESSAGE$=""
23810 GOSUB *SYS_MES_DRAW:GOSUB *SYS_MES_SHOW
23820 FWRITE #1,"OTO000"    :'Write the magic number
23830 FWRITE #1,STRW$(1,80+LEN(N_FILE$)):'Header length
23840 FWRITE #1,LEFT$(COPYRIGHT$+STRING$(80," "),80)
23850 FWRITE #1,N_FILE$
23860 '
23870 FWRITE #1,STRW$(1,MAX_F+1)
23880 FOR DA_TRK=0 TO MAX_F
23890  FWRITE #1,STRW$(1,GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TRK,0)):'Repeat signs
23900  FWRITE #1,STRW$(1,GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TRK,1)):'Tempo
23910  FWRITE #1,STRW$(1,GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TRK,2)):'For expansion
23920  FWRITE #1,STRW$(1,GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TRK,3)):'For expansion
23930 NEXT
23940 '
23950 DA_TEMP=DA_FILE_START-1
23960 DA_TEMP0=0
23980 *DA_SAVE_LOOP00
23990 DA_F=0
24000 DA_TEMP=DA_TEMP+1
24010 DA_TEMP0=DA_TEMP0+1
24020 FOR DA_TRK=0 TO 15
24030  IF (DA_FILE_TRACK AND (2^DA_TRK)) THEN
24040   DA_CH=DA_TRK
24050   DA_FR=DA_TEMP:GOSUB *DALINK_SEARCH
24060   IF DA_FR<=60000 THEN
24070    DA_F=1
24080    FWRITE #1,CHR$(DA_CH)+STRW$(1,DA_TEMP0)
24090    FWRITE #1,STRW$(1,LEN(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR))-4)
24100    FWRITE #1,MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR),5)
24110    SYS_MES_MESSAGE$=CHR$(13)+CHR$(10)+"Track :"+MID$(STR$(DA_CH+1)+"  ",2,3)+CHR$(13)+CHR$(10)+"Phrase:"+MID$(STR$(DA_FR)+"  ",2,3)
24120    GOSUB *SYS_MES_DRAW1
24130   ENDIF
24140  ENDIF
24150 NEXT
24160 IF DA_F=1 AND DA_TEMP<DA_FILE_END THEN GOTO *DA_SAVE_LOOP00
24170 ON ERROR GOTO *DA_SAVE_FILE_CLOSE_ERR
24190 *DA_SAVE_EXIT_CLOSE
24200 CLOSE #1
24210 ON ERROR GOTO 0
24230 *DA_SAVE_EXIT
24240 OBJ(SYS_OBJ,20)=SYS_OBJ
24250 RETURN
24260 'ERROR handling
24280 *DA_SAVE_FILE_OPEN_ERR
24300 *DA_SAVE_FILE_CLOSE_ERR:RET=1
24310 RESUME *DA_SAVE_EXIT
24330 *DA_SAVE_FWRITE_ERR:RET=1
24340 RESUME *DA_SAVE_EXIT_CLOSE
24350 '-----[ DA_LOAD ]-----------
24360 ' Load the internal OTO format
24370 ' ENTRY
24380 ' DA_FILE_TRACK: tracks to load
24390 ' as bits: MSB is track 15
24400 ' LSB is track 0
24410 ' FILENAME$    : file name
24420 '
24440 *DA_LOAD
24450 RET=0:IF DA_FILE_TRACK=0 THEN RETURN
24460 Y=0
24470 ON ERROR GOTO *DA_LOAD_FILE_OPEN_ERR
24480 OPEN FILENAME$ FOR INPUT AS #1
24490 ON ERROR GOTO *DA_LOAD_FREAD_ERR
24500 SYS_OBJ=255:SYS_MES_MODE=&B1000
24510 SYS_MES_TITLE$="Reading music data":SYS_MES_MESSAGE$=""
24520 GOSUB *SYS_MES_DRAW:GOSUB *SYS_MES_SHOW
24530 FREAD #1,F$,5:IF F$<>"OTO000" THEN ERROR 1     :'OTO format?
24540 FREAD #1,F$,2
24550 'Read the HEADER part
24560 DA_LOAD_L=ASC(LEFT$(F$,1))*256+ASC(RIGHT$(F$,1))
24570 FREAD #1,F$,80:COPYRIGHT$=LEFT$(F$,80)
24580 '
24590 IF DA_LOAD_L<>80 THEN
24600  FREAD #1,FILE$,(DA_LOAD_L-80):N_FILE$=FILE$
24610 ENDIF
24620 '
24630 FREAD #1,F$,2:MAX_F=ASC(LEFT$(F$,1))*256+ASC(RIGHT$(F$,1))-1
24640 FOR DA_TRK=0 TO MAX_F
24650  FREAD #1,F$,2:GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TRK,0)=ASC(LEFT$(F$,1))*256+ASC(RIGHT$(F$,1))
24660  FREAD #1,F$,2:GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TRK,1)=ASC(LEFT$(F$,1))*256+ASC(RIGHT$(F$,1)):'Tempo
24670  FREAD #1,F$,2:GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TRK,2)=ASC(LEFT$(F$,1))*256+ASC(RIGHT$(F$,1)):'For expansion
24680  FREAD #1,F$,2:GLOBAL_PRPTY(DA_TRK,3)=ASC(LEFT$(F$,1))*256+ASC(RIGHT$(F$,1)):'For expansion
24690 NEXT
24700 'Read the music part
24710 DA_FILE_START=0:DA_FILE_END=65535
24720 DA_TEMP=DA_FILE_START-1
24740 *DA_LOAD_LOOP00
24750  FREAD #1,F$,5
24760  DA_LOAD_L=ASC(MID$(F$,4,1))*256+ASC(MID$(F$,5,1))
24770  DA_CH=ASC(LEFT$(F$,1))
24780  IF DA_LOAD_L<>0 THEN
24790   FREAD #1,DA_DATA$,DA_LOAD_L
24800   IF (DA_FILE_TRACK AND (2^DA_CH)) THEN
24810    GOSUB *DALINK_ADD:Y=1
24820    SYS_MES_MESSAGE$="           "+CHR$(13)+CHR$(10)+"Track :"+MID$(STR$(DA_CH+1)+"  ",2,3)+CHR$(13)+CHR$(10)+"Phrase:"+MID$(STR$(G_MAX_FR(DA_CH))+"  ",2,3)
24830    GOSUB *SYS_MES_DRAW1
24840   ENDIF
24850  ENDIF
24860 IF LOF(#1)>LOC(#1) GOTO *DA_LOAD_LOOP00
24870 '
24880 ON ERROR GOTO *DA_LOAD_FILE_CLOSE_ERR
24900 *DA_LOAD_EXIT_CLOSE
24910 CLOSE #1
24930 *DA_LOAD_EXIT
24940 ON ERROR GOTO 0
24950 IF RET=0 THEN SYS_MES_MESSAGE$="Tone set: LIST":GOSUB *SYS_MES_DRAW:GOSUB *SET_NEIROLIST
24960 IF RET=0 THEN SYS_MES_MESSAGE$="Tone set: TARG":GOSUB *SYS_MES_DRAW:GOSUB *SET_NEIROSET
24970 OBJ(SYS_OBJ,20)=SYS_OBJ
24980 IF Y=0 THEN DA_CH=0:DA_DATA$="":GOSUB *DALINK_ADD
24982 GOSUB *DRAW_NEIRO
24984 GOSUB *SETNEIRO2ED_TAMA
24990 RETURN
25000 'ERROR handling
25020 *DA_LOAD_FILE_OPEN_ERR
25040 *DA_LOAD_FILE_CLOSE_ERR:RET=1
25050 RESUME *DA_LOAD_EXIT
25070 *DA_LOAD_FREAD_ERR:RET=1
25080 RESUME *DA_LOAD_EXIT_CLOSE
25090 '-----[ GET_TRACK_OTO ]-----
25100 'Get 1 bar in OTO format
25110 ' ENTRY: DA_CH : track number
25120 ' DA_FR : bar number
25130 '  RETURN:ED_TAMA(x,0) : TONE   (-1 - 127)
25140 '         ED_TAMA(x,1) : LENGTH (-1 - 32)
25150 '         ED_TAMA(x,2) : VOLUME ( 0 - 15)
25160 '         ED_TAMA(x,3) : PANPOT ( 0 - 15)
25170 '         ED_TAMA(x,4) : PITCH  ( 0 - 15)
25180 '         ED_TAMA(x,5) : PROGRAM( 0 - 127)
25190 '         ED_TAMA(x,6) : DAMPER( 0 - 127)
25210 *GET_TRACK_OTO
25220 GOSUB *DALINK_SEARCH : 'Search for the bar RET:DA_FR
25230 GOSUB *DA_TRK2OTO    : 'Stored format => OTO format
25240 PAT_L=GLOBAL_PRPTY(G_FR,0) \ 16    :'Left repeat sign
25250 PAT_R=GLOBAL_PRPTY(G_FR,0) AND &HF :'Right repeat sign
25260 S_TEMPO=GLOBAL_PRPTY(G_FR,1)       :'Tempo
25270 RETURN
25280 ' ENTRY: DA_FR : bar number
25290 ' DA_CH : track number
25310 *DA_TRK2OTO
25320 'Initialise
25330 FOR I=0 TO TAMA_Q-1
25340  ED_TAMA(I,0)=-1:ED_TAMA(I,1)=-1
25350  FOR K=2 TO 7:ED_TAMA(I,K)=ED_TAMA(TAMA_Q,K):NEXT
25360 NEXT
25370 'Parameter out of range
25380 IF DA_FR<0 OR DA_FR>60000 OR DA_CH<0 OR DA_CH>15 THEN RETURN
25390 DAT2M_$=DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR)
25400 DAT2M_I=5
25410 V=127
25420 P=64
25430 S_NEIRO=0
25440 D=0
25450 PIT=64
25470 *DA_TRK2MMLLOP0
25480 IF LEN(DAT2M_$)>=DAT2M_I THEN
25490  DAT2M_TMP=ASC(MID$(DAT2M_$,DAT2M_I,1))
25500  IF DAT2M_TMP>=&H80 AND DAT2M_TMP<>255 THEN
25510    KKK=ASC(MID$(DAT2M_$,DAT2M_I+1,1))
25520    'Properties
25530    IF DAT2M_TMP=&H80 THEN
25540      POSI=ASC(MID$(DAT2M_$,DAT2M_I+1,1))*256+ASC(MID$(DAT2M_$,DAT2M_I+2,1)):'OFFSET
25550      DAT2M_I=DAT2M_I+1
25560    ENDIF
25570    I=POSI \ 60
25580    IF DAT2M_TMP=&H81 THEN V=KKK:FOR KKK=I TO TAMA_Q-1:ED_TAMA(KKK,2)=V\8:NEXT :'Velocity
25590    IF DAT2M_TMP=&H82 THEN P=KKK:FOR KKK=I TO TAMA_Q-1:ED_TAMA(KKK,3)=P\8:NEXT :'Pan
25600    IF DAT2M_TMP=&H84 THEN S_NEIRO=KKK:FOR KKK=I TO TAMA_Q-1:ED_TAMA(KKK,5)=S_NEIRO:NEXT :'Tone
25610    IF DAT2M_TMP=&H85 THEN D=KKK:FOR KKK=I TO TAMA_Q-1:ED_TAMA(KKK,6)=D:NEXT :'Damper switch
25620    IF DAT2M_TMP=&H90 THEN PIT=KKK:FOR KKK=I TO TAMA_Q-1:ED_TAMA(KKK,4)=PIT\8:NEXT
25630    IF DAT2M_TMP=&HA0 THEN KKK=KKK-128:SIG_=SGN(KKK):SIG=ABS(KKK):IF SIG_=0 THEN SIG_=1
25640    DAT2M_I=DAT2M_I+2
25650  ELSE
25660    'Tadpole (note head)
25670    TAMA_NOTE=DAT2M_TMP:IF TAMA_NOTE=255 THEN TAMA_NOTE=-1
25680    L=ASC(MID$(DAT2M_$,DAT2M_I+1,1))*256+ASC(MID$(DAT2M_$,DAT2M_I+2,1))
25690    GOSUB *DAT2O_SET
25700    DAT2M_I=DAT2M_I+3
25710  ENDIF
25720  GOTO *DA_TRK2MMLLOP0
25730 ENDIF
25740 '
25750 RETURN
25760 'Place a note head
25780 *DAT2O_SET
25790 I=(POSI \ 60)
25800 ED_TAMA(I,0)=TAMA_NOTE
25810 ED_TAMA(I,1)=L \ 60
25820 FOR KKK=0 TO ED_TAMA(I,1)-1
25830  IF (I+KKK) <= TAMA_Q THEN
25835   ED_TAMA(I+KKK,2)=V\8
25840   ED_TAMA(I+KKK,3)=P\8
25850   ED_TAMA(I+KKK,4)=PIT\8
25860   ED_TAMA(I+KKK,5)=S_NEIRO
25870   ED_TAMA(I+KKK,6)=D
25875  ENDIF
25880 NEXT
25890 RETURN
25900 '-----[ GET_TRACK_OTO ]-----
25910 'Get 1 bar in OTO format
25920 ' ENTRY: DA_CH : track number
25930 ' DA_FR : bar number
25940 '         ED_TAMA(x,0) : TONE   (-1 - 127)
25950 '         ED_TAMA(x,1) : LENGTH (-1 - 32)
25960 '         ED_TAMA(x,2) : VOLUME ( 0 - 15)
25970 '         ED_TAMA(x,3) : PANPOT ( 0 - 15)
25980 '         ED_TAMA(x,4) : PITCH  ( 0 - 15)
25990 '         ED_TAMA(x,5) : PROGRAM( 0 - 127)
26000 '         ED_TAMA(x,6) : DAMPER( 0 - 127)
26020 *PUT_TRACK_OTO
26030 V=127
26040 P=64
26050 S_NEIRO=0
26060 D=0
26070 PIT=64
26080 DA_DATA$=""
26090 'Key 0xA0 128+[MML S command]
26100 DA_DATA$=DA_DATA$+CHR$(&HA0)+CHR$(SIG_*SIG+128)
26110 '
26120 GLOBAL_PRPTY(G_FR,0)=PAT_L*16+PAT_R
26130 GLOBAL_PRPTY(G_FR,1)=S_TEMPO
26140 '
26150 FOR I=0 TO TAMA_Q-1
26160  DA_DATA$=DA_DATA$+CHR$(&H80)+STRW$(1,I*60)
26170  'Properties
26180  IF V<>(ED_TAMA(I,2)*8) THEN V=ED_TAMA(I,2)*8:DA_DATA$=DA_DATA$+CHR$(&H81)+CHR$(ED_TAMA(I,2)*8)
26190  IF P<>(ED_TAMA(I,3)*8) THEN P=ED_TAMA(I,3)*8:DA_DATA$=DA_DATA$+CHR$(&H82)+CHR$(ED_TAMA(I,3)*8)
26200  IF S_NEIRO<>ED_TAMA(I,5) THEN S_NEIRO=ED_TAMA(I,5):DA_DATA$=DA_DATA$+CHR$(&H84)+CHR$(S_NEIRO)
26210  IF D<>ED_TAMA(I,6) THEN D=ED_TAMA(I,6):DA_DATA$=DA_DATA$+CHR$(&H85)+CHR$(ED_TAMA(I,6))
26220  IF PIT<>(ED_TAMA(I,4)*8) THEN PIT=ED_TAMA(I,4)*8:DA_DATA$=DA_DATA$+CHR$(&H90)+CHR$(ED_TAMA(I,4)*8)
26230  '
26240  IF ED_TAMA(I,1)<>-1 THEN
26250   IF ED_TAMA(I,0)=-1 THEN
26260    DA_DATA$=DA_DATA$+CHR$(255)+STRW$(1,ED_TAMA(I,1)*60)
26270   ELSE
26280    DA_DATA$=DA_DATA$+CHR$(ED_TAMA(I,0))+STRW$(1,ED_TAMA(I,1)*60)
26290   ENDIF
26300  ENDIF
26310 NEXT
26320 GOSUB *DALINK_SEARCH
26330 MID$(DATA_TRACK$(DA_CH,DA_FR),5)=DA_DATA$
26340 RETURN
26350 '-------------------
26360 'Fade out
26370 '-------------------
26390 *FADE_OUT :COLOROFS ON 0,1,4,10:FOR S_I=0 TO -255 STEP -5:COLOROFS (S_I,S_I,S_I):VSYNC :NEXT :RETURN
26410 *FADE_OUT0:COLOROFS ON 0,1,4,10:COLOROFS (-255,-255,-255):RETURN
26420 '-------------------
26430 'Fade in
26440 '-------------------
26460 *FADE_IN :COLOROFS ON 0,1,4,10:FOR S_I=-255 TO 0 STEP 5:COLOROFS (S_I,S_I,S_I):VSYNC :NEXT :RETURN
26480 *FADE_IN0:COLOROFS ON 0,1,4,10:COLOROFS (0,0,0):RETURN

26540 DATA 99,99,99,99,99,99,99,99,99, 5,99, 0,99,99,99,99:'00

      ' ... 12 DATA lines not shown (lines 26570-26680) ...

26950 '--[SYS_INIT]---------------------------
26960 ' Initialise the system so it can be used
26970 ' WORK :
26980 '    SYS_I,SYS_J,A$
26990 ' RETURN :
27000 '---------------------------------------
27020 *SYS_INIT
27030 DIM EV(255,2)        :'For the message queue
27040 DIM SYS_MES_NAME$(2) :'Holds the message box button captions
27050 DIM SYS_DEV$(6)      :'For the file selection device
27060 PRINT "GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN System "
27065 PRINT "                    for Sofiya   "
27070 PRINT "                     Version 1.20"
27080 PRINT :VSYNC 60
27090 SPRWINDOW,,,,,0,0
27100 'Set the texture for the cursor
27110 RESTORE *SYS_DATA:READ SYS_K:DIM SYS_PATTERN$(SYS_K+1)
27120 FOR SYS_I=0 TO SYS_K:FOR SYS_J=1 TO 32
27130   READ A$:SYS_PATTERN$(SYS_I)=SYS_PATTERN$(SYS_I)+HEXBIN$(A$)
27140 NEXT :NEXT :A$=""
27150 'Set the icons for the message box
27160 READ SYS_K:DIM SYS_MSGICON$(SYS_K-1+1)
27170 FOR SYS_I=0 TO SYS_K-1
27190 *SYS_LOP1:READ A$:IF A$<>"ENDTEX" THEN SYS_MSGICON$(SYS_I)=SYS_MSGICON$(SYS_I)+HEXBIN$(A$):GOTO *SYS_LOP1
27200 NEXT :A$=""
27210 GOSUB *SYS_DEVICECHECK
27220 'Reserve the textures for the system window
27230 SYS_I=VERTEXID(-1):SETVERTEX,4,(-80,-20,0),(80,-20,0),(80,20,0),(-80,20,0)
27240 SYS_POLYGONID=POLYGONID(-1):SETPOLYGON,1,SYS_I,,(0,1,2,3)
27250 SYS_I=VERTEXID(-1):SETVERTEX,4,(-120,-40,0),(120,-40,0),(120,40,0),(-120,40,0)
27260 SYS_POLYGONID1=POLYGONID(-1):SETPOLYGON,1,SYS_I,,(0,1,2,3)
27270 SYS_TEXID=TEXID(-1):SETTEX,160,40,256
27280 SYS_TEXID1=TEXID(-1):SETTEX,240,80,256
27290 SYS_WINDOW=ATRID(-1):SETATR,1,(0,0,3,SYS_TEXID,0,0)
27300 SYS_WINDOW1=ATRID(-1):SETATR,1,(0,0,3,SYS_TEXID1,0,0)
27310 OBJ(255,0)=7,,,,-16,-16:RETURN
27320 '--[SYS_MOUSEPOINTER]-------------------
27330 ' Change the Shuttle Mouse pointer's shape
27340 ' ENTRY :
27350 ' MOUSEPOINTER  0  normal pointer
27360 ' 1  busy pointer
27370 ' WORK :
27380 ' RETURN :
27390 '---------------------------------------
27410 *SYS_MOUSEPOINTER
27420 LOCK
27430 IF MOUSEPOINTER=0 THEN
27440  INTERVAL (1) OFF
27450  SYS_POINTERTYPE=0:SETTEX 0,32,32,16,SYS_PATTERN$(0)
27460 ELSE
27470  INTERVAL (1) ON,5
27480  SYS_POINTERTYPE=1:SYS_POINTERANIME=0:SETTEX 0,32,32,16,SYS_PATTERN$(1)
27490 ENDIF
27500 UNLOCK :RETURN
27520 *SYS_ANIME
27530 IF SYS_POINTERTYPE=1 THEN
27540  LOCK :SETTEX 0,32,32,16,SYS_PATTERN$(SYS_POINTERANIME+1):SYS_POINTERANIME=SYS_POINTERANIME XOR 1:UNLOCK
27550 ENDIF
27560 RETURN
27570 '--[SYS_DEVICECHECK]--------------------
27580 'Detect the input device
27590 '
27600 ' WORK :
27610 '     SYS_I,SYS_J
27620 '
27630 ' RETURN :
27640 '     SPADMODE
27650 '     SKEYMODE
27660 '     SPADNO
27670 '     SKEYNO
27680 '---------------------------------------
27700 *SYS_DEVICECHECK
27710 PRINT "Detecting input device":PRINT
27720 FOR SYS_I=28 TO 0 STEP -1
27730  SYS_J=PAD(SYS_I,0)
27740  IF SYS_J>=&H0  AND SYS_J<=&HF   AND SPADMODE<>2 THEN SPADNO=SYS_I:SPADMODE=1:PRINT "#";SYS_I;" Control pad found."
27750  IF SYS_J>=&HE0 AND SYS_J<=&HFE THEN SPADNO=SYS_I:SPADMODE=2:PRINT "#";SYS_I;" Shuttle Mouse found."
27760  IF SYS_J>=&H30 AND SYS_J<=&HDF THEN SKEYNO=SYS_I:SKEYMODE=1:PRINT "#";SYS_I;" SEGA Saturn keyboard found."
27770 NEXT
27780 IF SPADMODE<>0 THEN
27790  OBJ(1,0)=7:OBJ(1,16)=0,0:OBJ(1,20)=0:OBJ(1,12)=.5,.5:OBJ(1,6)=-4
27800  COLOR,15,0:CLS 30:OBJ(100,0)=7,,,,6,-4,,,,,,,,,,,20,20,,,1
27810  ON INTERVAL (1) GOSUB *SYS_ANIME
27820  IF SPADMODE=1 THEN ON INTERVAL (0) GOSUB *SYS_PAD
27830  IF SPADMODE=2 THEN ON INTERVAL (0) GOSUB *SYS_MOUSE
27840 ELSE
27850  COLOR 2:PRINT "No input device found":COLOR 7:SCREEN 0:END
27860 ENDIF
27870 VSYNC 20:RETURN
27880 '========================
27890 'Control pad input handling
27900 '========================
27910 '
27920 ' WORK :
27930 ' MB..PAD state
27940 ' MX..Shuttle Mouse pointer X coordinate
27950 ' MY..Shuttle Mouse pointer Y coordinate
27960 ' BR..right button (C) state
27970 ' BC..middle button (B) state
27980 ' BL..left button (A) state
27990 ' BS..start button state
28000 '
28010 ' MX2..Shuttle Mouse pointer X coordinate (previous)
28020 ' MY2..Shuttle Mouse pointer Y coordinate (previous)
28030 ' MR..right button (C) state (previous)
28040 ' MC..middle button (B) state (previous)
28050 ' ML..left button (A) state (previous)
28060 ' MS..start button state (previous)
28070 '
28080 ' TR..right button timer (used for clicks)
28090 ' TC..right button timer (used for clicks)
28100 ' TL..right button timer (used for clicks)
28110 ' TS..right button timer (used for clicks)
28120 '
28130 ' EV(x,0)..kind of event
28140 ' EV(x,1)..Shuttle Mouse X coordinate where the event happened
28150 ' EV(x,2)..Shuttle Mouse Y coordinate where the event happened
28160 '
28180 *SYS_PAD
28190 LOCK :MB=PAD(SPADNO,1)
28200 IF (MB AND &H40) THEN MV=8 ELSE MV=1
28210 IF (MB AND &H8000) THEN MX=MX+MV+1 ELSE IF (MB AND &H4000) THEN MX=MX-MV-1
28220 IF (MB AND &H2000) THEN MY=MY+MV+1 ELSE IF (MB AND &H1000) THEN MY=MY-MV-1
28230 IF MX<0 THEN MX=0 ELSE IF MX>319 THEN MX=319
28240 IF MY<0 THEN MY=0 ELSE IF MY>223 THEN MY=223
28250 OBJ(1,4)=MX,MY
28260 BR=MB AND &H200:BC=MB AND &H100:BL=MB AND &H400:BS=MB AND &H800
28270 IF MX2<>MX OR MY2<>MY THEN EV(EW,0)=-2:GOSUB *QIN_M:MX2=MX:MY2=MY
28280 IF MR AND BR=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=5:GOSUB *QIN
28290 IF MR=0 AND BR THEN EV(EW,0)=4:GOSUB *QIN:TR=15 ELSE TR=TR+(TR>0)
28300 IF BR=0 AND MR AND TR>1 THEN EV(EW,0)=6:GOSUB *QIN:TR=0
28310 IF ML AND BL=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=1:MDC1L=0:GOSUB *QIN
28320 IF BL AND ML=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=0:GOSUB *QIN:TL=14:MDXL=MX:MDYL=MY ELSE TL=TL+(TL>0):IF TL=0 THEN MDCL=0
28330 IF ML AND BL=0 AND TL>1 AND MDC1L=0 THEN
28340   IF ABS(MDXL-MX)<=2 AND ABS(MDYL-MY)<=2 THEN
28350     MDCL=MDCL+1:MDC1L=1
28360     IF MDCL=1 THEN EV(EW,0)=2:GOSUB *QIN
28370     IF MDCL=2 THEN EV(EW,0)=3:GOSUB *QIN:TL=0
28380   ELSE
28390       MDC1L=0:TL=0
28400   ENDIF
28410 ENDIF
28420 IF MC AND BC=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=9:GOSUB *QIN
28430 IF MC=0 AND BC THEN EV(EW,0)=8:GOSUB *QIN:TC=15 ELSE TC=TC+(TC>0)
28440 IF BC=0 AND MC AND TC>1 THEN EV(EW,0)=10:GOSUB *QIN:TC=0
28450 IF MS=0 AND BS THEN TS=15 ELSE TS=TS+(TS>0)
28460 IF BS=0 AND MS AND TS>1 THEN TS=0:EV(EW,0)=12:GOSUB *QIN
28470 MR=BR:ML=BL:MC=BC:MS=BS:UNLOCK :RETURN
28480 '========================
28490 ' Shuttle Mouse input handling
28500 '========================
28510 '
28520 ' WORK :
28530 ' MB..PAD state
28540 ' MX..Shuttle Mouse pointer X coordinate
28550 ' MY..Shuttle Mouse pointer Y coordinate
28560 ' BR..right button (C) state
28570 ' BC..middle button (B) state
28580 ' BL..left button (A) state
28590 ' BS..start button state
28600 '
28610 ' MX2..Shuttle Mouse pointer X coordinate (previous)
28620 ' MY2..Shuttle Mouse pointer Y coordinate (previous)
28630 ' MR..right button (C) state (previous)
28640 ' MC..middle button (B) state (previous)
28650 ' ML..left button (A) state (previous)
28660 ' MS..start button state (previous)
28670 '
28680 ' TR..right button timer (used for clicks)
28690 ' TC..right button timer (used for clicks)
28700 ' TL..right button timer (used for clicks)
28710 ' TS..right button timer (used for clicks)
28720 '
28730 ' EV(x,0)..kind of event
28740 ' EV(x,1)..Shuttle Mouse X coordinate where the event happened
28750 ' EV(x,2)..Shuttle Mouse Y coordinate where the event happened
28760 '
28780 *SYS_MOUSE
28790 LOCK :MX1=PAD(SPADNO,3):MY1=PAD(SPADNO,4)
28800 MXV=MX1-MX0:IF MXV<-384 THEN MXV=65535-MX0+MX1 ELSE IF MXV>384 THEN MXV=65535+MX0-MX1
28810 MYV=MY1-MY0:IF MYV<-384 THEN MYV=65535-MY0+MY1 ELSE IF MYV>384 THEN MYV=65535+MY0-MY1
28820 MX=MX+MXV:MY=MY+MYV
28830 IF MX<0 THEN MX=0 ELSE IF MX>319 THEN MX=319
28840 IF MY<0 THEN MY=0 ELSE IF MY>223 THEN MY=223
28850 OBJ(1,4)=MX,MY
28860 MX0=MX1:MY0=MY1
28870 MB=PAD(SPADNO,1):BR=MB AND &H200:BC=MB AND &H100:BL=MB AND &H400:BS=MB AND &H800
28880 IF MX2<>MX OR MY2<>MY THEN EV(EW,0)=-2:GOSUB *QIN_M:MX2=MX:MY2=MY
28890 IF MR AND BR=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=5:GOSUB *QIN
28900 IF MR=0 AND BR THEN EV(EW,0)=4:GOSUB *QIN:TR=15 ELSE TR=TR+(TR>0)
28910 IF BR=0 AND MR AND TR>1 THEN EV(EW,0)=6:GOSUB *QIN:TR=0
28920 IF ML AND BL=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=1:MDC1L=0:GOSUB *QIN
28930 IF BL AND ML=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=0:GOSUB *QIN:TL=14:MDXL=MX:MDYL=MY ELSE TL=TL+(TL>0):IF TL=0 THEN MDCL=0
28940 IF ML AND BL=0 AND TL>1 AND MDC1L=0 THEN
28950   IF ABS(MDXL-MX)<=2 AND ABS(MDYL-MY)<=2 THEN
28960     MDCL=MDCL+1:MDC1L=1
28970     IF MDCL=1 THEN EV(EW,0)=2:GOSUB *QIN
28980     IF MDCL=2 THEN EV(EW,0)=3:GOSUB *QIN:TL=0
28990   ELSE
29000       MDC1L=0:TL=0
29010   ENDIF
29020 ENDIF
29030 IF MC AND BC=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=9:GOSUB *QIN
29040 IF MC=0 AND BC THEN EV(EW,0)=8:GOSUB *QIN:TC=15 ELSE TC=TC+(TC>0)
29050 IF BC=0 AND MC AND TC>1 THEN EV(EW,0)=10:GOSUB *QIN:TC=0
29060 IF MS=0 AND BS THEN TS=15 ELSE TS=TS+(TS>0)
29070 IF BS=0 AND MS AND TS>1 THEN TS=0:EV(EW,0)=12:GOSUB *QIN
29080 MR=BR:ML=BL:MC=BC:MS=BS:UNLOCK :RETURN
29090 'Write a message to the message queue
29110 *QIN_M
29120 IF EW<>0 THEN
29130  IF EV(EW-1,0)=-2 THEN EW=EW-1
29140 ELSE
29150  IF EV(255,0)=-2 AND ER<>0 THEN EW=255
29160 ENDIF
29180 *QIN:EV(EW,1)=MX:EV(EW,2)=MY:EW=(EW+1) AND 255:RETURN
29190 'Read a message from the message queue
29210 *QOUT
29220 MMF$=INKEY$:IF MMF$<>"" THEN EVENT=-3:MMF=1:EVENTX=ASC(MMF$):RETURN
29230 IF MMF$="" AND MMF=1 THEN MMF=0:EVENT=-3:EVENTX=-1:RETURN
29240 IF ER=EW GOTO *QOUT
29250 LOCK :EVENT=EV(ER,0):EVENTX=EV(ER,1):EVENTY=EV(ER,2):EV(ER,0)=-99:ER=(ER+1) AND 255:UNLOCK :RETURN
29252 *QOUT1:IF ER=EW THEN RETURN
29254 EVENT=EV(ER,0):EVENTX=EV(ER,1):EVENTY=EV(ER,2):ER=(ER+1) AND 255:RETURN
29260 'Clear the message queue
29280 *QCLEAR:LOCK :ER=EW:UNLOCK :RETURN
29290 '--[SYS_DEVICECHECK]--------------------
29300 'Show a message box
29310 '
29320 ' ENTRY :
29330 ' SYS_MES_TITLE$   string shown in the title
29340 ' SYS_MES_MESSAGE$ message to show
29350 '     SYS_MES_MODE
29360 ' 1 ... rotating display
29370 ' 2 ... zooming display
29380 ' 3 ... ---- (for expansion)
29390 ' 4 ... no sound
29400 ' 5-7 ... kind of icon
29410 ' 0..none
29420 ' 1..warning
29430 ' 2..question
29440 ' 3..danger(?)
29450 '                  4..----
29460 '                  5..----
29470 '                  6..----
29480 '                  7..----
29490 ' 8-9 ... buttons
29500 ' 0..none (shown for about 2 s)
29510 ' 1..1 button
29520 ' 2..2 buttons
29530 '                  3..---
29540 ' WORK :
29550 '     SYS_I,SYS_J
29560 ' RETURN :
29570 '---------------------------------------
29590 *SYS_MESSAGEBOX
29600 SYS_OBJ=255
29610 GOSUB *SYS_MES_DRAW
29620 GOSUB *SYS_MES_SHOW
29630 'Wait for input
29640 SYS_J=0
29650 IF SYS_MES_MODE AND &H180 THEN
29660  GOSUB *QCLEAR
29680 *SYS_MES_LOOP00
29690  GOSUB *QOUT
29700  IF SYS_J<>0 THEN
29710    IF EVENT=1 THEN
29720      SYS_I=SYS_J-1:SYS_B=0:GOSUB *SYS_MES_BUTTONSUB
29730      IF ABS(EVENTX-209+SYS_I*56)<=25 AND ABS(EVENTY-124)<=5 THEN
29740        OBJ(SYS_OBJ,20)=SYS_OBJ:VSYNC :GOTO *QCLEAR
29750      ENDIF
29760      SYS_J=0
29770    ENDIF
29780    GOTO *SYS_MES_LOOP00
29790  ENDIF
29800  IF ABS(EVENTX-160)>80 OR ABS(EVENTY-112)>20 THEN
29810    IF MOUSEPOINTER=0 THEN MOUSEPOINTER=1:GOSUB *SYS_MOUSEPOINTER
29820    IF (EVENT MOD 4)=0 THEN BGM 0
29830    GOTO *SYS_MES_LOOP00

Loads the editor's sprites, textures and palettes, then runs `H_MAIN.B`.

- As `O_SET.B`

### H_MAIN.B: Hibiki: instrument editor

**File:** `H_MAIN.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 147,032 bytes, 3,098 lines. 2,731 lines shown.

An instrument (tone) editor. You browse the built-in tone sets, make new PCM tones from sample files or new FM tones, edit FM algorithms and parameters, arrange tones in a tray and save tone sets.

**Techniques:**

- Tone editing with `TARG` and `TPROP`
- Drawing FM algorithm diagrams
- Trays and scroll bars built from sprites
- A level meter and on-screen keyboard

**Files it uses:** `HIBIKI_0.0` (background), `LST1_00.D`-`LST1_15.D` (tone names)

```

 1010 ' Hibiki Version 1.00
 1020 '    Programed by Script Arts Co.,Ltd.
 1025 '                 Sofiya.
 1030 '------------------------------------------
 1035 '1998/4/2
 1040 SKCLOSE:CLS -1:CLEAR 257,1360,1
 1050 PASS_LEVEL=0
 1060 L=3
 1070 DIM FM_AR(L),FM_DL(L),FM_ML1(L),FM_SN(L),FM_RE(L),FM_PW(L),FM_DR(L),FM_TL(L),FM_ML2(L),FM_EN(L)
 1080 DIM FM_LF(L),FM_PS(L),FM_SR(L),FM_W(L),FM_S(L),FM_DT(L),FM_AW(L),FM_MX(L),FM_RR(L),FM_M(L),FM_KS(L)
 1090 DIM FM_VL(L),FM_AS(L),FM_DP(L),FM_X(L),FM_Y(L),FM_EXT(L)
 1100 '
 1110 LD_DEV$="CD:"
 1120 'LD_DEV$="COM:"
 1130 DIM WIN(50,7)
 1140 DIM TRAY$(128,4),LSTSE(10)
 1150 DIM LIST_$(128,4)
 1160 GOSUB *NEIROINIT :' Initialise tones
 1170 GOSUB *INIT
 1180 '
 1190 FILE$=LD_DEV$+"LST1_00.D":GOSUB *SET_NEIROLIST
 1200 GOSUB *SYS_INIT
 1210 SCREEN_MODE=0:GOSUB *SHOW_SCREEN
 1220 INTERVAL (0) ON,1:'for SYSTEM(MOUSE)
 1230 '=========
 1240 'Main loop
 1250 '=========
 1260 CAPTURE=-1
 1270 ACTIVE 0
 1290 *MAINLOOP
 1300  GOSUB *QOUT
 1310  IF CAPTURE<>-1 THEN J=CAPTURE:GOSUB *MAIN_PATCH:GOTO *MAINLOOP:'Capture
 1320  IF EVENT=-3 THEN GOSUB *MAIN_KEYACC:GOTO *MAINLOOP:'Keyboard accelerator handling
 1330  IF EVENT=12 AND SCREEN_MODE=3 THEN
 1340   'INSERT
 1350   IF FM_PROGRAM<0 THEN
 1360    GOSUB *NEIRO_ADD_FM
 1370   ELSE
 1380    ARG1=FM_PROGRAM
 1390    ARG2$=FM_NAME$
 1400    ARG3$=NEIROSETFILENAME$
 1410    GOSUB *NEIRO_UPDATE
 1420   ENDIF
 1430   FILE$=NEIROSETFILENAME$:GOSUB *SET_NEIROLIST
 1440   SCREEN_MODE=0:GOSUB *SHOW_SCREEN
 1450   GOTO *MAINLOOP
 1460  ENDIF
 1470  'Hit test
 1480  FOR J=0 TO 21
 1490   'ACTIVE 0:LINE(WIN(J,0),WIN(J,2))-(WIN(J,1),WIN(J,3)),1+RND(10),B
 1500   IF WIN(J,4)=1 AND EVENTY>=WIN(J,2) AND EVENTY<=WIN(J,3) THEN GOSUB *HITCHECK2
 1510  NEXT
 1520 GOTO *MAINLOOP
 1540 *HITCHECK2:IF EVENTX<WIN(J,0) OR EVENTX>WIN(J,1) THEN RETURN
 1560 *MAIN_PATCH
 1570 IF SCREEN_MODE=3 THEN
 1580  'FM mode
 1590  IF J<10 THEN
 1600   ON J+1 GOSUB *BTN_LOAD,*BTN_SAVE,*BTN_SEL,*BTN_SAVE2,*BTN_NOP,*BTN_SYS,*SYS_MOVE,*FM_ALGO,*FM_PROGRAMNO,*FM_NAME
 1610  ELSE
 1620   ON J-9 GOSUB *FM_EXT0,*FM_WIN0,*FM_LAY0,*FM_EXT1,*BTN_NOP,*FM_LAY1,*FM_EXT2,*BTN_NOP,*FM_LAY2,*FM_EXT3,*BTN_NOP,*FM_LAY3
 1630  ENDIF
 1640 ELSE
 1650  IF J<7 THEN
 1660   ON J+1 GOSUB *BTN_LOAD,*BTN_SAVE,*BTN_SEL,*BTN_SAVE2,*BTN_NOP,*BTN_SYS,*SYS_MOVE
 1670  ELSE
 1680   ON J-6 GOSUB *TRA,*TRA,*VSCR_BAR1,*VSCR_BAR1,*VSCR_BAR2,*VSCR_BAR2,*T_CLIENT,*HSCR_BAR1,*HSCR_BAR1,*HSCR_BAR2,*HSCR_BAR2,*BTN_NOP,*BTN_NOP,*CLIENT
 1690  ENDIF
 1700 ENDIF
 1710 J=1000
 1730 *BTN_NOP
 1740 RETURN
 1750 'Keyboard accelerator handling
 1770 *MAIN_KEYACC
 1780 'IF EVENTX=-1       THEN PLAY "%0Rl15"
 1790 IF EVENTX=ASC("c") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1(CEG)"
 1800 IF EVENTX=ASC("v") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1(DFA)"
 1810 IF EVENTX=ASC("b") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1(EGB)"
 1820 IF EVENTX=ASC("n") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1(FA>C)"
 1830 IF EVENTX=ASC("m") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1(GB>D)"
 1840 IF EVENTX=ASC("<") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1(A>CE)"
 1850 IF EVENTX=ASC(">") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1(B>DF)"
 1860 '
 1870 IF EVENTX=ASC("C") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1C2"
 1880 IF EVENTX=ASC("V") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1D2"
 1890 IF EVENTX=ASC("B") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1E2"
 1900 IF EVENTX=ASC("N") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1F2"
 1910 IF EVENTX=ASC("M") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1G2"
 1920 IF EVENTX=ASC(",") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1A2"
 1930 IF EVENTX=ASC(".") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1B2"
 1940 IF EVENTX=ASC(" ") THEN EFFECT -1,"@1N"+STR$(INT((TPROP(1,0,10)+TPROP(1,0,11))\2))+"'2"
 1950 RETURN
 1960 '======================
 1970 'FM-related
 1980 '======================
 1990 'Algorithm
 2010 *FM_ALGO
 2020 IF EVENT=0 THEN FM_ALGO=(FM_ALGO+1) MOD 9:GOSUB *FM_ALGO_DRAW:RETURN
 2030 IF EVENT=8 THEN FM_ALGO=0                :GOSUB *FM_ALGO_DRAW:RETURN
 2040 IF EVENT=4 THEN
 2050   FM_ALGO=FM_ALGO-1
 2060   IF FM_ALGO<0 THEN FM_ALGO=8
 2070   GOSUB *FM_ALGO_DRAW
 2080   RETURN
 2090 ENDIF
 2100 RETURN
 2110 'Program number handling
 2130 *FM_PROGRAMNO
 2140 IF EVENT=0 THEN
 2150  FM_PROGRAM=FM_PROGRAM+1
 2160  GOSUB *FM_PROGRAM_DRAW
 2170 ENDIF
 2180 IF EVENT=4 THEN
 2190  FM_PROGRAM=FM_PROGRAM-1
 2200  IF FM_PROGRAM<0 THEN FM_PROGRAM=0
 2210  GOSUB *FM_PROGRAM_DRAW
 2220 ENDIF
 2230 RETURN
 2240 '-------------
 2250 'Name handling
 2260 '-------------
 2280 *FM_NAME
 2290 IF EVENT=0 THEN X=18:Y=2:S=16:RET$=FM_NAME$:GOSUB *TEXT_INPUT
 2300 RETURN
 2320 *TEXT_INPUT
 2330 A$="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_"
 2340 ED=1
 2350 LOCATE X,Y:COLOR 6:PRINT MID$(RET$,1,S)
 2360 GOSUB *TEXT_INPUT_L
 2370 FM_NAME$=RET$
 2380 GOSUB *FM_PROGRAM_DRAW
 2390 RETURN
 2400 'Parameter part
 2420 *FM_LAY3:L=3:GOTO *FM_LAY_S
 2440 *FM_LAY2:L=2:GOTO *FM_LAY_S
 2460 *FM_LAY1:L=1:GOTO *FM_LAY_S
 2480 *FM_LAY0:L=0
 2500 *FM_LAY_S
 2510 IF EVENT=-2 AND CAPTURE<>-1 THEN
 2520  IF C_MODE=1 THEN
 2530   P=HSX1+HSX-(EVENTX \ 8)
 2540   GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW_TEXT
 2550  ENDIF
 2560  RETURN
 2570 ENDIF
 2580 IF EVENT=8 AND CAPTURE=-1 THEN
 2590   C_MODE=1
 2600   CAPTURE=J
 2610   HSX=(EVENTX \ 8)
 2620   HSX1=P
 2630   RETURN
 2640 ENDIF
 2650 IF EVENT=9 AND CAPTURE<>-1 THEN
 2660  C_MODE=0
 2670  CAPTURE=-1
 2680  P=HSX1+HSX-(EVENTX \ 8)
 2690  GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW_TEXT
 2700  RETURN
 2710 ENDIF
 2720 IF EVENT=0 THEN
 2730  XX=(EVENTX-WIN(J,0))\8+P
 2740  YY=(EVENTY-WIN(J,2))\8
 2750  LOCATE 0,0:PRINT L,XX,YY
 2760  IF XX>=3 AND XX<=4 THEN
 2770    IF YY=0 THEN FM_AR(L)=(FM_AR(L)+1) MOD 32
 2780    IF YY=1 THEN FM_DR(L)=(FM_DR(L)+1) MOD 32
 2790    IF YY=2 THEN FM_SR(L)=(FM_SR(L)+1) MOD 32
 2800    IF YY=3 THEN FM_RR(L)=(FM_RR(L)+1) MOD 32
 2810    TPROP(1,L,20)=FM_AR(L),FM_DR(L),FM_SR(L),FM_RR(L)
 2820    X=0
 2830    Y=5*L+4
 2840    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 2850    GOSUB *ENV_DRAW
 2860    RETURN
 2870  ENDIF
 2880  IF XX>=9 AND XX<=11 THEN
 2890    IF YY=0 THEN FM_DL(L)=(FM_DL(L)+1) MOD 32
 2900    IF YY=1 THEN FM_TL(L)=FM_TL(L)+1:IF FM_TL(L)>255  THEN FM_TL(L)=0
 2910    IF YY=2 THEN FM_W(L)=FM_W(L)+1:IF FM_W(L)>47 THEN FM_W(L)=1
 2920    IF YY=3 THEN FM_M(L)=FM_M(L)+1:IF FM_M(L)>15 THEN FM_M(L)=1
 2930    TPROP(1,L,24)=FM_DL(L)
 2940    X=0
 2950    Y=5*L+4
 2960    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 2970    GOSUB *ENV_DRAW
 2980    RETURN
 2990  ENDIF
 3000  IF XX>=17 AND XX<=19 THEN
 3010    IF YY=0 THEN FM_ML1(L)=FM_ML1(L)+1:IF FM_ML1(L)>65 THEN FM_ML1(L)=0
 3020    IF YY=1 THEN FM_ML2(L)=FM_ML2(L)+1:IF FM_ML2(L)>4  THEN FM_ML2(L)=0
 3030    IF YY=2 THEN FM_S(L)=FM_S(L)+1:IF FM_S(L)>7  THEN FM_S(L)=0
 3040    IF YY=3 THEN FM_KS(L)=FM_KS(L)+1:IF FM_KS(L)>14 THEN FM_KS(L)=-1
 3050    TPROP(1,L,27)=FM_KS(L)
 3060    X=0
 3070    Y=5*L+4
 3080    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 3090    RETURN
 3100  ENDIF
 3110  IF XX>=24 AND XX<=26 THEN
 3120    IF YY=0 AND FM_EXT(L)<>0 THEN FM_SN(L)=FM_SN(L)+1:IF FM_SN(L)>FM_EN(L) THEN FM_SN(L)=0
 3130    IF YY=1 AND FM_EXT(L)<>0 THEN FM_EN(L)=FM_EN(L)+1:IF FM_EN(L)>127 THEN FM_EN(L)=FM_SN(L)
 3140    IF YY=2 THEN FM_DT(L)=FM_DT(L)+1:IF FM_DT(L)>127 THEN FM_DT(L)=-128
 3150    IF YY=3 AND FM_EXT(L)<>0 THEN FM_VL(L)=1-FM_VL(L)
 3160    TPROP(1,L,10)=FM_SN(L),FM_EN(L)
 3170    X=0
 3180    Y=5*L+4
 3190    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 3200    RETURN
 3210  ENDIF
 3220  IF FM_EXT(L)<>0 AND XX>=31 AND XX<=33 THEN
 3230    IF YY=0 THEN FM_RE(L)=1-FM_RE(L)
 3240    IF YY=1 THEN FM_LF(L)=FM_LF(L)+1:IF FM_LF(L)>31 THEN FM_LF(L)=0
 3250    IF YY=2 THEN FM_AW(L)=FM_AW(L)+1:IF FM_AW(L)>3 THEN FM_AW(L)=0
 3260    IF YY=3 THEN FM_AS(L)=FM_AS(L)+1:IF FM_AS(L)>7 THEN FM_AS(L)=0
 3270    TPROP(1,L,50)=FM_RE(L),FM_LF(L),FM_AW(L),FM_AS(L)
 3280    X=0
 3290    Y=5*L+4
 3300    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 3310    RETURN
 3320  ENDIF
 3330  IF FM_EXT(L)<>0 AND XX>=38 AND XX<=40 THEN
 3340    IF YY=0 THEN FM_PW(L)=FM_PW(L)+1:IF FM_PW(L)>3 THEN FM_PW(L)=0
 3350    IF YY=1 THEN FM_PS(L)=FM_PS(L)+1:IF FM_PS(L)>7 THEN FM_PS(L)=0
 3360    IF YY=2 THEN FM_MX(L)=FM_MX(L)+1:IF FM_MX(L)>7 THEN FM_MX(L)=0
 3370    IF YY=3 THEN FM_DP(L)=FM_DP(L)+1:IF FM_DP(L)>31 THEN FM_DP(L)=0
 3380    TPROP(1,L,54)=FM_PW(L),FM_PS(L)
 3390    TPROP(1,L,71)=FM_MX(L),,FM_DP(L)
 3400    X=0
 3410    Y=5*L+4
 3420    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 3430    RETURN
 3440  ENDIF
 3450 ENDIF
 3460 IF EVENT=4 THEN
 3470  XX=(EVENTX-WIN(J,0))\8+P
 3480  YY=(EVENTY-WIN(J,2))\8
 3490  LOCATE 0,0:PRINT L,XX,YY
 3500  IF XX>=3 AND XX<=4 THEN
 3510    IF YY=0 THEN FM_AR(L)=FM_AR(L)-1:IF FM_AR(L)<0 THEN FM_AR(L)=31
 3520    IF YY=1 THEN FM_DR(L)=FM_DR(L)-1:IF FM_DR(L)<0 THEN FM_DR(L)=31
 3530    IF YY=2 THEN FM_SR(L)=FM_SR(L)-1:IF FM_SR(L)<0 THEN FM_SR(L)=31
 3540    IF YY=3 THEN FM_RR(L)=FM_RR(L)-1:IF FM_RR(L)<0 THEN FM_RR(L)=31
 3550    TPROP(1,L,20)=FM_AR(L),FM_DR(L),FM_SR(L),FM_RR(L)
 3560    X=0
 3570    Y=5*L+4
 3580    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 3590    GOSUB *ENV_DRAW
 3600    RETURN
 3610  ENDIF
 3620  IF XX>=9 AND XX<=11 THEN
 3630    IF YY=0 THEN FM_DL(L)=FM_DL(L)-1:IF FM_DL(L)<0 THEN FM_DL(L)=31
 3640    IF YY=1 THEN FM_TL(L)=FM_TL(L)-1:IF FM_TL(L)<0 THEN FM_TL(L)=255
 3650    IF YY=2 THEN FM_W(L)=FM_W(L)-1:IF FM_W(L)<1 THEN FM_W(L)=47
 3660    IF YY=3 THEN FM_M(L)=FM_M(L)-1:IF FM_M(L)<1 THEN FM_M(L)=15
 3670    TPROP(1,L,24)=FM_DL(L)
 3680    X=0
 3690    Y=5*L+4
 3700    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 3710    GOSUB *ENV_DRAW
 3720    RETURN
 3730  ENDIF
 3740  IF XX>=17 AND XX<=19 THEN
 3750    IF YY=0 THEN FM_ML1(L)=FM_ML1(L)-1:IF FM_ML1(L)<0 THEN FM_ML1(L)=65
 3760    IF YY=1 THEN FM_ML2(L)=FM_ML2(L)-1:IF FM_ML2(L)<0 THEN FM_ML2(L)=4
 3770    IF YY=2 THEN FM_S(L)=FM_S(L)-1:IF FM_S(L)<0  THEN FM_S(L)=7
 3780    IF YY=3 THEN FM_KS(L)=FM_KS(L)-1:IF FM_KS(L)<-1 THEN FM_KS(L)=14
 3790    TPROP(1,L,27)=FM_KS(L)
 3800    X=0
 3810    Y=5*L+4
 3820    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 3830    RETURN
 3840  ENDIF
 3850  IF XX>=24 AND XX<=26 THEN
 3860    IF YY=0 AND FM_EXT(L)<>0 THEN FM_SN(L)=FM_SN(L)-1:IF FM_SN(L)<0 THEN FM_SN(L)=FM_EN(L)
 3870    IF YY=1 AND FM_EXT(L)<>0 THEN FM_EN(L)=FM_EN(L)-1:IF FM_EN(L)<FM_SN(L) THEN FM_EN(L)=127
 3880    IF YY=2 THEN FM_DT(L)=FM_DT(L)-1:IF FM_DT(L)<-128 THEN FM_DT(L)=127
 3890    IF YY=3 AND FM_EXT(L)<>0 THEN FM_VL(L)=1-FM_VL(L)
 3900    TPROP(1,L,10)=FM_SN(L),FM_EN(L)
 3910    X=0
 3920    Y=5*L+4
 3930    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 3940    RETURN
 3950  ENDIF
 3960  IF FM_EXT(L)<>0 AND XX>=31 AND XX<=33 THEN
 3970    IF YY=0 THEN FM_RE(L)=1-FM_RE(L)
 3980    IF YY=1 THEN FM_LF(L)=FM_LF(L)-1:IF FM_LF(L)<0 THEN FM_LF(L)=31
 3990    IF YY=2 THEN FM_AW(L)=FM_AW(L)-1:IF FM_AW(L)<0 THEN FM_AW(L)=3
 4000    IF YY=3 THEN FM_AS(L)=FM_AS(L)-1:IF FM_AS(L)<0 THEN FM_AS(L)=7
 4010    TPROP(1,L,50)=FM_RE(L),FM_LF(L),FM_AW(L),FM_AS(L)
 4020    X=0
 4030    Y=5*L+4
 4040    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 4050    RETURN
 4060  ENDIF
 4070  IF FM_EXT(L)<>0 AND XX>=38 AND XX<=40 THEN
 4080    IF YY=0 THEN FM_PW(L)=FM_PW(L)-1:IF FM_PW(L)<0 THEN FM_PW(L)=3
 4090    IF YY=1 THEN FM_PS(L)=FM_PS(L)-1:IF FM_PS(L)<0 THEN FM_PS(L)=7
 4100    IF YY=2 THEN FM_MX(L)=FM_MX(L)-1:IF FM_MX(L)<0 THEN FM_MX(L)=7
 4110    IF YY=3 THEN FM_DP(L)=FM_DP(L)-1:IF FM_DP(L)<0 THEN FM_DP(L)=31
 4120    TPROP(1,L,54)=FM_PW(L),FM_PS(L)
 4130    TPROP(1,L,71)=FM_MX(L),,FM_DP(L)
 4140    X=0
 4150    Y=5*L+4
 4160    GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 4170    RETURN
 4180  ENDIF
 4190 ENDIF
 4200 RETURN
 4220 *FM_EXT1:L=1:GOTO *FM_EXT_L
 4240 *FM_EXT2:L=2:GOTO *FM_EXT_L
 4260 *FM_EXT3:L=3:GOTO *FM_EXT_L
 4280 *FM_EXT0:L=0
 4300 *FM_EXT_L
 4310 IF EVENT=0 THEN
 4320   FM_EXT(L)=1-FM_EXT(L)
 4330   X=0
 4340   Y=5*L+4
 4350   GOSUB *LAYER_DRAW2
 4360 ENDIF
 4370 RETURN
 4390 *FM_WIN0
 4400 L=0
 4410 IF EVENT=8 THEN
 4420   W_MODE=(W_MODE+1) MOD 3
 4430   X=0
 4440   FOR L=0 TO 3
 4450    Y=5*L+4
 4460    IF W_MODE=0 THEN
 4470     GOSUB *ENV_DRAW
 4480    ELSE
 4490     IF W_MODE=1 THEN W=FM_AW(L)
 4500     IF W_MODE=2 THEN W=FM_PW(L)
 4510     GOSUB *WAV_DRAW
 4520    ENDIF
 4530   NEXT
 4540 ENDIF
 4550 RETURN
 4560 '
 4580 *TEXT_INPUT_L
 4590 GOSUB *QOUT
 4600 IF EVENT=-3 THEN
 4610  IF EVENTX=27 OR EVENTX=13 THEN RETURN :'ESC or Return
 4620  IF EVENTX>=0 AND EVENT<=255 THEN
 4630   IF INSTR(A$,CHR$(EVENTX)) THEN
 4640    MID$(RET$,ED,1)=CHR$(EVENTX)
 4650    IF ED<S THEN ED=ED+1
 4660    GOSUB *TEXT_INPUT_S0
 4670    GOTO *TEXT_INPUT_L
 4680   ENDIF
 4690  ENDIF
 4700  IF EVENTX=29 OR EVENTX=8 THEN :'BS or Left
 4710   MID$(RET$,ED,1)=" "
 4720   IF ED>1 THEN ED=ED-1
 4730   GOSUB *TEXT_INPUT_S0
 4740   GOTO *TEXT_INPUT_L
 4750  ENDIF
 4760 ENDIF
 4770 IF EVENT=2 THEN :'CLICK
 4780  IF EVENTY>=Y*8+8 AND EVENTY<=Y*8+15 AND EVENTX>=X*8+8 AND EVENTX<X*8+S*8+8 THEN
 4790   PO=(EVENTX-X*8)\8
 4800   IF ED=PO THEN
 4810    IF INSTR(A$,MID$(RET$,ED,1))<LEN(A$) THEN
 4820     MID$(RET$,ED,1)=MID$(A$,INSTR(A$,MID$(RET$,ED,1))+1,1)
 4830    ELSE
 4840     MID$(RET$,ED,1)=LEFT$(A$,1)
 4850    ENDIF
 4860    GOSUB *TEXT_INPUT_S0
 4870    GOTO *TEXT_INPUT_L
 4880   ELSE
 4890    ED=PO
 4900    GOSUB *TEXT_INPUT_S0
 4910    GOTO *TEXT_INPUT_L
 4920   ENDIF
 4930  ENDIF
 4940 ENDIF
 4950 IF EVENT=6 THEN :'CLICK
 4960  IF EVENTY>=Y*8+8 AND EVENTY<=Y*8+15 AND EVENTX>=X*8+8 AND EVENTX<X*8+S*8+8 THEN
 4970   PO=(EVENTX-X*8)\8
 4980   IF ED=PO THEN
 4990    IF INSTR(A$,MID$(RET$,ED,1))>1 THEN
 5000     MID$(RET$,ED,1)=MID$(A$,INSTR(A$,MID$(RET$,ED,1))-1,1)
 5010    ELSE
 5020     MID$(RET$,ED,1)=RIGHT$(A$,1)
 5030    ENDIF
 5040    GOSUB *TEXT_INPUT_S0
 5050    GOTO *TEXT_INPUT_L
 5060   ELSE
 5070    ED=PO
 5080    GOSUB *TEXT_INPUT_S0
 5090    GOTO *TEXT_INPUT_L
 5100   ENDIF
 5110  ENDIF
 5120 ENDIF
 5130 IF EVENT=12 THEN RETURN
 5140 GOTO *TEXT_INPUT_L
 5160 *TEXT_INPUT_S0
 5170 LOCATE X     ,Y:COLOR 6:PRINT MID$(RET$, 1,S)
 5180 LOCATE X+ED-1,Y:COLOR 5:PRINT MID$(RET$,ED,1)
 5190 RETURN
 5200 '======================

 5220 '======================
 5230 '----------------------
 5240 'System menu title bar
 5250 '----------------------
 5270 *SYS_MOVE
 5280 IF EVENT=-2 AND CAPTURE<>-1 THEN OBJ(64,4)=EVENTX-HSX,EVENTY-HSY:RETURN
 5290 IF EVENT=0  AND CAPTURE=-1  THEN CAPTURE=J:HSX=EVENTX-OBJ(64,4):HSY=EVENTY-OBJ(64,5):RETURN
 5300 IF EVENT=1  AND CAPTURE<>-1 THEN OBJ(64,4)=EVENTX-HSX,EVENTY-HSY:CAPTURE=-1:GOTO *SET_SYSMENUPOS0
 5310 RETURN

 5380 RETURN

 5600 '----------------------

 5680 'Load button handling
 5690 '----------------------
 5710 *FUNC_LOAD
 5720 SYS_SAVEFLAG=0:GOSUB *SYS_FILESELECT:COLOR,0,0
 5730 IF SYS_FILENAME$="" THEN RETURN
 5740 RET=0
 5750 ON ERROR GOTO *FUNC_LOAD_ERR0
 5760 OPEN SYS_FILENAME$ FOR INPUT AS #1
 5770 ON ERROR GOTO *FUNC_LOAD_ERR1
 5780 IF SCREEN_MODE=0 THEN
 5790  CLS 22
 5800  MAX_TY=0
 5810 ENDIF
 5830 *FUNC_LOADL0
 5840 IF SCREEN_MODE=0 THEN
 5850  GOSUB *GET_TOKEN
 5860  IF INSTR("@#",LEFT$(TOKEN$,1))<>0 THEN
 5870   TRAY$(MAX_TY,0)=TOKEN$
 5880   GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:TRAY$(MAX_TY,1)=TOKEN$
 5890   GOSUB *GET_TOKEN:TRAY$(MAX_TY,2)=TOKEN$
 5900   TY=MAX_TY
 5910   MAX_TY=MAX_TY+1
 5920   GOSUB *TRAY_PRINT
 5930   IF LOF(1)>LOC(1) GOTO *FUNC_LOADL0
 5940  ELSE
 5950   RET=1
 5960  ENDIF
 5970 ENDIF
 5990 *FUNC_LOAD_EXIT1
 6000 ON ERROR GOTO *FUNC_LOAD_ERR2
 6010 CLOSE #1
 6030 *FUNC_LOAD_EXIT2
 6050 *FUNC_LOAD_EXIT0
 6060 ON ERROR GOTO 0
 6070 IF RET<>0 THEN
 6080  'Error handling
 6090  SYS_MES_TITLE$="":SYS_MES_MESSAGE$="An error occurred":SYS_MES_NAME$(0)="Ok"
 6100  SYS_MES_MODE=&B10110011:GOSUB *SYS_MESSAGEBOX:COLOR,0,0
 6110 ENDIF

 9750 *GET_NO

 9770 Y=(EVENTY \ 8)-5
 9780 FOR I=0 TO 8
 9790  IF (X-1)<=LSTSE(I) THEN RET=Y+I*18:I=10

 9830 *CLIENT

 9850   IF C_MODE=1 THEN
 9860     SX=HSX1+HSX-(EVENTX \ 8)
 9870     GOSUB *TEXT_PRINT
 9880   ENDIF
 9890   RETURN
 9900 ENDIF
 9910 'Left double-click (add tone to the tray)
 9920 IF EVENT=3 AND EVENTX>8 AND EVENTY<182 AND EVENTY>38 AND MAX_TY<128 THEN
 9930   GOSUB *NEIRO_MAXNO:ARG1=RET
 9940   GOSUB *GET_NO
 9950   IF RET>=ARG1 THEN RETURN
 9960   IF USER_NEIRO=1 AND RET=ARG1-1 GOTO *NEW_NEIRO
 9970   TRAY$(MAX_TY,0)=LIST_$(RET,0)
 9980   TRAY$(MAX_TY,1)=LIST_$(RET,1)
 9990   TRAY$(MAX_TY,2)=LIST_$(RET,2)
10000   MAX_TY=MAX_TY+1
10010   GOSUB *TRAY_PRINT
10020   RETURN
10030 ENDIF
10040 'Left click (set the tone)
10050 IF EVENT=2 AND EVENTX>8 AND EVENTY<182 AND EVENTY>38 THEN
10060   GOSUB *NEIRO_MAXNO:ARG1=RET
10070   GOSUB *GET_NO
10080   IF RET>=ARG1 THEN RETURN
10090   IF USER_NEIRO=1 AND RET=ARG1-1 GOTO *NEW_NEIRO
10100   IF RET<>N_NE THEN N_NE=RET:GOSUB *SET_NEIRO_LIST
10110   RETURN
10120 ENDIF
10130 'Middle-button drag
10140 IF EVENT=8 AND CAPTURE=-1 THEN
10150  C_MODE=1
10160  CAPTURE=J
10170  HSX=(EVENTX \ 8)
10180  HSX1=SX
10190  RETURN
10200 ENDIF
10210 IF EVENT=9 AND CAPTURE<>-1 THEN

10230  CAPTURE=-1
10240  SX=HSX1+HSX-(EVENTX \ 8)
10250  GOSUB *TEXT_PRINT
10260  WIN(14,0)=OBJ(WIN(14,5),4)
10270  WIN(14,1)=WIN(14,0)+15
10280  WIN(15,0)=WIN(14,0)
10290  WIN(15,1)=WIN(14,1)
10300  RETURN
10310 ENDIF

10340  GOSUB *NEIRO_MAXNO:ARG1=RET
10350  GOSUB *GET_NO
10360  IF RET>=ARG1 THEN RETURN
10370  GOSUB *DEL_SUB
10380  RETURN
10390 ENDIF
10400 IF EVENT=12 AND CAPTURE=-1 AND USER_NEIRO=1 THEN
10410  GOSUB *NEIRO_MAXNO:ARG1=RET
10420  GOSUB *GET_NO
10430  IF RET>=ARG1 THEN RETURN
10440  IF LEFT$(LIST_$(RET,0),1)="#" THEN

10460   N_NE=RET:GOSUB *SET_NEIRO_LIST
10470   IF F_FM=1 THEN
10480    'FM_MODE
10490    FM_NAME$=LEFT$(MID$(LIST_$(RET,0),2),16)
10500    SCREEN_MODE=3:GOSUB *SHOW_SCREEN
10510   ENDIF
10520  ENDIF
10530  RETURN
10540 ENDIF
10550 RETURN

12000 *GET_TRAYNO
12010 RET=TY+((EVENTY-4)\8)-4
12020 IF RET>=MAX_TY THEN RET=MAX_TY-1
12030 RETURN
12050 *T_CLIENT
12060 'Right-button click (delete)
12070 IF EVENT=6 AND CAPTURE=-1 THEN
12080  GOSUB *GET_TRAYNO:IF RET<0 THEN RETURN : 'Find the place
12090  'Confirm delete
12100  SYS_MES_TITLE$=""
12110  SYS_MES_MESSAGE$=MID$(TRAY$(RET,0),2,14)+CHR$(10)+CHR$(13)+"Delete it?"
12120  SYS_MES_NAME$(0)="No":SYS_MES_NAME$(1)="Yes"
12130  SYS_MES_MODE=&B100010011:GOSUB *SYS_MESSAGEBOX:COLOR,0,0
12140  IF SYS_I=0 THEN RETURN
12150  FOR KKK=RET TO MAX_TY-2          : 'Delete
12160   TRAY$(KKK,0)=TRAY$(KKK+1,0)
12170   TRAY$(KKK,1)=TRAY$(KKK+1,1)
12180   TRAY$(KKK,2)=TRAY$(KKK+1,2)
12190   TRAY$(KKK,3)=TRAY$(KKK+1,3)
12200  NEXT
12210  IF MAX_TY>0 THEN MAX_TY=MAX_TY-1
12220  CLS 22:GOSUB *TRAY_PRINT              : 'Display
12230  WIN(9,2)=OBJ(20,4)-20
12240  WIN(9,3)=WIN(9,2)+15
12250  WIN(10,2)=WIN(9,2)
12260  WIN(10,3)=WIN(9,3)
12270  RETURN
12280 ENDIF
12290 'Left-button click
12300 IF EVENT=2 AND CAPTURE=-1 THEN
12310  GOSUB *GET_TRAYNO:IF RET<0 THEN RETURN : 'Find the place
12320  GOSUB *SET_NEIRO_TRAY            : 'Set the tone
12330  RETURN
12340 ENDIF
12350 'Left-button double-click
12360 IF EVENT=3 AND CAPTURE=-1 THEN
12370  GOSUB *GET_TRAYNO:IF RET<0 THEN RETURN : 'Find the place
12380  'Switch mode
12390  'Can't change for CD
12400  IF LEFT$(TRAY$(RET,0),1)="#" AND USER_NEIRO=1 THEN
12410   'FM_MODE
12420   FM_NAME$=LEFT$(MID$(TRAY$(RET,0),2),16)
12430   FM_PROGRAM=-1
12440   K=MAX_TY:IF K>MAX_NEIRO THEN K=MAX_NEIRO
12450   FOR I=0 TO K-1
12460    IF TRAY$(I,0)=LIST_$(I,0) AND TRAY$(I,1)=LIST_$(I,1) AND TRAY$(I,2)=LIST_$(I,2) THEN FM_PROGRAM=I
12470   NEXT
12480   IF FM_PROGRAM>=0 THEN SCREEN_MODE=3:GOSUB *SHOW_SCREEN
12490   'PCM_MODE
12500  ENDIF
12510  RETURN
12520 ENDIF
12530 'Middle-button drag
12540 IF EVENT=-2 AND CAPTURE<>-1 THEN
12550   IF C_MODE=1 THEN
12560     TY=VSY1+VSY-(EVENTY \ 8)
12570     GOSUB *TRAY_PRINT
12580   ENDIF
12590   RETURN
12600 ENDIF
12610 IF EVENT=8 AND CAPTURE=-1 THEN
12620   C_MODE=1
12630   CAPTURE=J
12640   VSY=(EVENTY \ 8)
12650   VSY1=TY
12660   RETURN
12670 ENDIF
12680 IF EVENT=9 AND CAPTURE<>-1 THEN
12690  C_MODE=0
12700  CAPTURE=-1
12710  TY=VSY1+VSY-(EVENTY \ 8)
12720  GOSUB *TRAY_PRINT
12730  WIN(9,2)=OBJ(20,4)-20
12740  WIN(9,3)=WIN(9,2)+15
12750  WIN(10,2)=WIN(9,2)
12760  WIN(10,3)=WIN(9,3)
12770  RETURN
12780 ENDIF
12790 RETURN

15260 '---------------------
15270 'Delete a tone (from the list)
15280 '---------------------
15290 'ENTRY:
15300 ' ARG1 : tone number
15310 ' ARG2$: file name
15330 *NEIRO_DEL
15340 GOSUB *NEIRO_MAXNO:RET=RET-1
15350 IF RET<=0 OR RET<(ARG1+1) THEN RETURN
15360 L1$=LIST_$(ARG1,1)
15370 L2$=LIST_$(ARG1,2)
15380 J=0
15390 FOR I=0 TO RET-1
15400  IF LIST_$(I,1)<>L1$ OR LIST_$(I,2)<>L2$ THEN
15410   LIST_$(J,0)=LIST_$(I,0):LIST_$(J,1)=LIST_$(I,1):LIST_$(J,2)=MID$(STR$(J+1),2)
15420   J=J+1
15430  ENDIF
15440 NEXT
15450 MAX_NEIRO=J
15460 OPEN ARG2$ FOR OUTPUT AS #1
15470 IF MAX_NEIRO>0 THEN
15480  FOR I=0 TO MAX_NEIRO-1
15490   FWRITE #1,LIST_$(I,0)+","+LIST_$(I,1)+","+LIST_$(I,2)+CHR$(13)+CHR$(10)
15500  NEXT
15510 ENDIF
15520 CLOSE #1
15530 A$=""
15540 OPEN L1$ FOR INPUT AS #1
15550 B$="":C$=""
15560 FOR I=1 TO VAL(L2$)
15580 *ADLA0:B$=B$+C$:FREAD #1,C$,1:IF C$<>"@" AND LOF(1)>LOC(1) GOTO *ADLA0
15590 NEXT
15600 B$=B$+A$
15610 IF LOF(1)>LOC(1) THEN
15630 *ADLA1:FREAD #1,C$,1:IF C$<>"@" AND LOF(1)>LOC(1) GOTO *ADLA1
15640 ENDIF
15650 IF LOF(1)>LOC(1) THEN
15670 *ADLA2:B$=B$+C$:FREAD #1,C$,1:IF LOF(1)>LOC(1) GOTO *ADLA2
15680  B$=B$+C$
15690 ENDIF
15700 CLOSE #1
15710 OPEN L1$ FOR OUTPUT AS #1
15720 FWRITE #1,B$
15730 CLOSE #1
15740 B$=""
15750 RETURN
15760 '---------------------
15770 'Update a tone
15780 '---------------------
15790 'ENTRY:
15800 ' ARG1 : tone number
15810 ' ARG2$: name
15820 ' ARG3$: file name
15840 *NEIRO_UPDATE
15850 GOSUB *SET_FM_LAYER_FILE:'Create
15860 '
15870 GOSUB *NEIRO_MAXNO:RET=RET-1
15880 IF RET<=0 OR RET<(ARG1+1) THEN RETURN
15890 LIST_$(ARG1,0)="#"+ARG2$
15900 ON ERROR GOTO *NE_UP_ERR0
15910 OPEN ARG3$ FOR OUTPUT AS #1
15920 ON ERROR GOTO *NE_UP_ERR1
15930 FOR I=0 TO MAX_NEIRO-1
15940  FWRITE #1,LIST_$(I,0)+","+LIST_$(I,1)+","+LIST_$(I,2)+CHR$(13)+CHR$(10)
15950 NEXT
15960 ON ERROR GOTO *NE_UP_ERR2
15970 CLOSE #1
15980 ON ERROR GOTO *NE_UP_ERR0
15990 OPEN LIST_$(ARG1,1) FOR INPUT AS #1
16000 ON ERROR GOTO *NE_UP_ERR1
16010 B$="":C$=""
16020 FOR I=1 TO VAL(L2$)
16040 *ADL0:B$=B$+C$:FREAD #1,C$,1:IF C$<>"@" AND LOF(1)>LOC(1) GOTO *ADL0
16050 NEXT
16060 B$=B$+A$
16070 IF LOF(1)>LOC(1) THEN
16090 *ADL1:FREAD #1,C$,1:IF C$<>"@" AND LOF(1)>LOC(1) GOTO *ADL1
16100 ENDIF
16110 IF LOF(1)>LOC(1) THEN
16130 *ADL2:B$=B$+C$:FREAD #1,C$,1:IF LOF(1)>LOC(1) GOTO *ADL2
16140  B$=B$+C$
16150 ENDIF
16160 ON ERROR GOTO *NE_UP_ERR2
16170 CLOSE #1
16180 ON ERROR GOTO *NE_UP_ERR0
16190 OPEN L1$ FOR OUTPUT AS #1
16200 ON ERROR GOTO *NE_UP_ERR1
16210 FWRITE #1,B$
16220 ON ERROR GOTO *NE_UP_ERR2
16240 *NE_UP_EX1
16250 CLOSE #1
16260 B$=""
16280 *NE_UP_EX0
16290 RETURN
16310 *NE_UP_ERR0:RESUME *NE_UP_EX0
16330 *NE_UP_ERR1:RESUME *NE_UP_EX1
16350 *NE_UP_ERR2:RESUME *NE_UP_EX0
16360 '
16370 'Initial settings
16380 '
16400 *INIT
16410 PALETTE 0,15,RGB(31,31,31)
16420 PALETTE 0,128,RGB(27,26,25)
16430 PALETTE 0,9  ,RGB(16,15,14)
16440 PALETTE 0,8  ,RGB(10, 9, 8)
16450 PALETTE 0,7  ,RGB(10, 9, 8)
16460 DIM SC$(20),BG$(3)
16470 GLOAD LD_DEV$+"HIBIKI_0",1
16480 ACTIVE 1:GCOPY (0,0)-(319,127) TO BG$(0):GCOPY (0,128)-(319,255) TO BG$(1)
16490 RETURN
16500 '
16510 'Repair sprite data broken by GLOAD etc.
16520 '
16540 *HOT_INIT
16550 RETURN
16560 '-------------------
16570 'Fade out
16580 '-------------------
16600 *FADE_OUT :COLOROFS ON 0,1,4,10:FOR S_I=0 TO -255 STEP -5:COLOROFS (S_I,S_I,S_I):VSYNC :NEXT :RETURN
16620 *FADE_OUT0:COLOROFS ON 0,1,4,10:COLOROFS (-255,-255,-255):RETURN
16630 '-------------------
16640 'Fade in
16650 '-------------------
16670 *FADE_IN :COLOROFS ON 0,1,4,10:FOR S_I=-255 TO 0 STEP 5:COLOROFS (S_I,S_I,S_I):VSYNC :NEXT :RETURN
16690 *FADE_IN0:COLOROFS ON 0,1,4,10:COLOROFS (0,0,0):RETURN
16700 '
16710 'Text scrolling
16720 '
16740 *TEXT_PRINT_MOUSE
16750 MAX_TEXT_X=(LEN(SC$(0))-38)
16760 SX=(EVENTX-24)*MAX_TEXT_X/258
16780 *TEXT_PRINT
16790 MAX_TEXT_X=(LEN(SC$(0))-38)
16800 IF MAX_TEXT_X<0 THEN MAX_TEXT_X=0
16810 IF SX<0 THEN SX=0
16820 IF SX>MAX_TEXT_X THEN SX=MAX_TEXT_X
16830 FOR Y=0 TO 17
16840  LOCATE 0,Y+4:PRINT MID$(SC$(SY+Y),SX+1,38);
16850 NEXT
16860 IF MAX_TEXT_X<>0 THEN OBJ(24,4)=24+SX/MAX_TEXT_X*258 ELSE OBJ(24,4)=24
16870 RETURN
16880 '
16890 'Tray scrolling
16900 '
16920 *TRAY_PRINT_MOUSE
16930 TY=(EVENTY-27)/151*(MAX_TY-19)
16950 *TRAY_PRINT
16960 IF TY>MAX_TY-19 THEN TY=MAX_TY-19
16970 IF TY<0 THEN TY=0
16980 ACTIVE 22:COLOR,15,-1
16990 FOR KKK=0 TO 18
17000  IF (KKK+TY)<MAX_TY THEN
17010   KPRINT (2,8*KKK,0,-8,0),FIX RIGHT$("00"+MID$(STR$(INT(TY+KKK)),2),3)+"."+LEFT$(MID$(TRAY$(TY+KKK,0),2)+STRING$(16," "),16)
17020  ENDIF
17030 NEXT
17040 IF MAX_TY<=19 THEN
17050  OBJ(20,20)=20
17060  WIN(9,4)=0
17070  WIN(10,4)=0
17080 ELSE
17090  OBJ(20,20)=18
17100  OBJ(20,4)=49+(TY/(MAX_TY-19))*151
17110  WIN(9,4)=1
17120  WIN(10,4)=1
17130 ENDIF
17140 RETURN

18740 'ENTRY:FM_ALGO
18760 *FM_ALGO_DRAW
18770 IF FM_ALGO>=0 THEN
18780   LOCATE 0,0:PRINT "Algo.";:PRINT USING "##";FM_ALGO
18790   ON FM_ALGO+1 RESTORE *ALGODATA0,*ALGODATA1,*ALGODATA2,*ALGODATA3,*ALGODATA4,*ALGODATA5,*ALGODATA6,*ALGODATA7,*ALGODATA8
18800   READ X,Y:B$=STRW$(1,X)+STRW$(1,Y)
18820 *FM_ALGO_DRAWL0
18830   READ A$:IF A$<>"END" THEN B$=B$+HEXBIN$(A$):GOTO *FM_ALGO_DRAWL0
18840   ACTIVE 0:GCOPY B$ TO (8,16):A$=""
18850   'ALGO
18860   FOR L=0 TO 3
18870     READ FM_X(L),FM_Y(L),FM_S(L)
18880   NEXT
18890   GOSUB  *LAYER_DRAW_TEXT

18930 ENDIF
18940 RETURN

19040 ELSE

19060 ENDIF

19080 LOCATE 18,2:PRINT LEFT$(FM_NAME$,16)
19090 RETURN

19540 COLOR 7

19590 A$=A$+" RE:" +RIGHT$("  "+MID$(STR$(FM_RE(L)),2),3)
19600 A$=A$+" PW:" +RIGHT$("  "+MID$(STR$(FM_PW(L)),2),3)
19610 PRINT "           "+MID$(A$,P+1,27);
19620 '

19640 A$=A$+" TL:" +RIGHT$("  "+MID$(STR$(FM_TL(L)),2),3)

19680 A$=A$+" PS:" +RIGHT$("  "+MID$(STR$(FM_PS(L)),2),3)
19690 PRINT "           "+MID$(A$,P+1,27);
19700 '
19710 A$="SR:"+RIGHT$(" "+MID$(STR$(FM_SR(L)),2),2)
19720 A$=A$+"  W:" +RIGHT$("  "+MID$(STR$(FM_W(L)),2),3)
19730 A$=A$+"   S:"+RIGHT$("  "+MID$(STR$(FM_S(L)),2),3)
19740 A$=A$+" dt" +RIGHT$("   "+STR$(FM_DT(L)),4)
19750 A$=A$+" AW:" +RIGHT$("  "+MID$(STR$(FM_AW(L)),2),3)
19760 A$=A$+" MX:" +RIGHT$("  "+MID$(STR$(FM_MX(L)),2),3)
19770 PRINT "           "+MID$(A$,P+1,27);
19780 '
19790 A$="RR:"+RIGHT$(" "+MID$(STR$(FM_RR(L)),2),2)

19810 A$=A$+"  KS:"+RIGHT$("  "+STR$(FM_KS(L)),3)

19840 A$=A$+" DP:" +RIGHT$("  "+MID$(STR$(FM_DP(L)),2),3)
19850 PRINT "           "+MID$(A$,P+1,27);
19860 RETURN

20790 *FM_PARAM_INIT
20800 FOR L=0 TO 3
20810  FM_EXT(L)=0  :'FM mode
20820  FM_W(L)  =1  :'W
20830  FM_X(L)  =L  :'X
20840  FM_Y(L)  =L  :'Y
20850  FM_S(L)  =0  :'S
20860  FM_M(L)  =1  :'M
20870  FM_AR(L) =0  :'AR
20880  FM_DR(L) =0  :'DR
20890  FM_SR(L) =0  :'SR
20900  FM_RR(L) =0  :'RR
20910  FM_DL(L) =0  :'SL
20920  FM_TL(L) =0  :'TL
20930  FM_ML1(L)=0  :'ML1
20940  FM_ML2(L)=0  :'ML2
20950  FM_DT(L) =0  :'DT
20960  FM_KS(L) =0  :'KS
20970  FM_SN(L) =0  :'sn
20980  FM_EN(L) =127:'en
20990  FM_VL(L) =0  :'vl
21000  FM_RE(L) =0  :'RE
21010  FM_LF(L) =0  :'LF
21020  FM_AW(L) =0  :'AW
21030  FM_AS(L) =0  :'AS
21040  FM_PW(L) =0  :'PW
21050  FM_PS(L) =0  :'PS
21060  FM_MX(L) =0  :'MX
21070  FM_DP(L) =0  :'DP
21080 NEXT
21090 FM_S(3)  =7  :'S
21100 FM_X(0)  =1  :'X
21110 FM_Y(0)  =1  :'Y
21120 RETURN
21130 '
21150 *MAKE_FILE_FM
21160 PRINT "REM ------"
21170 PRINT "DATA BUILDLAYER"
21180 PRINT "REM "
21190 FOR L=0 TO 3
21200 A$="DATA "
21210 IF FM_EXT(L)<>0 THEN A$=A$+"FMEXT," ELSE A$=A$+"FM,"
21220 A$=A$+MID$(STR$(L),2)+","+RIGHT$(" "+MID$(STR$(FM_W(L)),2),2)+","+MID$(STR$(FM_X(L)),2)+","+MID$(STR$(FM_Y(L)),2)+","
21230 A$=A$+RIGHT$(" "+MID$(STR$(FM_M(L)),2),2)+","+MID$(STR$(FM_S(L)),2)+","
21240 A$=A$+RIGHT$(" "+MID$(STR$(FM_AR(L)),2),2)+","+RIGHT$(" "+MID$(STR$(FM_DR(L)),2),2)+","+RIGHT$(" "+MID$(STR$(FM_SR(L)),2),2)+","+RIGHT$(" "+MID$(STR$(FM_RR(L)),2),2)+","
21250 PRINT A$
21260 NEXT
21270 PRINT "DATA ENDLAYER"
21280 RETURN

21300 'Draw the picture
21310 '
21330 *ENV_DRAW
21340 ACTIVE 0
21350 COLOR,15
21360 LINE (X*8+8,Y*8+8)-(X*8+79+8,Y*8+39+8),8,BF
21370 LINE (X*8+9,Y*8+8)-(X*8+79+8,Y*8+38+8),128,BF
21380 LINE (X*8+9,Y*8+9)-(X*8+78+8,Y*8+38+8),9,BF
21390 PSET (X*8+8,Y*8+38+8)
21400 IF FM_AR(L)=0 THEN
21410  LINE -(X*8+38+8,Y*8+38+8)
21420  RETURN
21430 ELSE
21440  AT=&H400/FM_AR(L)
21450 ENDIF
21460 IF FM_DR(F)=0 THEN
21470  IF FM_DL(L)=0 THEN
21480   DT1=0
21490  ELSE
21500   DT1=AT
21510  ENDIF
21520 ELSE
21530  DT1=(FM_DL(L))*&H10/FM_DR(L)
21540 ENDIF
21550 DT2=(AT+DT1)/2
21560 IF FM_RR(L)=0 THEN
21570  RT=AT/2
21580 ELSE
21590  RT=(&H400-FM_SR(L)*DT2-(FM_DL(L)*&H10))/FM_RR(L)
21600 ENDIF
21610 T=AT+DT1+DT2+RT
21620 'AR
21630 LINE -(X*8+9+AT/T*80,Y*8+9)
21640 'DT1
21650 YY=FM_DL(L)*&H10/&H400*40:IF YY>40 THEN YY=40
21660 LINE -(X*8+9+(AT+DT1)/T*80,Y*8+9+YY)
21670 'DT2
21680 YY=(FM_DL(L)*&H10+DT2*FM_SR(L))/&H400*40:IF YY>40 THEN YY=40
21690 LINE -(X*8+9+(AT+DT1+DT2)/T*80,Y*8+8+YY)
21700 'RR
21710 LINE -(X*8+8+79,Y*8+8+38)
21720 RETURN
21730 '

26120 FREAD #1,C$,1:IF C$=CHR$(13) GOTO *GET_TOKENL

26210 *NEIRO_LAYER_SET
26220 RET=0
26230 TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*64+1,1))
26240 IF TEMP>=0 OR TEMP<=1 THEN
26250   'Built-in sounds
26260   TEMP$=MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+ 3, 8)+" "
26270   TEMP$=LEFT$(TEMP$,INSTR(TEMP$," ")-1)
26280   USERDATA TEMP$                  :'Tone set name
26290   TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+11, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26300   USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'Tone number
26310   TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+12, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26320   USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'a layer number
26330   TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+18, 1)):IF               TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26340   USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'Start note
26350   TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+19, 1)):IF               TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26360   USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'End note
26370   TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+20, 1)):IF               TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26380   USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'Base note
26390 ELSE
26400   IF TEMP>=16 OR TEMP<=17 THEN
26410     'Made sounds
26420     IF TEMP=16 THEN
26430       'Made sounds: PCM
26440       USERDATA "FILE"
26450       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+2, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>5 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26460       USERDATA DEV$(TEMP)+MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+ 2, 8)  :'File name
26470       USERDATA "20",0:USERDATA "0",0
26480       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+17, 1)):IF                TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26490       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'Start note
26500       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+18, 1)):IF                TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26510       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'End note
26520       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+19, 1)):IF                TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26530       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'Base note
26540     ELSE
26550       'Made sounds: FM
26560       USERDATA "FM"
26570       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+51, 1)):IF TEMP<1  OR TEMP>32  THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26580       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'OP number
26590       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+52, 1)):IF                TEMP>4   THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26600       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'W wave format
26610       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+53, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>1   THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26620       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'C carrier
26630       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+42, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>32  THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26640       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'X
26650       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+43, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>32  THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26660       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'Y
26670       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+54, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>32  THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26680       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'M modulation depth
26690       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+47, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>7   THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26700       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'S direct data send level
26710       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+22, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>31  THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26720       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'AR
26730       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+23, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>31  THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26740       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'D1R
26750       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+24, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>31  THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26760       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'D2R
26770       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+25, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>31  THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26780       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'RR
26790       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+26, 1)):IF TEMP<0  OR TEMP>31  THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26800       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'DL
26810       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+55, 1))
26820       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'TL
26830       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+18, 1)):IF TEMP<-1 OR TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26840       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'sn
26850       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+19, 1)):IF TEMP<-1 OR TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26860       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'en
26870       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+20, 1)):IF TEMP<-1 OR TEMP>127 THEN RET=-1:RETURN
26880       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'bn
26890       TEMP=ASC(MID$(NEIRO$,NE_NO*80+21, 1))-64
26900       USERDATA STR$(TEMP),0 :'ft
26910     ENDIF
26920   ELSE
26930     'Undefined
26940     RET=-1
26950     RETURN
26960   ENDIF
26970 ENDIF
26980 RETURN

27280 '--[SYS_INIT]---------------------------
27290 ' Initialise the system so it can be used
27300 ' WORK :
27310 '    SYS_I,SYS_J,A$
27320 ' RETURN :
27330 '---------------------------------------
27350 *SYS_INIT
27360 DIM EV(255,2)        :'For the message queue
27370 DIM SYS_MES_NAME$(2) :'Holds the message box button captions
27380 DIM SYS_DEV$(7)      :'For the file selection device
27390 PRINT "GAME BASIC for SEGASATURN        "
27395 PRINT "                System for Sofiya"
27400 PRINT "                     Version 1.00"
27410 PRINT :VSYNC 30
27420 SPRWINDOW,,,,,0,0
27430 'Set the texture for the cursor
27440 RESTORE *SYS_DATA:READ SYS_K:DIM SYS_PATTERN$(SYS_K+1)
27450 FOR SYS_I=0 TO SYS_K:FOR SYS_J=1 TO 32
27460  READ A$:SYS_PATTERN$(SYS_I)=SYS_PATTERN$(SYS_I)+HEXBIN$(A$)
27470 NEXT :NEXT :A$=""
27480 'Set the icons for the message box
27490 READ SYS_K:DIM SYS_MSGICON$(SYS_K)
27500 FOR SYS_I=0 TO SYS_K-1
27520 *SYS_LOP1:READ A$:IF A$<>"ENDTEX" THEN SYS_MSGICON$(SYS_I)=SYS_MSGICON$(SYS_I)+HEXBIN$(A$):GOTO *SYS_LOP1
27530 NEXT :A$=""
27540 GOSUB *SYS_DEVICECHECK
27550 'Reserve the textures for the system window
27560 SYS_I=VERTEXID(-1):SETVERTEX,4,(-80,-20,0),(80,-20,0),(80,20,0),(-80,20,0)
27570 SYS_POLYGONID=POLYGONID(-1):SETPOLYGON,1,SYS_I,,(0,1,2,3)
27580 SYS_I=VERTEXID(-1):SETVERTEX,4,(-120,-40,0),(120,-40,0),(120,40,0),(-120,40,0)
27590 SYS_POLYGONID1=POLYGONID(-1):SETPOLYGON,1,SYS_I,,(0,1,2,3)
27600 SYS_TEXID=TEXID(-1):SETTEX,160,40,256
27610 SYS_TEXID1=TEXID(-1):SETTEX,240,80,256
27620 SYS_WINDOW=ATRID(-1):SETATR,1,(0,0,3,SYS_TEXID,0,0)
27630 SYS_WINDOW1=ATRID(-1):SETATR,1,(0,0,3,SYS_TEXID1,0,0)
27640 OBJ(255,0)=7,,,,-10,-10:RETURN
27650 '--[SYS_MOUSEPOINTER]-------------------
27660 ' Change the mouse pointer's shape
27670 ' ENTRY :
27680 ' MOUSEPOINTER  0  normal pointer
27690 ' 1  busy pointer
27700 ' WORK :
27710 ' RETURN :
27720 '---------------------------------------
27740 *SYS_MOUSEPOINTER
27750 LOCK
27760 IF MOUSEPOINTER=0 THEN
27770   INTERVAL (1) OFF
27780   SYS_POINTERTYPE=0:SETTEX 0,32,32,16,SYS_PATTERN$(0)
27790 ELSE
27800   INTERVAL (1) ON,5
27810   SYS_POINTERTYPE=1:SYS_POINTERANIME=0:SETTEX 0,32,32,16,SYS_PATTERN$(1)
27820 ENDIF
27830 UNLOCK :RETURN
27850 *SYS_ANIME
27860 IF SYS_POINTERTYPE=1 THEN
27870   LOCK :SETTEX 0,32,32,16,SYS_PATTERN$(SYS_POINTERANIME+1):SYS_POINTERANIME=SYS_POINTERANIME XOR 1:UNLOCK
27880 ENDIF
27890 RETURN
27900 '--[SYS_DEVICECHECK]--------------------
27910 'Detect the input device
27920 '
27930 ' WORK :
27940 '     SYS_I,SYS_J
27950 '
27960 ' RETURN :
27970 '     SPADMODE
27980 '     SKEYMODE
27990 '     SPADNO
28000 '     SKEYNO
28010 '---------------------------------------
28030 *SYS_DEVICECHECK
28040 PRINT "Detecting input device":PRINT
28050 FOR SYS_I=28 TO 0 STEP -1
28060   SYS_J=PAD(SYS_I,0)
28070   IF SYS_J>=&H0  AND SYS_J<=&HF   AND SPADMODE<>2 THEN SPADNO=SYS_I:SPADMODE=1:PRINT "#";SYS_I;" Control pad found."
28080   IF SYS_J>=&HE0 AND SYS_J<=&HFE THEN SPADNO=SYS_I:SPADMODE=2:PRINT "#";SYS_I;" Shuttle Mouse found."
28090   IF SYS_J>=&H30 AND SYS_J<=&HDF THEN SKEYNO=SYS_I:SKEYMODE=1:PRINT "#";SYS_I;" SEGA Saturn keyboard found."
28100 NEXT
28110 IF SPADMODE<>0 THEN
28120   OBJ(1,0)=7:OBJ(1,16)=0,0:OBJ(1,20)=0:OBJ(1,12)=.5,.5
28130   ON INTERVAL (1) GOSUB *SYS_ANIME
28140   IF SPADMODE=1 THEN ON INTERVAL (0) GOSUB *SYS_PAD
28150   IF SPADMODE=2 THEN ON INTERVAL (0) GOSUB *SYS_MOUSE
28160 ENDIF
28170 VSYNC 30:RETURN
28180 '========================
28190 ' Pad input handling
28200 '========================
28210 '
28220 ' WORK :
28230 ' MB..PAD state
28240 ' MX..mouse pointer X coordinate
28250 ' MY..mouse pointer Y coordinate
28260 ' BR..right button (C) state
28270 ' BC..middle button (B) state
28280 ' BL..left button (A) state
28290 ' BS..start button state
28300 '
28310 ' MX2..mouse pointer X coordinate (previous)
28320 ' MY2..mouse pointer Y coordinate (previous)
28330 ' MR..right button (C) state (previous)
28340 ' MC..middle button (B) state (previous)
28350 ' ML..left button (A) state (previous)
28360 ' MS..start button state (previous)
28370 '
28380 ' TR..right button timer (used for clicks)
28390 ' TC..right button timer (used for clicks)
28400 ' TL..right button timer (used for clicks)
28410 ' TS..right button timer (used for clicks)
28420 '
28440 *SYS_PAD
28450 LOCK :MB=PAD(SPADNO,1)
28460 IF (MB AND &H40) THEN MV=8 ELSE MV=1
28470 IF (MB AND &H8000) THEN MX=MX+MV+1 ELSE IF (MB AND &H4000) THEN MX=MX-MV-1
28480 IF (MB AND &H2000) THEN MY=MY+MV+1 ELSE IF (MB AND &H1000) THEN MY=MY-MV-1
28490 IF MX<0 THEN MX=0 ELSE IF MX>319 THEN MX=319
28500 IF MY<0 THEN MY=0 ELSE IF MY>223 THEN MY=223
28510 OBJ(1,4)=MX,MY
28520 BR=MB AND &H200:BC=MB AND &H100:BL=MB AND &H400:BS=MB AND &H800
28530 IF MX2<>MX OR MY2<>MY THEN EV(EW,0)=-2:GOSUB *QIN:MX2=MX:MY2=MY
28540 IF MR AND BR=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=5:GOSUB *QIN
28550 IF (MR=0) AND BR THEN EV(EW,0)=4:GOSUB *QIN:TR=15 ELSE TR=TR+(TR>0)
28560 IF (BR=0) AND MR AND TR>1 THEN EV(EW,0)=6:GOSUB *QIN:TR=0
28570 IF ML AND BL=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=1:MDC1L=0:GOSUB *QIN
28580 IF (ML=0) AND BL THEN EV(EW,0)=0:GOSUB *QIN:TL=14:MDXL=MX:MDYL=MY ELSE TL=TL+(TL>0):IF TL=0 THEN MDCL=0
28590 IF (BL=0) AND ML AND (TL>1) AND MDC1L=0 THEN
28600   IF (ABS(MDXL-MX)<=2) AND ABS(MDYL-MY)<=2 THEN
28610     MDCL=MDCL+1:MDC1L=1
28620     IF MDCL=1 THEN EV(EW,0)=2:GOSUB *QIN
28630     IF MDCL=2 THEN EV(EW,0)=3:GOSUB *QIN:TL=0
28640   ELSE
28650     MDC1L=0:TL=0
28660   ENDIF
28670 ENDIF
28680 '
28690 IF MC AND BC=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=9:GOSUB *QIN
28700 IF (MC=0) AND BC THEN EV(EW,0)=8:GOSUB *QIN:TC=15:MDXC=MX:MDYC=MY ELSE TC=TC+(TC>0)
28710 IF (BC=0) AND MC AND (TC>1) AND (ABS(MDXC-MX)<=2) AND ABS(MDYC-MY)<=2 THEN EV(EW,0)=10:GOSUB *QIN:TC=0
28720 IF (MS=0) AND BS THEN TS=15 ELSE TS=TS+(TS>0)
28730 IF (BS=0) AND MS AND TS>1 THEN TS=0:EV(EW,0)=12:GOSUB *QIN
28740 MR=BR:ML=BL:MC=BC:MS=BS:UNLOCK :RETURN
28750 '========================
28760 ' Mouse input handling
28770 '========================
28780 '
28790 ' WORK :
28800 ' MB..PAD state
28810 ' MX..mouse pointer X coordinate
28820 ' MY..mouse pointer Y coordinate
28830 ' BR..right button (C) state
28840 ' BC..middle button (B) state
28850 ' BL..left button (A) state
28860 ' BS..start button state
28870 '
28880 ' MX2..mouse pointer X coordinate (previous)
28890 ' MY2..mouse pointer Y coordinate (previous)
28900 ' MR..right button (C) state (previous)
28910 ' MC..middle button (B) state (previous)
28920 ' ML..left button (A) state (previous)
28930 ' MS..start button state (previous)
28940 '
28950 ' TR..right button timer (used for clicks)
28960 ' TC..right button timer (used for clicks)
28970 ' TL..right button timer (used for clicks)
28980 ' TS..right button timer (used for clicks)
28990 '
29010 *SYS_MOUSE
29020 LOCK :MX1=PAD(SPADNO,3):MY1=PAD(SPADNO,4)
29030 MXV=MX1-MX0:IF MXV<-384 THEN MXV=65535-MX0+MX1 ELSE IF MXV>384 THEN MXV=65535+MX0-MX1
29040 MYV=MY1-MY0:IF MYV<-384 THEN MYV=65535-MY0+MY1 ELSE IF MYV>384 THEN MYV=65535+MY0-MY1
29050 MX=MX+MXV:MY=MY+MYV
29060 IF MX<0 THEN MX=0 ELSE IF MX>319 THEN MX=319
29070 IF MY<0 THEN MY=0 ELSE IF MY>223 THEN MY=223
29080 OBJ(1,4)=MX,MY
29090 MX0=MX1:MY0=MY1
29100 MB=PAD(SPADNO,1):BR=MB AND &H200:BC=MB AND &H100:BL=MB AND &H400:BS=MB AND &H800
29110 IF MX2<>MX OR MY2<>MY THEN EV(EW,0)=-2:GOSUB *QIN_M:MX2=MX:MY2=MY
29120 IF MR AND BR=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=5:GOSUB *QIN
29130 IF MR=0 AND BR THEN EV(EW,0)=4:GOSUB *QIN:TR=15 ELSE TR=TR+(TR>0)
29140 IF BR=0 AND MR AND TR>1 THEN EV(EW,0)=6:GOSUB *QIN:TR=0
29150 IF ML AND BL=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=1:MDC1L=0:GOSUB *QIN
29160 IF BL AND ML=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=0:GOSUB *QIN:TL=14:MDXL=MX:MDYL=MY ELSE TL=TL+(TL>0):IF TL=0 THEN MDCL=0
29170 IF ML AND BL=0 AND TL>1 AND MDC1L=0 THEN
29180   IF ABS(MDXL-MX)<=2 AND ABS(MDYL-MY)<=2 THEN
29190     MDCL=MDCL+1:MDC1L=1
29200     IF MDCL=1 THEN EV(EW,0)=2:GOSUB *QIN
29210     IF MDCL=2 THEN EV(EW,0)=3:GOSUB *QIN:TL=0
29220   ELSE
29230       MDC1L=0:TL=0
29240   ENDIF
29250 ENDIF
29260 IF MC AND BC=0 THEN EV(EW,0)=9:GOSUB *QIN
29270 IF MC=0 AND BC THEN EV(EW,0)=8:GOSUB *QIN:TC=15 ELSE TC=TC+(TC>0)
29280 IF BC=0 AND MC AND TC>1 THEN EV(EW,0)=10:GOSUB *QIN:TC=0
29290 IF MS=0 AND BS THEN TS=15 ELSE TS=TS+(TS>0)
29300 IF BS=0 AND MS AND TS>1 THEN TS=0:EV(EW,0)=12:GOSUB *QIN
29310 MR=BR:ML=BL:MC=BC:MS=BS:UNLOCK :RETURN
29320 'Write a message to the message queue
29340 *QIN_M
29350 IF EW<>0 THEN
29360  IF EV(EW-1,0)=-2 THEN EW=EW-1
29370 ELSE
29380  IF EV(255,0)=-2 THEN EW=255
29390 ENDIF
29410 *QIN:EV(EW,1)=MX:EV(EW,2)=MY:EW=(EW+1) AND 255:RETURN
29420 'Read a message from the message queue
29440 *QOUT
29450 MMF$=INKEY$:IF MMF$<>"" THEN EVENT=-3:MMF=1:EVENTX=ASC(MMF$):RETURN
29460 IF MMF$="" AND MMF=1 THEN MMF=0:EVENT=-3:EVENTX=-1:RETURN
29470 IF ER=EW GOTO *QOUT
29480 EVENT=EV(ER,0):EVENTX=EV(ER,1):EVENTY=EV(ER,2):EV(ER,0)=-99:ER=(ER+1) AND 255:RETURN
29500 *QOUT1:IF ER=EW THEN RETURN
29510 EVENT=EV(ER,0):EVENTX=EV(ER,1):EVENTY=EV(ER,2):ER=(ER+1) AND 255:RETURN
29520 'Clear the message queue

### T_KANADE.B: Kanade (Playing)

**File:** `T_KANADE.B` on the GAME BASIC CD, 10,583 bytes, 223 lines. 182 lines shown. Run it with `LOAD "CD:T_KANADE.B",R`.

A music visualiser: plays the BGM and shows a keyboard and level meter for each of the 16 tracks, lighting the keys as notes play (TM p. 128).

**Techniques:**

- `MMLSTAT(track,1)` to read the note each track is playing
- `PLAYSTAT` to see when the song ends
- Fades with `COLOROFS` under `ON INTERVAL`

```
 1000 '-----------------------------------

 1050 '
 1060 '
 1070 ' Programed by Script Arts.Co.,Ltd.

 1260   Y=Y+13

 1630 RETURN

 1650 'Draw the volume
 1660 '------------------------
 1670 *SET_VOL:IF MN(1,I)=0 THEN RETURN
 1680 LOCK
 1690 VOL1(I)=MMLSTAT(I,4)*.0625
 1700 IF VOL(I)>VOL1(I) THEN VOL(I)=VOL1(I)
 1710 SV=MN(1,I)*.25+16
 1720 VOL1(SV)=VOL1(I)
 1730 VOL1(SV+1)=VOL1(I)+(16-VOL1(I))*.2:VOL1(SV-1)=VOL1(SV+1)
 1740 VOL1(SV+2)=VOL1(I)+(16-VOL1(I))*.4:VOL1(SV-2)=VOL1(SV+2)
 1750 VOL1(SV+3)=VOL1(I)+(16-VOL1(I))*.6:VOL1(SV-3)=VOL1(SV+3)
 1760 VOL1(SV+4)=VOL1(I)+(16-VOL1(I))*.8:VOL1(SV-4)=VOL1(SV+4)
 1770 IF VOL(SV)>VOL1(SV)     THEN VOL(SV)=VOL1(SV)
 1780 IF VOL(SV+1)>VOL1(SV+1) THEN VOL(SV+1)=VOL1(SV+1)
 1790 IF VOL(SV-1)>VOL1(SV-1) THEN VOL(SV-1)=VOL1(SV-1)
 1800 IF VOL(SV+2)>VOL1(SV+2) THEN VOL(SV+2)=VOL1(SV+2)
 1810 IF VOL(SV-2)>VOL1(SV-2) THEN VOL(SV-2)=VOL1(SV-2)
 1820 IF VOL(SV+3)>VOL1(SV+3) THEN VOL(SV+3)=VOL1(SV+3)
 1830 IF VOL(SV-3)>VOL1(SV-3) THEN VOL(SV-3)=VOL1(SV-3)
 1840 IF VOL(SV+4)>VOL1(SV+4) THEN VOL(SV+4)=VOL1(SV+4)
 1850 IF VOL(SV-4)>VOL1(SV-4) THEN VOL(SV-4)=VOL1(SV-4)
 1860 UNLOCK
